verses.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.fr: Salomon, fils de David, s''affermit dans son règne; l''Eternel, son Dieu, fut avec lui, et l''éleva à un haut degré.
verses.am: የዳዊት ልጅ ሰሎሞን በመንግሥቱ በረታ፤ አምላኩም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ፥ እጅግም አገነነው።

verses.en: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
verses.fr: Salomon donna des ordres à tout Israël, aux chefs de milliers et de centaines, aux juges, aux princes de tout Israël, aux chefs des maisons paternelles;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ለሻለቆች፥ ለመቶ አለቆችም፥ ለፈራጆችም፥ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ዘንድ ለነበሩ መሳፍንት ሁሉ፥ ለአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ተናገረ።

verses.en: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.
verses.fr: et Salomon se rendit avec toute l''assemblée au haut lieu qui était à Gabaon. Là se trouvait la tente d''assignation de Dieu, faite dans le désert par Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከእርሱም ጋር ጉባኤው ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ የሠራው የእግዚአብሔር መገናኛ ድንኳን በዚያ ነበረና በገባዖን ወዳለው የኮረብታ መስገጃ ሄዱ።

verses.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: mais l''arche de Dieu avait été transportée par David de Kirjath-Jearim à la place qu''il lui avait préparée, car il avait dressé pour elle une tente à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ታቦት ግን ዳዊት በኢየሩሳሌም ድንኳን ተክሎለት ነበርና ዳዊት ከቂርያትይዓሪም ወዳዘጋጀለት ስፍራ አምጥቶት ነበር።

verses.en: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.fr: Là se trouvait aussi, devant le tabernacle de l''Eternel, l''autel d''airain qu''avait fait Betsaleel, fils d''Uri, fils de Hur. Salomon et l''assemblée cherchèrent l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሆርም ልጅ የኡሪ ልጅ ባስልኤል የሠራው የናስ መሠዊያ በዚያ በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት ነበረ፤ ሰሎሞንም ጉባኤውም ይህን ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the Lord, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.fr: Et ce fut là, sur l''autel d''airain qui était devant la tente d''assignation, que Salomon offrit à l''Eternel mille holocaustes.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመገናኛው ድንኳን አጠገብ ወዳለው ወደ ናሱ መሠዊያ ወጣ፥ በዚያም አንድ ሺህ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።

verses.en: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
verses.fr: Pendant la nuit, Dieu apparut à Salomon et lui dit: Demande ce que tu veux que je te donne.
verses.am: በዚያም ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር። ምን እንድሰጥህ ለምነኝ ሲል ለሰሎሞን ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
verses.fr: Salomon répondit à Dieu: Tu as traité David, mon père, avec une grande bienveillance, et tu m''as fait régner à sa place.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር ታላቅ ምሕረት አድርገሃል፥ በእርሱም ፋንታ አንግሠኸኛል።

verses.en: Now, O Lord God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel Dieu, que ta promesse à David, mon père, s''accomplisse, puisque tu m''as fait régner sur un peuple nombreux comme la poussière de la terre!
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ቍጥሩ እንደ ምድር ትቢያ በሆነው በብዙ ሕዝብ ላይ አንግሠኸኛልና ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸው ተስፋ ይጽና።

verses.en: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
verses.fr: Accorde-moi donc de la sagesse et de l''intelligence, afin que je sache me conduire à la tête de ce peuple! Car qui pourrait juger ton peuple, ce peuple si grand?
verses.am: አሁንም በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት እወጣና እገባ ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ስጠኝ፤ ይህን በሚያህል በዚህ በታላቅ ሕዝብ ላይ ይፈርድ ዘንድ የሚችል የለምና።

verses.en: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Salomon: Puisque c''est là ce qui est dans ton coeur, puisque tu ne demandes ni des richesses, ni des biens, ni de la gloire, ni la mort de tes ennemis, ni même une longue vie, et que tu demandes pour toi de la sagesse et de l''intelligence afin de juger mon peuple sur lequel je t''ai fait régner,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰሎሞንን። ይህ በልብህ ነበረና፥ ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንና የጠላቶችህን ነፍስ ረጅምም ዕድሜን አልለመንህምና፥ ነገር ግን ባነገሥሁህ በሕዝቤ ላይ ለመፍረድ ትችል ዘንድ ጥበብንና እውቀትን ለራስህ ለምነሃልና ጥበብንና እውቀትን ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤

verses.en: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
verses.fr: la sagesse et l''intelligence te sont accordées. Je te donnerai, en outre, des richesses, des biens et de la gloire, comme n''en a jamais eu aucun roi avant toi et comme n''en aura aucun après toi.
verses.am: ከአንተ በፊትም ከነበሩት ከአንተም በኋላ ከሚነሡት ነገሥታት አንድ ስንኳ የሚመስልህ እንዳይኖር ባለጠግነትንና ሀብትን ክብርንም እሰጥሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
verses.fr: Salomon revint à Jérusalem, après avoir quitté le haut lieu qui était à Gabaon et la tente d''assignation. Et il régna sur Israël.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በገባዖን ካለው ከኮረብታው መስገጃ ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፤ በእስራኤልም ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Salomon rassembla des chars et de la cavalerie; il avait quatorze cents chars et douze mille cavaliers, qu''il plaça dans les villes où il tenait ses chars et à Jérusalem près du roi.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ሰረገሎቹንና ፈረሰኞችን ሰበሰበ፥ አንድ ሺህም አራት መቶ ሰረገሎች፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፤ በሰረገሎች ከተሞችና ከእርሱ ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
verses.fr: Le roi rendit l''argent et l''or aussi communs à Jérusalem que les pierres, et les cèdres aussi communs que les sycomores qui croissent dans la plaine.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ብሩንና ወርቁን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ ሆነ።

verses.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.fr: C''était de l''Egypte que Salomon tirait ses chevaux; une caravane de marchands du roi allait les chercher par troupes à un prix fixe;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ፈረሶችን ከግብጽና ከቀዌ አስመጣ፤ የንጉሡም ነጋዴዎች በገንዘብ እየገዙ ከቀዌ ያመጡአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.fr: on faisait monter et sortir d''Egypte un char pour six cents sicles d''argent, et un cheval pour cent cinquante sicles. Ils en amenaient de même avec eux pour tous les rois des Héthiens et pour les rois de Syrie.
verses.am: አንዱም ሰረገላ በስድስት መቶ፥ አንዱም ፈረስ በመቶ አምሳ ሰቅል ብር ከግብጽ ይወጣ ነበር፤ እንዲሁም ለኬጢያውያንና ለሶሪያ ነገሥታት ሁሉ በእጃቸው ያመጡላቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.fr: Salomon ordonna que l''on bâtît une maison au nom de l''Eternel et une maison royale pour lui.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት፥ ለመንግሥቱም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ አሰበ።

verses.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.fr: Salomon compta soixante-dix mille hommes pour porter les fardeaux, quatre-vingt mille pour tailler les pierres dans la montagne, et trois mille six cents pour les surveiller.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የሚሸከሙትን ሰባ ሺህ፥ ከተራሮችም የሚጠርቡትን ሰማኒያ ሺህ፥ በእነርሱም ላይ የተሾሙትን ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሰዎች ቈጠረ።

verses.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
verses.fr: Salomon envoya dire à Huram, roi de Tyr: Fais pour moi comme tu as fait pour David, mon père, à qui tu as envoyé des cèdres afin qu''il se bâtît une maison d''habitation.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም እንዲህ ሲል ወደ ጢሮስ ንጉሥ ወደ ኪራም ላከ። ከአባቴ ከዳዊት ጋር እንዳደረግህ፥ የሚቀመጥበትንም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የዝግባ እንጨት እንደ ሰደድህለት፥ እንዲሁ ለእኔ አድርግ።

verses.en: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
verses.fr: Voici, j''élève une maison au nom de l''Eternel, mon Dieu, pour la lui consacrer, pour brûler devant lui le parfum odoriférant, pour présenter continuellement les pains de proposition, et pour offrir les holocaustes du matin et du soir, des sabbats, des nouvelles lunes, et des fêtes de l''Eternel, notre Dieu, suivant une loi perpétuelle pour Israël.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለእስራኤል ለዘላለም እንደ ታዘዘው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የጣፋጩን ሽቱ ለማጠን፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት ለማኖር፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በጥዋትና በማታ በሰንበታቱም በመባቻዎቹም በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር በዓላት ለማቅረብ ለአምላኬ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት እሠራና እቀድስ ዘንድ አሰብሁ።

verses.en: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
verses.fr: La maison que je vais bâtir doit être grande, car notre Dieu est plus grand que tous les dieux.
verses.am: አምላካችንም ከአማልክት ሁሉ በላይ ታላቅ ነውና የምሠራው ቤት ታላቅ ነው።

verses.en: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.fr: Mais qui a le pouvoir de lui bâtir une maison, puisque les cieux et les cieux des cieux ne peuvent le contenir? Et qui suis-je pour lui bâtir une maison, si ce n''est pour faire brûler des parfums devant lui?
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሰማይና ከሰማያት በላይ ያለ ሰማይ ይይዘው ዘንድ አይችልምና ለእርሱ ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ማን ይችላል? በፊቱ ዕጣን ከማጠን በቀር ቤት እሠራለት ዘንድ እኔ ማን ነኝ?

verses.en: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.fr: Envoie-moi donc un homme habile pour les ouvrages en or, en argent, en airain et en fer, en étoffes teintes en pourpre, en cramoisi et en bleu, et connaissant la sculpture, afin qu''il travaille avec les hommes habiles qui sont auprès de moi en Juda et à Jérusalem et que David, mon père, a choisis.
verses.am: አሁንም አባቴ ዳዊት ካዘጋጃቸው በእኔ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ካሉት ብልሃተኞች ጋር የሚሆን፥ ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ናሱንና ብረቱን፥ ሐምራዊውንና ቀዩን ሰማያዊውንም ግምጃ የሚሠራ፥ ቅርጽንም የሚያውቅ ብልሃተኛ ሰው ላክልኝ።

verses.en: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
verses.fr: Envoie-moi aussi du Liban des bois de cèdre, de cyprès et de sandal; car je sais que tes serviteurs s''entendent à couper les bois du Liban. Voici, mes serviteurs seront avec les tiens.
verses.am: ደግሞም ባሪያዎችህ ከሊባኖስ እንጨት መቍረጥ እንዲያውቁ እኔ አውቃለሁና ከሊባኖስ የዝግባና የጥድ የሰንደልም እንጨት ስደድልኝ።

verses.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
verses.fr: Que l''on me prépare du bois en abondance, car la maison que je vais bâtir sera grande et magnifique.
verses.am: የምሠራውም ቤት እጅግ ታላቅና ድንቅ ይሆናልና ብዙ እንጨት ያዘጋጁልኝ ዘንድ፥ እነሆ፥ ባሪያዎቼ ከባሪያዎችህ ጋር ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.fr: Je donnerai à tes serviteurs qui couperont, qui abattront les bois, vingt mille cors de froment foulé, vingt mille cors d''orge, vingt mille baths de vin, et vingt mille baths d''huile.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እንጨቱን ለሚቈርጡ ለባሪያዎችህ ሀያ ሺህ የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የተበጠረ ስንዴ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ገብስ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ የወይን ጠጅ፥ ሀያ ሺህም የባዶስ መስፈሪያ ዘይት እሰጣለሁ።

verses.en: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the Lord hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
verses.fr: Huram, roi de Tyr, répondit dans une lettre qu''il envoya à Salomon: C''est parce que l''Eternel aime son peuple qu''il t''a établi roi sur eux.
verses.am: የጢሮስ ንጉሥም ኪራም። እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ወድዶአልና በላያቸው አነገሠህ ብሎ ለሰሎሞን መልእክት ላከ።

verses.en: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.
verses.fr: Huram dit encore: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui a fait les cieux et la terre, de ce qu''il a donné au roi David un fils sage, prudent et intelligent, qui va bâtir une maison à l''Eternel et une maison royale pour lui!
verses.am: ኪራምም ደግሞ አለ። ሰማይንና ምድርን የፈጠረ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለመንግሥቱም ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ ጥበበኛና ብልሃተኛ አስተዋይም ልጅ ለንጉሡ ለዳዊት የሰጠ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ቡሩክ ይሁን።

verses.en: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
verses.fr: Je t''envoie donc un homme habile et intelligent, Huram-Abi,
verses.am: አሁንም ከብልሃተኞችህ ጋር ከጌታዬም ከአባትህ ከዳዊት ብልሃተኞች ጋር ይሆን ዘንድ ኪራምአቢ የሚባል ብልሃተኛና አስተዋይ ሰው ሰድጄልሃለሁ።

verses.en: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
verses.fr: fils d''une femme d''entre les filles de Dan, et d''un père Tyrien. Il est habile pour les ouvrages en or, en argent, en airain et en fer, en pierre et en bois, en étoffes teintes en pourpre et en bleu, en étoffes de byssus et de carmin, et pour toute espèce de sculptures et d''objets d''art qu''on lui donne à exécuter. Il travaillera avec tes hommes habiles et avec les hommes habiles de mon seigneur David, ton père.
verses.am: እናቱ ከዳን ልጆች ናት፥ አባቱም የጢሮስ ሰው ነው፤ ወርቁንና ብሩንም፥ ናሱንና ብረቱን፥ ድንጋይንና እንጨቱን፥ ሐምራዊውንና ሰማያዊውን ቀዩንም ግምጃ፥ ጥሩውንም በፍታ ይሠራ ዘንድ፥ ቅርጽም ሌላም ነገር ሁሉ ያደርግ ዘንድ ያውቃል።

verses.en: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.fr: Maintenant, que mon seigneur envoie à ses serviteurs le froment, l''orge, l''huile et le vin dont il a parlé.
verses.am: አሁንም ጌታዬ የተናገረውን ስንዴውንና ገብሱን ዘይቱንና የወይን ጠጁን ወደ ባሪያዎቹ ይስደድ፤

verses.en: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Et nous, nous couperons des bois du Liban autant que tu en auras besoin; nous te les expédierons par mer en radeaux jusqu''à Japho, et tu les feras monter à Jérusalem.
verses.am: እኛም ከሊባኖስ የምትሻውን ያህል እንጨት እንቈርጣለን፥ በታንኳም አድርገን በባሕር ላይ ወደ አንተ ወደ ኢዮጴ እንሰድዳለን፤ አንተም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ታስወስደዋለህ።

verses.en: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: Salomon compta tous les étrangers qui étaient dans le pays d''Israël, et dont le dénombrement avait été fait par David, son père. On en trouva cent cinquante-trois mille six cents.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በእስራኤል ምድር የነበሩትን መጻተኞች ሁሉ አባቱ ዳዊት እንደ ቈጠራቸው ቈጠረ፤ መቶ አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ተገኙ።

verses.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.fr: Et il en prit soixante-dix mille pour porter les fardeaux, quatre-vingt mille pour tailler les pierres dans la montagne, et trois mille six cents pour surveiller et faire travailler le peuple.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የሚሸከሙትን ሰባ ሺህ፥ በተራሮችም ላይ የሚጠርቡትን ሰማንያ ሺህ፥ በሕዝቡም ሥራ ላይ የተሾሙትን ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አደረገ።

verses.en: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.fr: Salomon commença à bâtir la maison de l''Eternel à Jérusalem, sur la montagne de Morija, qui avait été indiquée à David, son père, dans le lieu préparé par David sur l''aire d''Ornan, le Jébusien.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔር ለአባቱ ለዳዊት በተገለጠበት በሞሪያ ተራራ ዳዊት ባዘጋጀው ስፍራ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ በኢየሩሳሌም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመረ።

verses.en: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.fr: Il commença à bâtir le second jour du second mois de la quatrième année de son règne.
verses.am: በነገሠም በአራተኛው ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር መሥራት ጀመረ።

verses.en: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.fr: Voici sur quels fondements Salomon bâtit la maison de Dieu. La longueur en coudées de l''ancienne mesure était de soixante coudées, et la largeur de vingt coudées.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የጣለው መሠረት ይህ ነው፤ ርዝመቱም በዱሮው ስፍር ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.fr: Le portique sur le devant avait vingt coudées de longueur, répondant à la largeur de la maison, et cent vingt de hauteur; Salomon le couvrit intérieurement d''or pur.
verses.am: በቤቱም ፊት የነበረው ወለል ርዝመቱ እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም መቶ ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውስጡንም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.en: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.fr: Il revêtit de bois de cyprès la grande maison, la couvrit d''or pur, et y fit sculpter des palmes et des chaînettes.
verses.am: ታላቁንም ቤት በጥድ እንጨት ከደነው፥ በጥሩም ወርቅ ለበጠው፤ የዘንባባና የሰንሰለት አምሳል ቀረጸበት።

verses.en: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.fr: Il couvrit la maison de pierres précieuses comme ornement; et l''or était de l''or de Parvaïm.
verses.am: ቤቱንም በዕንቍ አስጌጠው፤ ወርቁንም የፈርዋይም ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.fr: Il couvrit d''or la maison, les poutres, les seuils, les parois et les battants des portes, et il fit sculpter des chérubins sur les parois.
verses.am: ቤቱንም ሰረገሎቹንም መድረኮቹንም ግንቦቹንም ደጆቹንም በወርቅ ለበጠ፤ በግንቦቹም ላይ ኪሩቤልን ቀረጸ።

verses.en: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.fr: Il fit la maison du lieu très saint; elle avait vingt coudées de longueur répondant à la largeur de la maison, et vingt coudées de largeur. Il la couvrit d''or pur, pour une valeur de six cents talents;
verses.am: ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑንም ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ስድስት መቶ መክሊት በሚያህል በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።

verses.en: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.fr: et le poids de l''or pour les clous montait à cinquante sicles. Il couvrit aussi d''or les chambres hautes.
verses.am: የምስማሮቹም ሚዛን አምሳ ሰቅል ወርቅ ነበረ። የደርቡንም ጓዳዎች በወርቅ ለበጠ።

verses.en: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.fr: Il fit dans la maison du lieu très saint deux chérubins sculptés, et on les couvrit d''or.
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ውስጥ ከእንጨት ሥራ ሁለቱ ኪሩቤልን ሠራ፥ በወርቅም ለበጣቸው።

verses.en: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.fr: Les ailes des chérubins avaient vingt coudées de longueur. L''aile du premier, longue de cinq coudées, touchait au mur de la maison; et l''autre aile, longue de cinq coudées, touchait à l''aile du second chérubin.
verses.am: የኪሩቤልም ክንፎች ሀያ ክንድ ሙሉ ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ የአንዱ ኪሩብ ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የቤቱንም ግንብ ይነካ ነበረ፤ ሁለተኛው ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሁለተኛውንም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ይነካ ነበር።

verses.en: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.fr: L''aile du second chérubin, longue de cinq coudées, touchait au mur de la maison; et l''autre aile, longue de cinq coudées, joignait l''aile du premier chérubin.
verses.am: የሁለተኛውም ኪሩብ ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የቤቱንም ግንብ ይነካ ነበር፤ ሁለተኛውም ክንፍ አምስት ክንድ ነበረ፥ የሌላውንም ኪሩብ ክንፍ ይነካ ነበር።

verses.en: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.fr: Les ailes de ces chérubins, déployées, avaient vingt coudées. Ils étaient debout sur leurs pieds, la face tournée vers la maison.
verses.am: የእነዚህም ኪሩቤል ክንፎች ሀያ ክንድ ሙሉ ተዘርግተው ነበር፤ በእግራቸውም ቆመው ነበር፥ ፊቶቻቸውም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለከቱ ነበር።

verses.en: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.fr: Il fit le voile bleu, pourpre et cramoisi, et de byssus, et il y représenta des chérubins.
verses.am: ከሰማያዊውም ከሐምራዊውም ከቀዩም ሐር ከጥሩም በፍታ መጋረጃውን ሠራ፥ ኪሩቤልንም ጠለፈበት።

verses.en: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.fr: Il fit devant la maison deux colonnes de trente-cinq coudées de hauteur, avec un chapiteau de cinq coudées sur leur sommet.
verses.am: በቤቱም ፊት ቁመታቸው ሠላሳ አምስት ክንድ የነበረውን ሁለቱን ዓምዶች ሠራ፥ በእያንዳንዳቸውም ላይ የነበረው ጕልላት አምስት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.fr: Il fit des chaînettes comme celles qui étaient dans le sanctuaire, et les plaça sur le sommet des colonnes, et il fit cent grenades qu''il mit dans les chaînettes.
verses.am: እንደ ድሪ ያሉ ሰንሰለቶችንም ሠርቶ በአዕማዱ ራስ ላይ አደረጋቸው፤ መቶም ሮማኖች ሠርቶ በሰንሰለቱ ላይ አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.fr: Il dressa les colonnes sur le devant du temple, l''une à droite et l''autre à gauche; il nomma celle de droite Jakin, et celle de gauche Boaz.
verses.am: አዕማዶቹንም አንደኛውን በቀኝ፥ ሁለተኛውን በግራ በመቅደሱ ፊት አቆማቸው፤ በቀኝም የነበረውን ስም ያቁም በግራም የነበረውን ስም በለዝ ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.fr: Il fit un autel d''airain, long de vingt coudées, large de vingt coudées, et haut de dix coudées.
verses.am: ደግሞም ርዝመቱ ሀያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሀያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አሥር ክንድ የነበረውን የናሱን መሠዊያ ሠራ።

verses.en: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.fr: Il fit la mer de fonte. Elle avait dix coudées d''un bord à l''autre, une forme entièrement ronde, cinq coudées de hauteur, et une circonférence que mesurait un cordon de trente coudées.
verses.am: ከፈሰሰም ናስ ከዳር እስከ ዳር አሥር ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም አምስት ክንድ፥ በዙሪያውም ሠላሳ ክንድ የሆነ ክብ ኵሬ ሠራ።

verses.en: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.fr: Des figures de boeufs l''entouraient au-dessous de son bord, dix par coudée, faisant tout le tour de la mer; les boeufs, disposés sur deux rangs, étaient fondus avec elle en une seule pièce.
verses.am: በበታቹም ለአንድ ክንድ አሥር፥ ለአንድም ክንድ አሥር፥ ጕብጕቦች አዞረበት፤ ኵሬውም በቀለጠ ጊዜ ጕብጕቦቹ በሁለት ተራ ከእርሱ ጋር አብረው ቀልጠው ነበር።

verses.en: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.fr: Elle était posée sur douze boeufs, dont trois tournés vers le nord, trois tournés vers l''occident, trois tournés vers le midi, et trois tournés vers l''orient; la mer était sur eux, et toute la partie postérieure de leur corps était en dedans.
verses.am: በአሥራ ሁለትም በሬዎች ምስል ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ሦስቱ ወደ ሰሜን ሦስቱም ወደ ምዕራብ ሦስቱም ወደ ደቡብ ሦስቱም ወደ ምሥራቅ ይመለከቱ ነበር፤ ኵሬውም በላያቸው ነበር፥ የሁሉም ጀርባቸው በስተ ውስጥ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.fr: Son épaisseur était d''un palme; et son bord, semblable au bord d''une coupe, était façonné en fleur de lis. Elle pouvait contenir trois mille baths.
verses.am: ውፍረቱም አንድ ጋት ያህል ነበረ፤ ከንፈሩም አንደ ጽዋ ከንፈር፥ እንደ ሱፍ አበባ ሆኖ ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ሦስት ሺህም የባዶስ መሥፈሪያ ይይዝ ነበር።

verses.en: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.fr: Il fit dix bassins, et il en plaça cinq à droite et cinq à gauche, pour qu''ils servissent aux purifications: on y lavait les diverses parties des holocaustes. La mer était destinée aux ablutions des sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ደግሞም አሥር የመታጠቢያ ሰኖች ሠራ፥ ለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት የሚቀርበው ነገር ሁሉ ይታጠብባቸው ዘንድ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ አኖራቸው፤ ኵሬው ግን ካህናት ይታጠቡበት ነበር።

verses.en: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.fr: Il fit dix chandeliers d''or, selon l''ordonnance qui les concernait, et il les plaça dans le temple, cinq à droite et cinq à gauche.
verses.am: አሥሩንም መቅረዞች እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ከወርቅ ሠርቶ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.fr: Il fit dix tables, et il les plaça dans le temple, cinq à droite et cinq à gauche. Il fit cent coupes d''or.
verses.am: አሥሩንም ገበታዎች ሠርቶ አምስቱን በቀኝ፥ አምስቱንም በግራ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖራቸው። አንድ መቶም የወርቅ ድስቶች ሠራ።

verses.en: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.fr: Il fit le parvis des sacrificateurs, et le grand parvis avec ses portes, dont il couvrit d''airain les battants.
verses.am: ደግሞም የካህናቱን አደባባይ፥ ታላቁንም አደባባይ፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጆች ሠራ፥ ደጆቻቸውንም በናስ ለበጠ።

verses.en: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.fr: Il plaça la mer du côté droit, au sud-est.
verses.am: ኵሬውንም በቤቱ ቀኝ በአዜብ በኩል አኖረው።

verses.en: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
verses.fr: Huram fit les cendriers, les pelles et les coupes. Ainsi Huram acheva l''ouvrage que le roi Salomon lui fit faire pour la maison de Dieu:
verses.am: ኪራምም ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎቹን ድስቶቹንም ሠራ። ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።

verses.en: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.fr: deux colonnes, avec les deux chapiteaux et leurs bourrelets sur le sommet des colonnes; les deux treillis, pour couvrir les deux bourrelets des chapiteaux sur le sommet des colonnes;
verses.am: ሁለቱን አዕማድ፥ ጽዋዎቹንም፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለት ጕልላቶች፥ በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን የጕልላቶች ሁለቱን ጽዋዎች የሚሸፍኑትን ሁለቱን መርበቦች ሠራ።

verses.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.fr: les quatre cents grenades pour les deux treillis, deux rangées de grenades par treillis, pour couvrir les deux bourrelets des chapiteaux sur le sommet des colonnes;
verses.am: በአዕማዱም ላይ የነበሩትን ሁለቱን ጕልላቶች ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ፥ ለእያንዳንዱ መርበብ ሁለት ሁለት ተራ ሮማኖች፥ ለሁለቱ መርበቦች አራት መቶ ሮማኖች አደረገ።

verses.en: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.fr: les dix bases, et les dix bassins sur les bases;
verses.am: መቀመጫዎቹንና በመቀመጫዎቹ ላይ የሚቀመጡትን የመታጠቢያ ሰኖች፥

verses.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.fr: la mer, et les douze boeufs sous elle;
verses.am: አንዱንም ኵሬ፥ በበታቹም የሚሆኑትን አሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ሠራ።

verses.en: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.
verses.fr: les cendriers, les pelles et les fourchettes. Tous ces ustensiles que le roi Salomon fit faire à Huram-Abi pour la maison de l''Eternel étaient d''airain poli.
verses.am: ምንቸቶቹንም መጫሪያዎቹንም ሜንጦዎቹንም ዕቃቸውንም ሁሉ ኪራም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ከለስላሳ ናስ ሠራ።

verses.en: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.fr: Le roi les fit fondre dans la plaine du Jourdain, dans un sol argileux, entre Succoth et Tseréda.
verses.am: ንጉሡም በዮርዳኖስ ሜዳ በሱኮትና በጽሬዳ መካከል ባለው በወፍራሙ መሬት ውስጥ አስፈሰሰው።

verses.en: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.fr: Salomon fit tous ces ustensiles en si grande quantité que l''on ne vérifia pas le poids de l''airain.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም እነዚህን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ እጅግ አብዝቶ ሠራ፤ የናሱም ሚዛን አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.fr: Salomon fit encore tous les autres ustensiles pour la maison de Dieu: l''autel d''or; les tables sur lesquelles on mettait les pains de proposition;
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን ዕቃ ሁሉ የወርቁንም መሠዊያ፥ የገጹንም ኅብስት የነበረባቸውን ገበታዎች፥

verses.en: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.fr: les chandeliers et leurs lampes d''or pur, qu''on devait allumer selon l''ordonnance devant le sanctuaire,
verses.am: በቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ፊት እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ያበሩ ዘንድ መቅረዞችንና ቀንዲሎቻቸውን ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።

verses.en: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.fr: les fleurs, les lampes et les mouchettes d''or, d''or très pur;
verses.am: አበባዎቹንና ቀንዲሎቹን መኮስተሪያዎቹንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።

verses.en: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.fr: les couteaux, les coupes, les tasses et les brasiers d''or pur; et les battants d''or pour la porte de l''intérieur de la maison à l''entrée du lieu très saint, et pour la porte de la maison à l''entrée du temple.
verses.am: ጕጦቹንም ድስቶቹንም ጭልፋዎቹንም ማንደጃዎቹንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ። የውስጠኛውም ቤት የቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ደጆች የቤተ መቅደሱም ደጆች የወርቅ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
verses.fr: Ainsi fut achevé tout l''ouvrage que Salomon fit pour la maison de l''Eternel. Puis il apporta l''argent, l''or et tous les ustensiles que David, son père, avait consacrés, et il les mit dans les trésors de la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲሁም ሰሎሞን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ ተጨረሰ። አባቱም ዳዊት የቀደሰውን የብርና የወርቅ ዕቃ ሁሉ ሰሎሞን አምጥቶ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በነበረው ግምጃ ቤት አኖረው።

verses.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.fr: Alors Salomon assembla à Jérusalem les anciens d''Israël et tous les chefs des tribus, les chefs de famille des enfants d''Israël, pour transporter de la cité de David, qui est Sion, l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ከዳዊት ከተማ ከጽዮን ያወጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ሽማግሌዎችና የነገድ አለቆች ሁሉ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አባቶች ቤቶች መሳፍንት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
verses.fr: Tous les hommes d''Israël se réunirent auprès du roi pour la fête, qui se célébra le septième mois.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሰዎች ሁሉ በሰባተኛው ወር በበዓሉ ጊዜ ጊዜ ወደ ንጉሡ ተከማቹ።

verses.en: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
verses.fr: Lorsque tous les anciens d''Israël furent arrivés, les Lévites portèrent l''arche.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ መጡ፥ ሌዋውያንም ታቦቱን አነሡ።

verses.en: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.fr: Ils transportèrent l''arche, la tente d''assignation, et tous les ustensiles sacrés qui étaient dans la tente: ce furent les sacrificateurs et les Lévites qui les transportèrent.
verses.am: ታቦቱንም የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን በድኳኑም ውስጥ የነበረውን የተቀደሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አመጡ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ አመጡ።

verses.en: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon et toute l''assemblée d''Israël convoquée auprès de lui se tinrent devant l''arche. Ils sacrifièrent des brebis et des boeufs, qui ne purent être ni comptés, ni nombrés, à cause de leur multitude.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከእርሱም ጋር የተሰበሰቡ የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ በታቦቱ ፊት ሆነው ከብዛት የተነሣ የማይቈጠሩትንና የማይመጠኑትን በጎችና በሬዎች ይሠዉ ነበር።

verses.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs portèrent l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel à sa place, dans le sanctuaire de la maison, dans le lieu très saint, sous les ailes des chérubins.
verses.am: ካህናቱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት ወደ ቤቱ አምጥተው በቅድስት ቅዱሳን ውስጥ ከኪሩቤል ክንፍ በታች በነበረው በስፍራው አኖሩት።

verses.en: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.fr: Les chérubins avaient les ailes étendues sur la place de l''arche, et ils couvraient l''arche et ses barres par-dessus.
verses.am: ኪሩቤልም በታቦቱ ስፍራ ላይ ክንፎቻቸውን ዘርግተው ነበር፥ ኪሩቤልም ታቦቱንና መሎጊያዎቹን በስተ ላዩ በኩል ይሸፍኑ ነበር።

verses.en: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
verses.fr: On avait donné aux barres une longueur telle que leurs extrémités se voyaient à distance de l''arche devant le sanctuaire, mais ne se voyaient point du dehors. L''arche a été là jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: መሎጊያዎቹም ረጃጅሞች ነበሩና በቅዱስተ ቅዱሳን ፊት ከመቅደሱ ውስጥ ጫፎቻቸው ይታዩ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ከውጪ አይታዩም ነበር፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እዚያ አሉ።

verses.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il n''y avait dans l''arche que les deux tables que Moïse y plaça en Horeb, lorsque l''Eternel fit alliance avec les enfants d''Israël, à leur sortie d''Egypte.
verses.am: በታቦቱም ውስጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ባደረገ ጊዜ ሙሴ በኮሬብ ካስቀመጣቸው ከሁለቱ ጽላቶች በቀር ምንም አልነበረበትም።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
verses.fr: Au moment où les sacrificateurs sortirent du lieu saint, -car tous les sacrificateurs présents s''étaient sanctifiés sans observer l''ordre des classes,
verses.am: በዚያም የነበሩት ካህናት ሁሉ ተቀድሰው ነበር፥ በሰሞናቸውም አልተከፈሉም ነበር፤

verses.en: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
verses.fr: et tous les Lévites qui étaient chantres, Asaph, Héman, Jeduthun, leurs fils et leurs frères, revêtus de byssus, se tenaient à l''orient de l''autel avec des cymbales, des luths et des harpes, et avaient auprès d''eux cent vingt sacrificateurs sonnant des trompettes,
verses.am: መዘምራንም የነበሩት ሌዋውያን ሁሉ፥ አሳፍና ኤማን ኤዶታምም ልጆቻቸውም ወንድሞቻቸውም፥ ጥሩ በፍታ ለብሰው ጸናጽልና በገና መሰንቆም እየመቱ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ በመሥራቅ በኩል ቆመው ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር መቶ ሀያ ካህናት መለከት ይነፉ ነበር። ካህናቱም ከመቅደሱ በወጡ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the Lord;
verses.fr: et lorsque ceux qui sonnaient des trompettes et ceux qui chantaient, s''unissant d''un même accord pour célébrer et pour louer l''Eternel, firent retentir les trompettes, les cymbales et les autres instruments, et célébrèrent l''Eternel par ces paroles: Car il est bon, car sa miséricorde dure à toujours! en ce moment, la maison, la maison de l''Eternel fut remplie d''une nuée.
verses.am: መለከቱንም የሚነፉ መዘምራኑም በአንድነት ሆነው እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ። እግዚአብሔር ቸር ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ እያሉ በአንድ ቃል ድምፃቸውን ወደ ላይ ከፍ አድገው በመለከትና በጸናጽል በዜማም ዕቃ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ባመሰገኑ ጊዜ፥ ደመናው የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞላው።

verses.en: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs ne purent pas y rester pour faire le service, à cause de la nuée; car la gloire de l''Eternel remplissait la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበርና ካህናቱ ከደመናው የተነሣ መቆምና ማገልገል አልተቻላቸውም።

verses.en: Then said Solomon, The Lord hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.fr: Alors Salomon dit: L''Eternel veut habiter dans l''obscurité!
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም። እግዚአብሔር። በጨለማ ውስጥ እኖራለሁ ብሎአል፤

verses.en: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
verses.fr: Et moi, j''ai bâti une maison qui sera ta demeure, un lieu où tu résideras éternellement!
verses.am: እኔ ግን ለዘላለም ትኖርበት ዘንድ ማደሪያ ቤትን ሠራሁልህ አለ።

verses.en: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
verses.fr: Le roi tourna son visage, et bénit toute l''assemblée d''Israël; et toute l''assemblée d''Israël était debout.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ፊቱን ዘወር አድርጎ የእስራኤልን ጉባኤ ሁሉ መረቀ፤ የእስራኤልም ጉባኤ ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.fr: Et il dit: Béni soit l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, qui a parlé de sa bouche à David, mon père, et qui accomplit par sa puissance ce qu''il avait déclaré en disant:
verses.am: እርሱም አለ። ለአባቴ ለዳዊት በአፉ የተናገረ በእጁም የፈጸመ የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይባረክ፤

verses.en: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
verses.fr: Depuis le jour où j''ai fait sortir mon peuple du pays d''Egypte, je n''ai point choisi de ville parmi toutes les tribus d''Israël pour qu''il y fût bâti une maison où résidât mon nom, et je n''ai point choisi d''homme pour qu''il fût chef de mon peuple d''Israël;
verses.am: እርሱም። ሕዝቤን ከግብጽ ካወጣሁበት ቀን ጀምሮ ስሜ የሚጠራበት ቤት በዚያ ይሠራልኝ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ ማንኛውንም ከተማ አልመረጥሁም፤ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ ይሆን ዘንድ ማንንም አልመረጥሁም፤

verses.en: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
verses.fr: mais j''ai choisi Jérusalem pour que mon nom y résidât, et j''ai choisi David pour qu''il régnât sur mon peuple d''Israël!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ስሜ በዚያ እንዲጠራባት ኢየሩሳሌምን መርጫለሁ፥ በሕዝቤም በእስራኤል ላይ እንዲሆን ዳዊትን መርጫለሁ ብሎአልና።

verses.en: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: David, mon père, avait l''intention de bâtir une maison au nom de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: አባቴም ዳዊት ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ በልቡ አስቦ ነበር።

verses.en: But the Lord said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à David, mon père: Puisque tu as eu l''intention de bâtir une maison à mon nom, tu as bien fait d''avoir eu cette intention.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አባቴን ዳዊትን። ለስሜ ቤት ትሠራ ዘንድ በልብህ አስበሃልና ይህን በልብህ መልካም አደረግህ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.fr: Seulement, ce ne sera pas toi qui bâtiras la maison; mais ce sera ton fils, sorti de tes entrailles, qui bâtira la maison à mon nom.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከወገብህ የሚወጣው ልጅህ እርሱ ለስሜ ቤትን ይሠራል እንጂ ቤት የምትሠራልኝ አንተ አይደለህም አለው።

verses.en: The Lord therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel a accompli la parole qu''il avait prononcée. Je me suis élevé à la place de David, mon père, et je me suis assis sur le trône d''Israël, comme l''avait annoncé l''Eternel, et j''ai bâti la maison au nom de l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የተናገረውን ቃል ፈጸመ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ተስፋ እንደ ሰጠ በአባቴ በዳዊት ፋንታ ተነሣሁ፥ በእስራኤልም ዙፋን ላይ ተቀመጥሁ፥ ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ስም ቤት ሠራሁ።

verses.en: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, that he made with the children of Israel.
verses.fr: J''y ai placé l''arche où est l''alliance de l''Eternel, l''alliance qu''il a faite avec les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ጋር ያደረገው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ያለበትን ታቦት በዚያው ውስጥ አኖርሁ።

verses.en: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
verses.fr: Salomon se plaça devant l''autel de l''Eternel, en face de toute l''assemblée d''Israël, et il étendit ses mains.
verses.am: አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ወይም በምድር አንተን የሚመስል አምላክ የለም፤ በፍጹም ልባቸው በፊትህ ለሚሄዱ ባሪያዎችህ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥

verses.en: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven.
verses.fr: Car Salomon avait fait une tribune d''airain, et l''avait mise au milieu du parvis; elle était longue de cinq coudées, large de cinq coudées, et haute de trois coudées; il s''y plaça, se mit à genoux en face de toute l''assemblée d''Israël, et étendit ses mains vers le ciel.
verses.am: አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ወይም በምድር አንተን የሚመስል አምላክ የለም፤ በፍጹም ልባቸው በፊትህ ለሚሄዱ ባሪያዎችህ ቃል ኪዳንንና ምሕረትን የምትጠብቅ፥

verses.en: And said, O Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
verses.fr: Et il dit: O Eternel, Dieu d''Israël! Il n''y a point de Dieu semblable à toi, dans les cieux et sur la terre: tu gardes l''alliance et la miséricorde envers tes serviteurs qui marchent en ta présence de tout leur coeur!
verses.am: ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት የሰጠኸውን ተስፋ የጠበቀህ፤ በአፍህ ተናገርህ፥ ዛሬም እንደ ሆነው በእጅህ ፈጸምኸው።

verses.en: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
verses.fr: Ainsi tu as tenu parole à ton serviteur David, mon père; et ce que tu as déclaré de ta bouche, tu l''accomplis en ce jour par ta puissance.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ። አንተ በፊቴ እንደ ሄድህ ልጆችህ በሕጌ ይሄዱ ዘንድ መንገዳቸውን ቢጠብቁ በእስራኤል ዙፋን የሚቀመጥ ሰው በፊቴ አታጣም ብለህ ተስፋ የሰጠኸውን ለባሪያህ ለአባቴ ለዳዊት ጠብቅ።

verses.en: Now therefore, O Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel, Dieu d''Israël, observe la promesse que tu as faite à David, mon père, en disant: Tu ne manqueras jamais devant moi d''un successeur assis sur le trône d''Israël, pourvu que tes fils prennent garde à leur voie et qu''ils marchent dans ma loi comme tu as marché en ma présence.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ የእስራኤል አምላክ ሆይ፥ ለባሪያህ ለዳዊት የተናገረኸው ቃል ይጽና።

verses.en: Now then, O Lord God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
verses.fr: Qu''elle s''accomplisse donc, Eternel, Dieu d''Israël, la promesse que tu as faite à ton serviteur David!
verses.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ከሰው ጋር በምድር ላይ ይኖራልን? እነሆ፥ ሰማይ ከሰማያትም በላይ ያለ ሰማይ ይይዝህ ዘንድ አይችልም፤ ይልቁንስ እኔ የሠራሁት ቤት እንዴት ያንስ ይሆን?

verses.en: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.fr: Mais quoi! Dieu habiterait-il véritablement avec l''homme sur la terre? Voici, les cieux et les cieux des cieux ne peuvent te contenir: combien moins cette maison que j''ai bâtie!
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ አቤቱ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ወደ ባሪያህ ጸሎትና ልመና ተመልከት፥ ባሪያህም በፊትህ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎትና ጥሪውን ስማ።

verses.en: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
verses.fr: Toutefois, Eternel mon Dieu, sois attentif à la prière de ton serviteur et à sa supplication; écoute le cri et la prière que t''adresse ton serviteur.
verses.am: ባሪያህ ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልየውን ጸሎት ትሰማ ዘንድ። በዚያ ስሜ ይሆናል ወዳልኸው ስፍራ፥ ወደዚህ ቤት ዓይኖችህ ቀንና ሌሊት የተገለጡ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.fr: Que tes yeux soient jour et nuit ouverts sur cette maison, sur le lieu dont tu as dit que là serait ton nom! Ecoute la prière que ton serviteur fait en ce lieu.
verses.am: ባሪያህና ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ወደዚህ ስፍራ የሚጸልዩትን ልመና ስማ፤ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ ሰምተህም ይቅር በል።

verses.en: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
verses.fr: Daigne exaucer les supplications de ton serviteur et de ton peuple d''Israël, lorsqu''ils prieront en ce lieu! Exauce du lieu de ta demeure, des cieux, exauce et pardonne!
verses.am: ሰው ባልንጀራውን ቢበድል፥ በላዩም መሐላ ቢጫን፥ እርሱም መጥቶ በዚህ ቤት በመሠዊያህ ፊት ቢምል፥

verses.en: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un pèche contre son prochain et qu''on lui impose un serment pour le faire jurer, et s''il vient jurer devant ton autel, dans cette maison,
verses.am: በሰማይ ስማ፥ አድርግም፥ በባሪያዎችህም ላይ ዳኛ ሁን፥ በበደለኛውም ላይ ፍረድ፥ መንገዱንም በራሱ ላይ መልስበት፤ ንጹሑንም አጽድቀው፥ እንደ ጽድቁም ክፈለው።

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.fr: coute-le des cieux, agis, et juge tes serviteurs; condamne le coupable, et fais retomber sa conduite sur sa tête, rends justice à l''innocent, et traite-le selon son innocence!
verses.am: ሕዝብህም እስራኤል አንተን ስለ በደሉ በጠላት ፊት ድል ተመትተው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ በዚህም ቤት በፊትህ ቢጸልዩና ቢለምኑህ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፥

verses.en: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
verses.fr: Quand ton peuple d''Israël sera battu par l''ennemi, pour avoir péché contre toi; s''ils reviennent à toi et rendent gloire à ton nom, s''ils t''adressent des prières et des supplications dans cette maison,
verses.am: የሕዝብህንም የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፤ ለእነርሱም ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጥሃት ምድር መልሳቸው።

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
verses.fr: exauce-les des cieux, pardonne le péché de ton peuple d''Israël, et ramène-les dans le pays que tu as donné à eux et à leurs pères!
verses.am: አንተን ስለ በደሉ ሰማያት በተዘጉ ጊዜ ዝናብም ባልዘነበ ጊዜ፥ ወደዚህ ስፍራ ቢጸልዩ፥ ስምህንም ቢያከብሩ፥ ባስጨነቅሃቸውም ጊዜ ከኃጢአታቸው ቢመለሱ፥ አንተ በሰማይ ስማ፥

verses.en: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
verses.fr: Quand le ciel sera fermé et qu''il n''y aura point de pluie, à cause de leurs péchés contre toi; s''ils prient dans ce lieu et rendent gloire à ton nom, et s''ils se détournent de leurs péchés, parce que tu les auras châtiés;
verses.am: የባሪያዎችህንና የሕዝብህን የእስራኤልን ኃጢአት ይቅር በል፥ የሚሄዱበትንም መልካም መንገድ አሳያቸው፤ ለሕዝብህም ርስት አድርገህ ለሰጠሃት ምድር ዝናብን ስጥ።

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
verses.fr: exauce-les des cieux, pardonne le péché de tes serviteurs et de ton peuple d''Israël, à qui tu enseigneras la bonne voie dans laquelle ils doivent marcher, et fais venir la pluie sur la terre que tu as donnée pour héritage à ton peuple!
verses.am: በምድር ላይ ራብ ወይም ቸነፈር ወይም ዋግ ወይም አረማሞ ወይም አንበጣ ወይም ኩብኩባ ቢሆን፥ ጠላቶቻቸውም የአገሩን ከተሞች ከብበው ቢያስጨንቁአቸው፥ ማናቸውም መቅሠፍትና ደዌ ቢሆን፥

verses.en: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
verses.fr: Quand la famine, la peste, la rouille et la nielle, les sauterelles d''une espèce ou d''une autre, seront dans le pays, quand l''ennemi assiégera ton peuple dans son pays, dans ses portes, quand il y aura des fléaux ou des maladies quelconques;
verses.am: ማንም ሰው ወይም ሕዝብህ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ማናቸውም ሰው ሕመሙንና ኀዘኑን አውቆ ጸሎትና ልመና ቢያደርግ እጆቹንም ወደዚህ ቤት ቢዘረጋ፥

verses.en: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
verses.fr: si un homme, si tout ton peuple d''Israël fait entendre des prières et des supplications, et que chacun reconnaisse sa plaie et sa douleur et étende les mains vers cette maison,
verses.am: ከሕዝብህም ከእስራኤል ያልሆነ እንግዳ ስለ ታላቁ ስምህ ስለ ብርቱውም እጅህ ስለ ተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ከሩቅ አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ መጥቶም ወደዚህ ቤት በጸለየ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.fr: exauce-le des cieux, du lieu de ta demeure, et pardonne; rends à chacun selon ses voies, toi qui connais le coeur de chacun, car seul tu connais le coeur des enfants des hommes,
verses.am: ከሕዝብህም ከእስራኤል ያልሆነ እንግዳ ስለ ታላቁ ስምህ ስለ ብርቱውም እጅህ ስለ ተዘረጋውም ክንድህ ከሩቅ አገር በመጣ ጊዜ፥ መጥቶም ወደዚህ ቤት በጸለየ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
verses.fr: et ils te craindront pour marcher dans tes voies tout le temps qu''ils vivront dans le pays que tu as donné à nos pères!
verses.am: አንተ በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፤ የምድርም አሕዛብ ሁሉ ስምህን ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንደ ሕዝብህም እንደ እስራኤል ይፈሩህ ዘንድ፥ በዚህም በሠራሁት ቤት ስምህ እንደ ተጠራ ያውቁ ዘንድ፥ እንግዳው የሚለምንህን ሁሉ አድርግ።

verses.en: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.fr: Quand l''étranger, qui n''est pas de ton peuple d''Israël, viendra d''un pays lointain, à cause de ton grand nom, de ta main forte et de ton bras étendu, quand il viendra prier dans cette maison,
verses.am: ሕዝብህም ጠላቶቻቸውን ለመውጋት አንተ በምትልካቸው መንገድ ቢወጡ፥ አንተም ወደ መረጥሃት ወደዚህች ከተማ እኔም ለስምህ ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ለአንተ ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
verses.fr: exauce-le des cieux, du lieu de ta demeure, et accorde à cet étranger tout ce qu''il te demandera, afin que tous les peuples de la terre connaissent ton nom pour te craindre, comme ton peuple d''Israël, et sachent que ton nom est invoqué sur cette maison que j''ai bâtie!
verses.am: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው።

verses.en: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
verses.fr: Quand ton peuple sortira pour combattre ses ennemis, en suivant la voie que tu lui auras prescrite; s''ils t''adressent des prières, les regards tournés vers cette ville que tu as choisie et vers la maison que j''ai bâtie en ton nom,
verses.am: የማይበድል ሰው የለምና አንተን ቢበድሉ፥ ተቈጥተህም ለጠላት አሳልፈህ ብትሰጣቸው፥ ሩቅም ወይም ቅርብ ወደ ሆነ አገር ቢማርኩአቸው፥

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.fr: exauce des cieux leurs prières et leurs supplications, et fais-leur droit!
verses.am: በተማረኩበትም አገር ሆነው በልባቸው ንስሐ ቢገቡ፥ በምርኮአቸውም አገር ሳሉ ተመልሰው። ኃጢአት ሠርተናል፥ በድለንማል፥ ክፉም አድርገናል ብለው ቢለምኑህ፥

verses.en: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.fr: Quand ils pécheront contre toi, car il n''y a point d''homme qui ne pèche, quand tu seras irrité contre eux et que tu les livreras à l''ennemi, qui les emmènera captifs dans un pays lointain ou rapproché;
verses.am: በተማረኩበትም በምርኮአቸው አገር ሳሉ በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው ወደ አንተ ቢመለሱ፥ ለአባቶቻቸውም ወደ ሰጠሃት ወደ ምድራቸው ወደ መረጥሃትም ከተማ ለስምህም ወደ ሠራሁት ቤት ቢጸልዩ፥

verses.en: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
verses.fr: s''ils rentrent en eux-mêmes dans le pays où ils seront captifs, s''ils reviennent à toi et t''adressent des supplications dans le pays de leur captivité, et qu''ils disent: Nous avons péché, nous avons commis des iniquités, nous avons fait le mal!
verses.am: ጸሎታቸውንና ልመናቸውን በማደሪያህ በሰማይ ስማ፥ ፍርድንም አድርግላቸው፤ አንተንም የበደሉህን ሕዝብህን ይቅር በል።

verses.en: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
verses.fr: s''ils reviennent à toi de tout leur coeur et de toute leur âme, dans le pays de leur captivité où ils ont été emmenés captifs, s''ils t''adressent des prières, les regards tournés vers leur pays que tu as donné à leurs pères, vers la ville que tu as choisie et vers la maison que j''ai bâtie à ton nom,
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በዚህ ስፍራ ወደሚሆነው ጸሎት ዓይኖችህ የተገለጡ፥ ጆሮችህም የሚያደምጡ እንዲሆኑ እለምንሃለሁ።

verses.en: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
verses.fr: exauce des cieux, du lieu de ta demeure, leurs prières et leurs supplications, et fais-leur droit; pardonne à ton peuple ses péchés contre toi!
verses.am: አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከኃይልህ ታቦት ጋር ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሣ፤ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ካህናትህ ደኅንነትን ይልበሱ፤ ቅዱሳንህም በደስታ ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.fr: Maintenant, ô mon Dieu, que tes yeux soient ouverts, et que tes oreilles soient attentives à la prière faite en ce lieu!
verses.am: አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ የቀባኸውን ሰው ፊት አትመልስ ለባሪያም ለዳዊት ያደረግህለትን ምሕረት አስብ።

verses.en: Now therefore arise, O Lord God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.fr: Maintenant, Eternel Dieu, lève-toi, viens à ton lieu de repos, toi et l''arche de ta majesté! Que tes sacrificateurs, Eternel Dieu, soient revêtus de salut, et que tes bien-aimés jouissent du bonheur!
verses.am: ፤ አሁንም፥ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ከኃይልህ ታቦት ጋር ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሣ፤ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ ካህናትህ ደኅንነትን ይልበሱ፤ ቅዱሳንህም በደስታ ደስ ይበላቸው።

verses.en: O Lord God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
verses.fr: Eternel Dieu, ne repousse pas ton oint, souviens-toi des grâces accordées à David, ton serviteur!
verses.am: ፤ አቤቱ አምላክ ሆይ፥ የቀባኸውን ሰው ፊት አትመልስ ለባሪያም ለዳዊት ያደረግህለትን ምሕረት አስብ።

verses.en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
verses.fr: Lorsque Salomon eut achevé de prier, le feu descendit du ciel et consuma l''holocauste et les sacrifices, et la gloire de l''Eternel remplit la maison.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ጸሎቱን በፈጸመ ጊዜ እሳት ከሰማይ ወርዶ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ሌላ መሥዋዕቱን በላ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ቤቱን ሞላ።

verses.en: And the priests could not enter into the house of the Lord, because the glory of the Lord had filled the Lord's house.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs ne pouvaient entrer dans la maison de l''Eternel, car la gloire de l''Eternel remplissait la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሞልቶት ነበርና ካህናቱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መግባት አልቻሉም።

verses.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Tous les enfants d''Israël virent descendre le feu et la gloire de l''Eternel sur la maison; ils s''inclinèrent le visage contre terre sur le pavé, se prosternèrent et louèrent l''Eternel, en disant: Car il est bon, car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እሳቱ ሲወርድ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር በቤቱ ላይ ሲሆን ያዩ ነበር፤ በወለሉም ላይ በግምባራቸው ወደ ምድር ተደፍተው ሰገዱ። እርሱ መልካም ነውና፥ ምሕረቱም ለዘላለም ነውና ብለውም እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ።

verses.en: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord.
verses.fr: Le roi et tout le peuple offrirent des sacrifices devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon immola vingt-deux mille boeufs et cent vingt mille brebis. Ainsi le roi et tout le peuple firent la dédicace de la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ በሬዎችና መቶ ሀያ ሺህ በጎች ሠዋ። እንዲሁ ንጉሡና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ቀደሱ።

verses.en: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the Lord, which David the king had made to praise the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs se tenaient à leur poste, et les Lévites aussi avec les instruments faits en l''honneur de l''Eternel par le roi David pour le chant des louanges de l''Eternel, lorsque David les chargea de célébrer l''Eternel en disant: Car sa miséricorde dure à toujours! Les sacrificateurs sonnaient des trompettes vis-à-vis d''eux. Et tout Israël était là.
verses.am: ካህናቱም በየሥርዓታቸው፥ ሌዋውያኑም ደግሞ። ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚለውን የዳዊትን መዝሙር እየዘመሩ፥ ንጉሡ ዳዊት እግዚአብሔርን ለማመስገን የሠራውን የእግዚአብሔርን የዜማ ዕቃ ይዘው ቆመው ነበር፤ ካህናቱም በፊታቸው መለከት ይነፉ ነበር፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
verses.fr: Salomon consacra le milieu du parvis, qui est devant la maison de l''Eternel; car il offrit là les holocaustes et les graisses des sacrifices d''actions de grâces, parce que l''autel d''airain qu''avait fait Salomon ne pouvait contenir les holocaustes, les offrandes et les graisses.
verses.am: ሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የአደባባዩን ውስጥ ቀደሰ፤ ሰሎሞንም የሠራው የናስ መሠዊያ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን ስቡንም መያዝ አልቻለምና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ስብ በዚያ አቀረበ።

verses.en: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.
verses.fr: Salomon célébra la fête en ce temps-là pendant sept jours, et tout Israël avec lui; une grande multitude était venue depuis les environs de Hamath jusqu''au torrent d''Egypte.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከእርሱም ጋር እጅግ ታላቅ ጉባኤ የሆኑ፥ ከሐማት መግቢያ ጀምሮ እስከ ግብጽ ወንዝ ድረስ ያሉ እስራኤል ሁሉ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ ሰባት ቀን በዓል አደረጉ።

verses.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, ils eurent une assemblée solennelle; car ils firent la dédicace de l''autel pendant sept jours, et la fête pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀንም መሠዊያውን ቀድሰው፥ ሰባት ቀንም በዓል አድርገው ነበርና በስምንተኛው ቀን የተቀደሰውን ጉባኤ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the Lord had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
verses.fr: Le vingt-troisième jour du septième mois, Salomon renvoya dans ses tentes le peuple joyeux et content pour le bien que l''Eternel avait fait à David, à Salomon, et à Israël, son peuple.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ወር በሃያ ሦስተኛውም ቀን ሕዝቡን ወደ ድንኳናቸው አሰናበተ፤ እግዚአብሔር ለዳዊትና ለሰሎሞን ለሕዝቡም ለእስራኤል ስላደረገው ቸርነት ደስ ብሎአቸው ሐሴትን እያደረጉ ሄዱ።

verses.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the Lord, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
verses.fr: Lorsque Salomon eut achevé la maison de l''Eternel et la maison du roi, et qu''il eut réussi dans tout ce qu''il s''était proposé de faire dans la maison de l''Eternel et dans la maison du roi,
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት ጨረሰ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በራሱ ቤት ይሠራው ዘንድ በልቡ ያሰበውን ሁሉ አከናወነ።

verses.en: And the Lord appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
verses.fr: l''Eternel apparut à Salomon pendant la nuit, et lui dit: J''exauce ta prière, et je choisis ce lieu comme la maison où l''on devra m''offrir des sacrifices.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለሰሎሞን በሌሊት ተገልጦ እንዲህ አለው። ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፥ ይህንም ስፍራ ለራሴ ለመሥዋዕት ቤት መርጫለሁ።

verses.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
verses.fr: Quand je fermerai le ciel et qu''il n''y aura point de pluie, quand j''ordonnerai aux sauterelles de consumer le pays, quand j''enverrai la peste parmi mon peuple;
verses.am: ዝናብ እንዳይወርድ ሰማያቱን ብዘጋ፥ ወይም ምድሪቱን ይበላ ዘንድ አንበጣን ባዝዘው፥ ወይም በሕዝብ ላይ ቸነፈር ብሰድድ፥

verses.en: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
verses.fr: si mon peuple sur qui est invoqué mon nom s''humilie, prie, et cherche ma face, et s''il se détourne de ses mauvaises voies, -je l''exaucerai des cieux, je lui pardonnerai son péché, et je guérirai son pays.
verses.am: በስሜ የተጠሩት ሕዝቤ ሰውነታቸውን አዋርደው ቢጸልዩ፥ ፊቴንም ቢፈግሉ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ቢመለሱ፥ በሰማይ ሆኜ እሰማለሁ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቅር እላለሁ፥ ምድራቸውንም እፈውሳለሁ።

verses.en: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.fr: Mes yeux seront ouverts désormais, et mes oreilles seront attentives à la prière faite en ce lieu.
verses.am: አሁንም በዚህ ስፍራ ለሚጸለይ ጸሎት ዓይኖቼ ይገለጣሉ፥ ጆሮቼም ያደምጣሉ።

verses.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.fr: Maintenant, je choisis et je sanctifie cette maison pour que mon nom y réside à jamais, et j''aurai toujours là mes yeux et mon coeur.
verses.am: አሁንም ስሜ ለዘላለም በዚያ ይኖር ዘንድ ይህን ቤት መርጫለሁ ቀድሻለሁም፤ ዓይኖቼና ልቤም ዘወትር በዚያ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
verses.fr: Et toi, si tu marches en ma présence comme a marché David, ton père, faisant tout ce que je t''ai commandé, et si tu observes mes lois et mes ordonnances,
verses.am: አንተም ደግሞ አባትህ ዳዊት እንደ ሄደ በፊቴ ብትሄድ፥ እንዳዘዝሁህም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴንም ብትጠብቅ፥

verses.en: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.
verses.fr: j''affermirai le trône de ton royaume, comme je l''ai promis à David, ton père, en disant: Tu ne manqueras jamais d''un successeur qui règne en Israël.
verses.am: ከአባትህ ከዳዊት ጋር። በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ፥ የሚሆን ከዘርህ አይታጣም ብዬ ቃል ኪዳን እንዳደረግሁ የመንግሥትህን ዙፋን አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.fr: Mais si vous vous détournez, si vous abandonnez mes lois et mes commandements que je vous ai prescrits, et si vous allez servir d''autres dieux et vous prosterner devant eux,
verses.am: እናንተ ግን እኔን ከመከተል ብትመለሱ፥ የሰጠኋችሁንም ሥርዓቴንና ትእዛዜን ብትተዉ፥ ሄዳችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት ብታመልኩ ብትሰግዱላቸውም፥

verses.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
verses.fr: je vous arracherai de mon pays que je vous ai donné, je rejetterai loin de moi cette maison que j''ai consacrée à mon nom, et j''en ferai un sujet de sarcasme et de raillerie parmi tous les peuples.
verses.am: ለአባቶቻችሁ ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር እነቅላችኋለሁ፤ ለስሜም የቀደስሁትን ይህን ቤት ከፊቴ እጥለዋለሁ፥ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ መካከል ምሳሌና ተረት አደርገዋለሁ።

verses.en: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
verses.fr: Et si haut placée qu''ait été cette maison, quiconque passera près d''elle sera dans l''étonnement, et dira: Pourquoi l''Eternel a-t-il ainsi traité ce pays et cette maison?
verses.am: ከፍ ከፍ ብሎ የነበረውንም ይህን ቤት እያዩ በዚያ የሚያልፉ ሰዎች ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በዚህ አገርና በዚህ ቤት ስለ ምን እንዲህ አደረገ? ብለው ይደነቃሉ።

verses.en: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
verses.fr: Et l''on répondra: Parce qu''ils ont abandonné l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères, qui les a fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, parce qu''ils se sont attachés à d''autres dieux, se sont prosternés devant eux et les ont servis; voilà pourquoi il a fait venir sur eux tous ces maux.
verses.am: መልሰውም። ከግብጽ ምድር ያወጣቸውን የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ሌሎችን አማልክት ስለ ተከተሉ፥ ስለ ሰገዱላቸውም፥ ስለ አመለኩአቸውም፥ ስለዚህ ይህን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አመጣባቸው ይላሉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the Lord, and his own house,
verses.fr: Au bout de vingt ans, pendant lesquels Salomon bâtit la maison de l''Eternel et sa propre maison,
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የራሱን ቤት የሠራበት ሀያ ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
verses.fr: il reconstruisit les villes que lui donna Huram et y établit des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ኪራም ለሰሎሞን የሰጠውን ከተሞች ሰሎሞን ሠራቸው፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አኖረባቸው።

verses.en: And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.
verses.fr: Salomon marcha contre Hamath, vers Tsoba, et s''en empara.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ወደ ሐማትሱባ ሄደ አሸነፋትም።

verses.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
verses.fr: Il bâtit Thadmor au désert, et toutes les villes servant de magasins en Hamath.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳም ያለውን ተድሞርን፥ በሐማትም የሠራቸውን የዕቃ ቤቱን ከተሞች ሁሉ ሠራ።

verses.en: Also he built Bethhoron the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.fr: Il bâtit Beth-Horon la haute et Beth-Horon la basse, villes fortes, ayant des murs, des portes et des barres;
verses.am: ደግሞም ቅጥርና መዝጊያ መወርወሪያም የነበራቸውን የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ላይኛውን ቤትሖሮን ታችኛውንም ቤትሖሮን ሠራ።

verses.en: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
verses.fr: Baalath, et toutes les villes servant de magasins et lui appartenant, toutes les villes pour les chars, les villes pour la cavalerie, et tout ce qu''il plut à Salomon de bâtir à Jérusalem, au Liban, et dans tout le pays dont il était le souverain.
verses.am: ባዕላትንም፥ ለሰሎሞንም የነበሩትን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የሰረገላውንም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የፈረሰኞችንም ከተሞች፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም በሊባኖስም በመንግሥቱም ምድር ሁሉ ሰሎሞን ይሠራ ዘንድ የወደደውን ሁሉ ሠራ።

verses.en: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
verses.fr: Tout le peuple qui était resté des Héthiens, des Amoréens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens, ne faisant point partie d''Israël,
verses.am: ከኬጢያውያንም ከአሞራውያንም ከፌርዜያውያንም ከኤዊያውያንም ከኢያቡሳውያንም የቀሩትን ከእስራኤል ወገን ያልሆኑትን ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
verses.fr: leurs descendants qui étaient restés après eux dans le pays et que les enfants d''Israël n''avaient pas détruits, Salomon les leva comme gens de corvée, ce qu''ils ont été jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያላጠፉአቸውን፥ በኋላቸው በምድር ላይ የቀሩትን ልጆቻቸውን ሰሎሞን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ገባሮች አድርጎ መለመላቸው።

verses.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
verses.fr: Salomon n''employa comme esclave pour ses travaux aucun des enfants d''Israël; car ils étaient des hommes de guerre, ses chefs, ses officiers, les commandants de ses chars et de sa cavalerie.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለሥራው ከእስራኤል ልጆች ማንንም ባሪያ አላደረገም፤ እነርሱ ግን ሰልፈኞች፥ የሹማምቶችም አለቆች፥ የሰረገሎችና የፈረሰኞች ባልደራሶች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
verses.fr: Les chefs placés par le roi Salomon à la tête du peuple, et chargés de le surveiller, étaient au nombre de deux cent cinquante.
verses.am: እነዚህም በሕዝቡ ላይ ሠልጥነው የነበሩ የንጉሡ የሰሎሞን ዓይነተኞች አለቆች ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the Lord hath come.
verses.fr: Salomon fit monter la fille de Pharaon de la cité de David dans la maison qu''il lui avait bâtie; car il dit: Ma femme n''habitera pas dans la maison de David, roi d''Israël, parce que les lieux où est entrée l''arche de l''Eternel sont saints.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም። የእግዚአብሔር ታቦት የገባበት ስፍራ ቅዱስ ነውና ሚስቴ በእስራኤል ንጉሥ በዳዊት ቤት አትቀመጥም ሲል የፈርዖንን ልጅ ከዳዊት ከተማ ወደ ሠራላት ቤት አወጣት።

verses.en: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the Lord on the altar of the Lord, which he had built before the porch,
verses.fr: Alors Salomon offrit des holocaustes à l''Eternel sur l''autel de l''Eternel, qu''il avait construit devant le portique.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ሰሎሞን በወለሉ ፊት በሠራው በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አቀረበ።

verses.en: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.fr: Il offrait ce qui était prescrit par Moïse pour chaque jour, pour les sabbats, pour les nouvelles lunes, et pour les fêtes, trois fois l''année, à la fête des pains sans levain, à la fête des semaines, et à la fête des tabernacles.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንዳዘዘ እንደ ሥርዓታቸው በየቀኑ ሁሉ፥ በየሰንበታቱም፥ በየመባቻዎቹም፥ በየተወሰኑትም በዓላት፥ በየዓመቱ ሦስት ጊዜ በየቂጣው በዓልና በየሰባቱ ሱባዔ በዓል በየዳሱም በዓል ቍርባን ያቀርቡ ነበር።

verses.en: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
verses.fr: Il établit dans leurs fonctions, telles que les avait réglées David, son père, les classes des sacrificateurs selon leur office, les Lévites selon leur charge, consistant à célébrer l''Eternel et à faire jour par jour le service en présence des sacrificateurs, et les portiers distribués à chaque porte d''après leurs classes; car ainsi l''avait ordonné David, homme de Dieu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው ዳዊት እንዲህ አዝዞ ነበርና ካህናቱን እንደ አባቱ እንደ ዳዊት ሥርዓት በየአገልግሎታቸው ሰሞን ከፈላቸው፤ ሌዋውያንም እንደ ሥርዓታቸው ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ፥ በካህናቱም ፊት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ በየሰሞናቸው ከፈላቸው፤ በረኞቹንም ደግሞ በየበሩ ሁሉ በየሰሞናቸው ከፈላቸው።

verses.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.fr: On ne s''écarta point de l''ordre du roi pour les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, ni pour aucune chose, ni pour ce qui concernait les trésors.
verses.am: እነርሱም ንጉሡ ስለ ነገሩ ሁሉና ስለ መዝገቡ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ያዘዘውን ነገር ሁሉ አልተላለፉም።

verses.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, and until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was perfected.
verses.fr: Ainsi fut dirigée toute l''oeuvre de Salomon, jusqu''au jour où la maison de l''Eternel fut fondée et jusqu''à celui où elle fut terminée. La maison de l''Eternel fut donc achevée.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት መሠረት ከተጣለ ጀምሮ እስከ ተጨረሰ ድረስ የሰሎሞን ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ነበረ። የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.fr: Salomon partit alors pour Etsjon-Guéber et pour Eloth, sur les bords de la mer, dans le pays d''Edom.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የዚያን ጊዜ በኤዶምያስ ምድር በባሕር ዳር ወዳሉ ወደ ዔጽዮንጋብርና ወደ ኤሎት ሄደ።

verses.en: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.fr: Et Huram lui envoya par ses serviteurs des navires et des serviteurs connaissant la mer. Ils allèrent avec les serviteurs de Salomon à Ophir, et ils y prirent quatre cent cinquante talents d''or, qu''ils apportèrent au roi Salomon.
verses.am: ኪራምም መርከቦችንና የባሕርን ነገር የሚያውቁትን መርከበኞች በባሪያዎቹ እጅ ሰደደለት፤ እነርሱም ከሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ጋር ወደ ኦፊር መጡ፥ ከዚያም አራት መቶ አምሳ መክሊት ወርቅ ወስደው ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሰሎሞን አመጡ።

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.fr: La reine de Séba apprit la renommée de Salomon, et elle vint à Jérusalem pour l''éprouver par des énigmes. Elle avait une suite fort nombreuse, et des chameaux portant des aromates, de l''or en grande quantité et des pierres précieuses. Elle se rendit auprès de Salomon, et elle lui dit tout ce qu''elle avait dans le coeur.
verses.am: የሳባም ንግሥት የሰሎሞንን ዝና በሰማች ጊዜ በግመሎች ላይ ሽቱና ብዙ ወርቅ የከበረም ዕንቍ አስጭና ከታላቅ ጓዝ ጋር ሰሎሞንን በኢየሩሳሌም በእንቆቅልሽ ትፈትነው ዘንድ መጣች፤ ወደ ሰሎሞንም በገባች ጊዜ በልብዋ ያለውን ሁሉ አጫወተችው።

verses.en: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
verses.fr: Salomon répondit à toutes ses questions, et il n''y eut rien que Salomon ne sût lui expliquer.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም የጠየቀችውን ሁሉ ፈታላት፤ ሰሎሞንም ያልፈታው ስውር ነገር አልነበረም።

verses.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.fr: La reine de Séba vit la sagesse de Salomon, et la maison qu''il avait bâtie,
verses.am: የሳባም ንግሥት የሰሎሞንን ጥበብ፥ ሠርቶትም የነበረውን ቤት፥ የማዕዱንም መብል፥

verses.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.
verses.fr: et les mets de sa table, et la demeure de ses serviteurs, et les fonctions et les vêtements de ceux qui le servaient, et ses échansons et leurs vêtements, et les degrés par lesquels on montait à la maison de l''Eternel. Hors d''elle-même,
verses.am: የብላቴኖቹንም አቀማመጥ፥ የሎሌዎቹንም አሠራር አለባበሳቸውንም፥ ጠጅ አሳላፊዎቹንም አለባበሳቸውንም በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የሚያሳርገውን መሥዋዕት ባየች ጊዜ መንፈስ አልቀረላትም።

verses.en: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
