verses.fr: elle dit au roi: C''était donc vrai ce que j''ai appris dans mon pays au sujet de ta position et de ta sagesse!
verses.am: ንጉሡንም አለችው። ስለ ነገርህና ስለ ጥበብህ በአገሬ ሳለሁ የሰማሁት ዝና እውነት ነው።

verses.en: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.fr: Je ne croyais pas ce qu''on en disait, avant d''être venue et d''avoir vu de mes yeux. Et voici, on ne m''a pas raconté la moitié de la grandeur de ta sagesse. Tu surpasses ce que la renommée m''a fait connaître.
verses.am: እኔ ግን መጥቼ በዓይኔ እስካየሁ ድረስ የነገሩኝን አላመንሁም፤ እነሆ፥ የጥበብህን ታላቅነት እኵሌታ አልነገሩኝም፤ ከሰማሁት ዝና ትበልጣለህ።

verses.en: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
verses.fr: Heureux tes gens, heureux tes serviteurs, qui sont continuellement devant toi et qui entendent ta sagesse!
verses.am: በፊትህ ሁልጊዜ የሚቆሙ ጥበብህንም የሚሰሙ ሰዎችህና እነዚህ ባሪያዎችህ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the Lord thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
verses.fr: Béni soit l''Eternel, ton Dieu, qui t''a accordé la faveur de te placer sur son trône comme roi pour l''Eternel, ton Dieu! C''est parce que ton Dieu aime Israël et veut le faire subsister à toujours, qu''il t''a établi roi sur lui pour que tu fasses droit et justice.
verses.am: በአምላክህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ንጉሥ እንድትሆን በዙፋኑ ላይ ያስቀምጥህ ዘንድ የወደደህ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ብሩክ ይሁን፤ አምላክህ እስራኤልን ለዘላለም ያጸናቸው ዘንድ ወድዶአቸዋልና ስለዚህ ፍርድና ጽድቅ ታደርግ ዘንድ በላያቸው አነገሠህ።

verses.en: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
verses.fr: Elle donna au roi cent vingt talents d''or, une très grande quantité d''aromates et des pierres précieuses. Il n''y eut plus d''aromates tels que ceux donnés au roi Salomon par la reine de Séba.
verses.am: ለንጉሡም መቶ ሀያ መክሊት ወርቅ፥ እጅግም ብዙ ሽቱ የከበረም ዕንቍ ሰጠችው፤ የሳባም ንግሥት ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን እንደ ሰጠችው ያለ ሽቱ ከቶ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.fr: Les serviteurs de Huram et les serviteurs de Salomon, qui apportèrent de l''or d''Ophir, amenèrent aussi du bois de sandal et des pierres précieuses.
verses.am: ከኦፊርም ወርቅ ያመጡ የኪራም ባሪያዎችና የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች የሰንደል እንጨትና የከበረ ዕንቍ ደግሞ አመጡ።

verses.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the Lord, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
verses.fr: Le roi fit avec le bois de sandal des escaliers pour la maison de l''Eternel et pour la maison du roi, et des harpes et des luths pour les chantres. On n''en avait pas vu de semblable auparavant dans le pays de Juda.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ከሰንደሉ እንጨት ለእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ለንጉሡ ቤት ደርብ፥ ለመዘምራኑም መሰንቆና በገና አደረገ፤ እንደዚህም ያለ በይሁዳ ምድር ከቶ አልታየም ነበር።

verses.en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon donna à la reine de Séba tout ce qu''elle désira, ce qu''elle demanda, plus qu''elle n''avait apporté au roi. Puis elle s''en retourna et alla dans son pays, elle et ses serviteurs.
verses.am: የሳባም ንግሥት ወደ ንጉሡ ካመጣችው የሚበልጥ፥ ንጉሡ ሰሎሞን የወደደችውን ሁሉ ከእርሱም የለመነችውን ሁሉ ሰጣት፤ እርስዋም ተመልሳ ከባሪያዎችዋ ጋር ወደ ምድርዋ ሄደች።

verses.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
verses.fr: Le poids de l''or qui arrivait chaque année à Salomon était de six cent soixante-six talents d''or,
verses.am: ነጋድራሶችና ነጋዴዎች ካመጡለት ሌላ በየዓመቱ ወደ ሰሎሞን የሚመጣ የወርቅ ሚዛን ስድስት መቶ ስድሳ ስድስት መክሊት ወርቅ ነበረ።

verses.en: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.fr: outre ce qu''il retirait des négociants et des marchands qui en apportaient, de tous les rois d''Arabie et des gouverneurs du pays, qui apportaient de l''or et de l''argent à Salomon.
verses.am: የዓረብም ነገሥታት ሁሉ የምድሩም ሹማምት ወርቅና ብር ወደ ሰሎሞን ያመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon fit deux cents grands boucliers d''or battu, pour chacun desquels il employa six cents sicles d''or battu,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን በጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ሁለት መቶ አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻ ውስጥ የገባው ጥፍጥፍ ወርቅ ስድስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.fr: et trois cents autres boucliers d''or battu, pour chacun desquels il employa trois cents sicles d''or; et le roi les mit dans la maison de la forêt du Liban.
verses.am: ከጥፍጥም ወርቅ ሦስት መቶ ጋሻ አሠራ፤ በአንዱም ጋሻ የገባው ወርቅ ሦስት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ፤ ንጉሡም የሊባኖስ ዱር በተባለው ቤት ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.fr: Le roi fit un grand trône d''ivoire, et le couvrit d''or pur.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ደግሞ ከዘሆን ጥርስ ታላቅ ዙፋን አሠራ፥ በጥሩ ወርቅም ለበጠው።

verses.en: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
verses.fr: Ce trône avait six degrés, et un marchepied d''or attenant au trône; il y avait des bras de chaque côté du siège; deux lions étaient près des bras,
verses.am: ከዙፋኑም ጋር ተጋጥመው ወደ ዙፋኑም የሚያስሄዱ ስድስት እርከኖች ነበሩ፤ የወርቅ ብርኩማም ነበረ፤ በዚህና በዚያም በመቀመጫው፤ አጠገብ ሁለት የክንድ መደገፊያዎች ነበሩበት፥ በመደገፊያዎችም አጠገብ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.fr: et douze lions sur les six degrés de part et d''autre. Il ne s''est rien fait de pareil pour aucun royaume.
verses.am: በስድስቱም እርከኖች ላይ በዚህና በዚያ አሥራ ሁለት አንበሶች ቆመው ነበር፤ በመንግሥታት ሁሉ እንዲህ ያለ ሥራ አልተሠራም።

verses.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.fr: Toutes les coupes du roi Salomon étaient d''or, et toute la vaisselle de la maison de la forêt du Liban était d''or pur. Rien n''était d''argent: on n''en faisait aucun cas du temps de Salomon.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን የሚጠጣበት ዕቃ ሁሉ የወርቅ ነበረ፥ የሊባኖስ ዱር በተባለውም ቤቱ የነበረው ዕቃ ሁሉ ጥሩ ወርቅ ነበረ፤ በሰሎሞን ዘመን ብር ከቶ አይቈጠርም ነበር።

verses.en: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.fr: Car le roi avait des navires de Tarsis naviguant avec les serviteurs de Huram; et tous les trois ans arrivaient les navires de Tarsis, apportant de l''or et de l''argent, de l''ivoire, des singes et des paons.
verses.am: ለንጉሡም ከኪራም ባሪያዎች ጋር ወደ ተርሴስ የሚሄዱ መርከቦች ነበሩት፤ በሦስት በሦስት ዓመትም አንድ ጊዜ የተርሴስ መርከቦች ወርቅና ብር የዘሆንም ጥርስ ዝንጀሮና ዝጕርጕር ወፍም ይዘው ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.fr: Le roi Salomon fut plus grand que tous les rois de la terre par les richesses et par la sagesse.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሰሎሞን ከምድር ነገሥታት ሁሉ በባለጠግነትና በጥበብ በለጠ።

verses.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
verses.fr: Tous les rois de la terre cherchaient à voir Salomon, pour entendre la sagesse que Dieu avait mise dans son coeur.
verses.am: የምድርም ነገሥታት ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በልቡ ያኖረውን ጥበቡን ይሰሙ ዘንድ የሰሎሞንን ፊት ሊያዩ ይመኙ ነበር።

verses.en: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.fr: Et chacun d''eux apportait son présent, des objets d''argent et des objets d''or, des vêtements, des armes, des aromates, des chevaux et des mulets; et il en était ainsi chaque année.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ገጸ በረከቱን፥ የወርቅንና የብርን ዕቃ፥ ልብስንና የጦር መሣሪያን፥ ሽቱውንም፥ ፈረሶችንና በቅሎችን እየያዘ በየዓመቱ ያመጣ ነበር።

verses.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Salomon avait quatre mille crèches pour les chevaux destinés à ses chars, et douze mille cavaliers qu''il plaça dans les villes où il tenait ses chars et à Jérusalem près du roi.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ለፈረሶችና ለሰረገሎች አራት ሺህ ጋጥ፥ አሥራ ሁለት ሺህም ፈረሰኞች ነበሩት፥ በሰረገሎችም ከተሞች፥ ከንጉሡም ጋር በኢየሩሳሌም አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.fr: Il dominait sur tous les rois, depuis le fleuve jusqu''au pays des Philistins et jusqu''à la frontière d''Egypte.
verses.am: ከኤፍራጥስም ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ፍልስጥኤም ምድርና እስከ ግብጽ ዳርቻ ድረስ ባሉ ነገሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
verses.fr: Le roi rendit l''argent aussi commun à Jérusalem que les pierres, et les cèdres aussi nombreux que les sycomores qui croissent dans la plaine.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ብሩን በኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ድንጋይ እንዲበዛ አደረገው፤ የዝግባውንም እንጨት ብዛት በቈላ እንደሚበቅል ሾላ አደረገው።

verses.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
verses.fr: C''était de l''Egypte et de tous les pays que l''on tirait des chevaux pour Salomon.
verses.am: ለሰሎሞንም ፈረሶች ከግብጽና ከየአገሩ ሁሉ ያመጡለት ነበር።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Salomon, les premières et les dernières, cela n''est-il pas écrit dans le livre de Nathan, le prophète, dans la prophétie d''Achija de Silo, et dans les révélations de Jéedo, le prophète sur Jéroboam, fils de Nebath?
verses.am: የቀረውም ፊተኛውና ኋለኛው የሰሎሞን ነገር በነቢዩ በናታን ታሪክ፥ በሴሎናዊውም በኦሒያ ትንቢት፥ ስለ ናባጥም ልጅ ስለ ኢዮርብዓም ባየው በባለ ራእዩ በአዶ ራእይ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?

verses.en: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.fr: Salomon régna quarante ans à Jérusalem sur tout Israël.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም በኢየሩሳሌም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Puis Salomon se coucha avec ses pères, et on l''enterra dans la ville de David, son père. Et Roboam, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ሰሎሞንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ሮብዓም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
verses.fr: Roboam se rendit à Sichem, car tout Israël était venu à Sichem pour le faire roi.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ወደ ሴኬም መጥተው ነበርና ሮብዓም ወደ ሴኬም ሄደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.fr: Lorsque Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, eut des nouvelles, il était en Egypte, où il s''était enfui loin du roi Salomon, et il revint d''Egypte.
verses.am: የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓምም ከንጉሡ ከሰሎሞን ፊት ሸሽቶ በግብጽ ይኖር ነበርና ይህን በሰማ ጊዜ ኢዮርብዓም ከግብጽ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.fr: On l''envoya appeler. Alors Jéroboam et tout Israël vinrent vers Roboam et lui parlèrent ainsi:
verses.am: ልከውም ጠሩት፤ ኢዮርብዓምና እስራኤልም ሁሉ መጥተው ሮብዓምን።

verses.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
verses.fr: Ton père a rendu notre joug dur; maintenant allège cette rude servitude et le joug pesant que nous a imposé ton père. Et nous te servirons.
verses.am: አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብን ነበር፤ አሁንም አንተ ጽኑውን የአባትህን አገዛዝ፥ በላያችንም የጫነውን የከበደውን ቀንበር አቅልልልን፥ እኛም እንገዛልሃለን ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Revenez vers moi dans trois jours. Et le peuple s''en alla.
verses.am: እርሱም። ከሦስት ቀን በኋላ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ አላቸው። ሕዝቡም ሄዱ።

verses.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
verses.fr: Le roi Roboam consulta les vieillards qui avaient été auprès de Salomon, son père, pendant sa vie, et il dit: Que conseillez-vous de répondre à ce peuple?
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ እመልስለት ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? ብሎ አባቱ ሰሎሞን በሕይወት ሳለ በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
verses.fr: Et voici ce qu''ils lui dirent: Si tu es bon envers ce peuple, si tu les reçois favorablement, et si tu leur parles avec bienveillance, ils seront pour toujours tes serviteurs.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ለዚህ ሕዝብ ቸርነት ብታደርግላቸው፥ ደስም ብታሰኛቸው፥ በገርነትም ብትናገራቸው፥ ለዘላለም ባሪያዎች ይሆኑልሃል ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
verses.fr: Mais Roboam laissa le conseil que lui donnaient les vieillards, et il consulta les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui et qui l''entouraient.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ሽማግሌዎች የመከሩትን ነገር ትቶ ከእርሱ ጋር ካደጉትና በፊቱ ይቆሙ ከነበሩት ብላቴኖች ጋር ተማከረ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Que conseillez-vous de répondre à ce peuple qui me tient ce langage: Allège le joug que nous a imposé ton père?
verses.am: እርሱም። አባትህ የጫነብንን ቀንበር አቅልልልን ለሚሉኝ ሕዝብ እመልስላቸው ዘንድ የምትመክሩኝ ምንድር ነው? አላቸው።

verses.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
verses.fr: Et voici ce que lui dirent les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui: Tu parleras ainsi à ce peuple qui t''a tenu ce langage: Ton père a rendu notre joug pesant, et toi, allège-le-nous! tu leur parleras ainsi: Mon petit doigt est plus gros que les reins de mon père.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ያደጉት ብላቴኖች። አባትህ ቀንበር አክብዶብን ነበር፥ አንተ ግን አቅልልልን ለሚሉህ ሕዝብ። ታናሽቱ ጣቴ ከአባቴ ወገብ ትወፍራለች፤

verses.en: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.fr: Maintenant, mon père vous a chargés d''un joug pesant, et moi je vous le rendrai plus pesant; mon père vous a châtiés avec des fouets, et moi je vous châtierai avec des scorpions.
verses.am: አሁንም አባቴ ከባድ ቀንበር ጭኖባችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በቀንበራችሁ ላይ እጨምራለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ በላቸው ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
verses.fr: Jéroboam et tout le peuple vinrent à Roboam le troisième jour, suivant ce qu''avait dit le roi: Revenez vers moi dans trois jours.
verses.am: ንጉሡም። በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ ብሎ እንደ ተናገረ ኢዮርብዓምና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በሦስተኛው ቀን ወደ ሮብዓም መጡ።

verses.en: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.fr: Le roi leur répondit durement. Le roi Roboam laissa le conseil des vieillards,
verses.am: ንጉሡም ጽኑ ምላሽ መለሰላቸው፤ ንጉሡም ሮብዓም የሽማግሌዎቹን ምክር ትቶ።

verses.en: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.fr: et leur parla ainsi d''après le conseil des jeunes gens: Mon père a rendu votre joug pesant, et moi je le rendrai plus pesant; mon père vous a châtiés avec des fouets, et moi je vous châtierai avec des scorpions.
verses.am: አባቴ ቀንበር አክብዶባችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን እጨምርበታለሁ፤ አባቴ በአለንጋ ገርፎአችሁ ነበር፥ እኔ ግን በጊንጥ እገርፋችኋለሁ ብሎ እንደ ብላቴኖቹ ምክር ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the Lord might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.fr: Ainsi le roi n''écouta point le peuple; car cela fut dirigé par Dieu, en vue de l''accomplissement de la parole que l''Eternel avait dite par Achija de Silo à Jéroboam, fils de Nebath.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሴሎናዊው በአሒያ አድርጎ ለናባጥ ልጅ ለኢዮርብዓም የተናገረውን ቃል እንዲያጸና ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ተወስኖ ነበርና ንጉሡ ሕዝቡን አልሰማም።

verses.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
verses.fr: Lorsque tout Israël vit que le roi ne l''écoutait pas, le peuple répondit au roi: Quelle part avons-nous avec David? Nous n''avons point d''héritage avec le fils d''Isaï! A tes tentes, Israël! Maintenant, pourvois à ta maison, David! Et tout Israël s''en alla dans ses tentes.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ሁሉ ንጉሡ እንዳልሰማቸው ባዩ ጊዜ ሕዝቡ። በዳዊት ዘንድ ምን ክፍል አለን? በእሴይም ልጅ ዘንድ ርስት የለንም፤ እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ወደ እየድንኳኖቻችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ዳዊት ሆይ፥ አሁን ቤትህን ተመልከት ብለው ለንጉሡ መለሱለት። እስራኤልም ሁሉ ወደ እየድንኳኖቻቸው ሄዱ።

verses.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël qui habitaient les villes de Juda furent les seuls sur qui régna Roboam.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ከተሞች በተቀመጡት በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ግን ሮብዓም ነገሠባቸው።

verses.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Alors le roi Roboam envoya Hadoram, qui était préposé aux impôts. Mais Hadoram fut lapidé par les enfants d''Israël, et il mourut. Et le roi Roboam se hâta de monter sur un char, pour s''enfuir à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም አስገባሪውን አዶራምን ሰደደ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በድንጋይ ወገሩት፥ ሞተም፤ ንጉሡም ሮብዓም ፈጥኖ ወደ ሰረገላው ወጣ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ሸሸ።

verses.en: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''Israël s''est détaché de la maison de David jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: እስራኤልም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ከዳዊት ቤት ሸፈተ።

verses.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.fr: Roboam, arrivé à Jérusalem, rassembla la maison de Juda et de Benjamin, cent quatre-vingt mille hommes d''élite propres à la guerre, pour qu''ils combattissent contre Israël afin de le ramener sous la domination de Roboam.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በመጣ ጊዜ እስራኤልን ወግተው መንግሥቱን ወደ ሮብዓም ይመልሱ ዘንድ ከይሁዳና ከብንያም ቤት የተመረጡትን አንድ መቶ ሰማንያ ሺህ ሰልፈኞች ሰዎች ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.fr: Mais la parole de l''Eternel fut ainsi adressée à Schemaeja, homme de Dieu:
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሰው ወደ ሸማያ እንዲህ ሲል መጣ።

verses.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.fr: Parle à Roboam, fils de Salomon, roi de Juda, et à tout Israël en Juda et en Benjamin. Et dis-leur:
verses.am: ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም፥ በይሁዳና በብንያምም ላሉት ለእስራኤል ሁሉ።

verses.en: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the Lord, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.fr: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Ne montez point, et ne faites pas la guerre à vos frères! Que chacun de vous retourne dans sa maison, car c''est de par moi que cette chose est arrivée. Ils obéirent aux paroles de l''Eternel, et ils s''en retournèrent, renonçant à marcher contre Jéroboam.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ይህ ነገር ከእኔ ዘንድ ነውና አትውጡ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁንም አትውጉ፤ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ ብለህ ንገራቸው። የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ሰሙ፥ በኢዮርብዓምም ላይ ከመሄድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.fr: Roboam demeura à Jérusalem, et il bâtit des villes fortes en Juda.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጠ፥ በይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ሠራ።

verses.en: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.fr: Il bâtit Bethléhem, Etham, Tekoa,
verses.am: በይሁዳና በብንያም ያሉትንም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች፥ ቤተ ልሔም፥ ኤጣምን፥ ቴቁሔን፥

verses.en: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.fr: Beth-Tsur, Soco, Adullam,
verses.am: ቤትጹርን፥ ሦኮን፥ ዓዶላምን፥ ጌትን፥ መሪሳን፥

verses.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.fr: Gath, Maréscha, Ziph,
verses.am: ቤትጹርን፥ ሦኮን፥ ዓዶላምን፥ ጌትን፥ መሪሳን፥

verses.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.fr: Adoraïm, Lakis, Azéka,
verses.am: ዚፍን፥ አዶራይምን፥ ለኪሶን፥ ዓዜቃን፥

verses.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.fr: Tsorea, Ajalon et Hébron, qui étaient en Juda et en Benjamin, et il en fit des villes fortes.
verses.am: ጾርዓን፥ ኤሎንን፥ ኬብሮንን፥ ሠራ።

verses.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.fr: Il les fortifia, et y établit des commandants, et des magasins de vivres, d''huile et de vin.
verses.am: ምሽጎቹንም አጠነከረ፥ አለቆችንም አኖረባቸው፥ ምግቡንም ዘይቱንም የወይን ጠጁንም አከማቸባቸው።

verses.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.fr: Il mit dans chacune de ces villes des boucliers et des lances, et il les rendit très fortes. Juda et Benjamin étaient à lui.
verses.am: በከተሞቹ ሁሉ ጋሻና ጦርን አኖረ። ከተሞቹንም እጅግ አጠነከራቸው፤ ይሁዳና ብንያምም የእርሱ ወገን ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs et les Lévites qui se trouvaient dans tout Israël quittèrent leurs demeures pour se rendre auprès de lui;
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ዘንድ የነበሩ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን ከየአገራቸው ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ።

verses.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the Lord:
verses.fr: car les Lévites abandonnèrent leurs banlieues et leurs propriétés et vinrent en Juda et à Jérusalem, parce que Jéroboam et ses fils les empêchèrent de remplir leurs fonctions comme sacrificateurs de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ካህናት እንዳይሆኑ ኢዮርብዓምና ልጆቹ አስለቅቀዋቸው ነበርና ሌዋውያን መሰመሪያቸውንና ቦታቸውን ትተው ወደ ይሁዳና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.fr: Jéroboam établit des sacrificateurs pour les hauts lieux, pour les boucs, et pour les veaux qu''il avait faits.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ለኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ለአጋንንቱም ለሠራቸውም እምቦሶች ካህናትን አቆመ።

verses.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.fr: Ceux de toutes les tribus d''Israël qui avaient à coeur de chercher l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, suivirent les Lévites à Jérusalem pour sacrifier à l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères.
verses.am: ደግሞም ለአባቶቻቸው አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዉ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ነገድ ሁሉ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ለመፈለግ ልባቸውን የሰጡ ሁሉ እነርሱን ተከትለው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.fr: Ils donnèrent ainsi de la force au royaume de Juda, et affermirent Roboam, fils de Salomon, pendant trois ans; car ils marchèrent pendant trois ans dans la voie de David et de Salomon.
verses.am: ሦስት ዓመት በዳዊትና በሰሎሞን መንገድ ይሄዱ ነበርና ሦስት ዓመት የይሁዳን መንግሥት አበረቱ፥ የሰሎሞንንም ልጅ ሮብዓምን አጸኑ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.fr: Roboam prit pour femme Mahalath, fille de Jerimoth, fils de David et d''Abichaïl, fille d''Eliab, fils d''Isaï.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም መሐላትን አገባ፤ አባትዋ የዳዊት ልጅ ኢያሪሙት ነበረ፤ እናትዋም የእሴይ ልጅ የኤልያብ ልጅ አቢካኢል ነበረች።

verses.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.fr: Elle lui enfanta des fils: Jeusch, Schemaria et Zaham.
verses.am: እርስዋም የዑስን፥ ሰማራያን፥ ዘሃምን ወንዶች ልጆች ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.fr: Après elle, il prit Maaca, fille d''Absalom. Elle lui enfanta Abija, Attaï, Ziza et Schelomith.
verses.am: ከእርስዋም በኋላ የአቤሴሎምን ልጅ መዓካን አገባ፤ እርስዋም አብያን፥ ዓታይን፥ ዚዛን፥ ሰሎሚትን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.fr: Roboam aimait Maaca, fille d''Absalom, plus que toutes ses femmes et ses concubines; car il eut dix-huit femmes et soixante concubines, et il engendra vingt-huit fils et soixante filles.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም ከሚስቶቹና ከቁባቶቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ የአቤሴሎምን ልጅ መዓካን ወደደ፤ አሥራ ስምንትም ሚስቶችና ስድሳ ቁባቶች ነበሩት፥ ሀያ ስምንት ወንዶችና ስድሳ ሴቶች ልጆች ወለደ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.fr: Roboam donna le premier rang à Abija, fils de Maaca, et l''établit chef parmi ses frères, car il voulait le faire roi.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም ንጉሥ ያደርገው ዘንድ አስቦአልና የመዓካን ልጅ አብያን በወንድሞቹ ላይ አለቃ አድርጎ ሾመው።

verses.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.fr: Il agit avec habileté en dispersant tous ses fils dans toutes les contrées de Juda et de Benjamin, dans toutes les villes fortes; il leur fournit des vivres en abondance, et demanda pour eux une multitude de femmes.
verses.am: ተጠበበም፥ ልጆቹንም ሁሉ በይሁዳና በብንያም አገር ሁሉ በምሽጉ ከተሞች ሁሉ ከፋፈላቸው፤ ብዙም ምግብ ሰጣቸው፤ ብዙም ሚስቶች ፈለገላቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the Lord, and all Israel with him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Roboam se fut affermi dans son royaume et qu''il eut acquis de la force, il abandonna la loi de l''Eternel, et tout Israël l''abandonna avec lui.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የሮብዓም መንግሥት በጸናች ጊዜ፥ እርሱም በበረታ ጊዜ፥ እርሱና እስራኤል ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ተዉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the Lord,
verses.fr: La cinquième année du règne de Roboam, Schischak, roi d''Egypte, monta contre Jérusalem, parce qu''ils avaient péché contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በድለዋልና ሮብዓም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብጽ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሰረገሎችና ስድሳ ሺህ ፈረሰኞች ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.en: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
verses.fr: Il avait mille deux cents chars et soixante mille cavaliers; et il vint d''Egypte avec lui un peuple innombrable, des Libyens, des Sukkiens et des Ethiopiens.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ጋር ከግብጽ ለመጣው ሕዝብ ቍጥር አልነበረውም፤ እነርሱም የልብያ ሰዎች፥ ሱካውያን፥ የኢትዮጵያ ሰዎችም ነበሩ።

verses.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il prit les villes fortes qui appartenaient à Juda, et arriva jusqu''à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ለይሁዳም የነበሩትን ምሽጎች ከተሞች ወሰደ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጣ።

verses.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
verses.fr: Alors Schemaeja, le prophète, se rendit auprès de Roboam et des chefs de Juda qui s''étaient retirés dans Jérusalem à l''approche de Schischak, et il leur dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Vous m''avez abandonné; je vous abandonne aussi, et je vous livre entre les mains de Schischak.
verses.am: ነበዩም ሸማያ ወደ ሮብዓምና ከሺሻቅ ሸሽተው በኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ተሰበሰቡባት ወደ ይሁዳ መሳፍንት መጥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ ተዋችሁኝ፤ ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በሺሻቅ እጅ ተውኋችሁ።

verses.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The Lord is righteous.
verses.fr: Les chefs d''Israël et le roi s''humilièrent et dirent: L''Eternel est juste!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም መሳፍንትና ንጉሡ። እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው ብለው ሰውነታቸውን አዋረዱ።

verses.en: And when the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.fr: Et quand l''Eternel vit qu''ils s''humiliaient, la parole de l''Eternel fut ainsi adressée à Schemaeja: Ils se sont humiliés, je ne les détruirai pas, je ne tarderai pas à les secourir, et ma colère ne se répandra pas sur Jérusalem par Schischak;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰውነታቸውን እንዳዋረዱ ባየ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል። ሰውነታቸውን አዋርደዋል፤ አላጠፋቸውም፤ ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ አድናቸዋለሁ፥ ቍጣዬም በሺሻቅ እጅ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አይፈስስም፤

verses.en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.fr: mais ils lui seront assujettis, et ils sauront ce que c''est que me servir ou servir les royaumes des autres pays.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእኔ መገዛትንና ለምድር ነገሥታት መገዛትን ያውቁ ዘንድ ይገዙለታል ሲል ወደ ሸማያ መጣ።

verses.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.fr: Schischak, roi d''Egypte, monta contre Jérusalem. Il prit les trésors de la maison de l''Eternel et les trésors de la maison du roi, il prit tout. Il prit les boucliers d''or que Salomon avait faits.
verses.am: የግብጽ ንጉሥ ሺሻቅም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት መዛግብትና የንጉሡን ቤት መዛግብት ወሰደ፤ ሁሉንም ወሰደ፤ ደግሞም ሰሎሞን የሠራቸውን የወርቁን ጋሻዎች ወሰደ።

verses.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
verses.fr: Le roi Roboam fit à leur place des boucliers d''airain, et il les remit aux soins des chefs des coureurs, qui gardaient l''entrée de la maison du roi.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በእነርሱ ፋንታ የናስ ጋሻዎችን ሠራ፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት ደጅ በሚጠብቁ በዘበኞች አለቃ እጅ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And when the king entered into the house of the Lord, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
verses.fr: Toutes les fois que le roi allait à la maison de l''Eternel, les coureurs venaient et les portaient; puis ils les rapportaient dans la chambre des coureurs.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በገባ ቍጥር ዘበኞች መጥተው ይሸከሙአቸው ነበር፥ መልሰውም በዘበኞች ቤት ውስጥ ያኖሩአቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the Lord turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
verses.fr: Comme Roboam s''était humilié, l''Eternel détourna de lui sa colère et ne le détruisit pas entièrement. Et il y avait encore de bonnes choses en Juda.
verses.am: ሰውነቱንም ባዋረደ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ፈጽሞ እንዳያጠፋው ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተመለሰ፤ በይሁዳም ደግሞ መልካም ነገር ተገኘ።

verses.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.fr: Le roi Roboam s''affermit dans Jérusalem et régna. Il avait quarante et un ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna dix-sept ans à Jérusalem, la ville que l''Eternel avait choisie sur toutes les tribus d''Israël pour y mettre son nom. Sa mère s''appelait Naama, l''Ammonite.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በኢየሩሳሌም በረታ ንጉሥም ሆነ፤ ሮብዓምም በነገሠ ጊዜ የአርባ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ስሙን ያኖርባት ዘንድ ከእስራኤል አገር ሁሉ በመረጣት ከተማ በኢየሩሳሌም አሥራ ሰባት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የአሞን ሴት ናዕማ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the Lord.
verses.fr: Il fit le mal, parce qu''il n''appliqua pas son coeur à chercher l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ይሻ ዘንድ ልቡን አላዘጋጀም ነበርና ክፉ ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.fr: Les actions de Roboam, les premières et les dernières, ne sont-elles pas écrites dans les livres de Schemaeja, le prophète et d''Iddo, le prophète, parmi les registres généalogiques? Il y eut toujours guerre entre Roboam et Jéroboam.
verses.am: የሮብዓምም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ነገር በነቢዩ ሸማያና በባለ ራእዩ በአዶ የትውልድ ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን? በሮብዓምና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም በዘመናቸው ሁሉ ሰልፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Roboam se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré dans la ville de David. Et Abija, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ሮብዓምም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም አብያ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
verses.fr: La dix-huitième année du règne de Jéroboam, Abija régna sur Juda.
verses.am: ንጉሡም ኢዮርብዓም በነገሠ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት አብያ በይሁዳ ላይ ንጉሥ ሆነ።

verses.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.fr: Il régna trois ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Micaja, fille d''Uriel, de Guibea. Il y eut guerre entre Abija et Jéroboam.
verses.am: ሦስት ዓመት በኢየሩሳሌም ነገሠ፤ የእናቱም ስም ሚካያ ነበረ፥ የገብዓ ሰው የኡርኤል ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
verses.fr: Abija engagea les hostilités avec une armée de vaillants guerriers, quatre cent mille hommes d''élite; et Jéroboam se rangea en bataille contre lui avec huit cent mille hommes d''élite, vaillants guerriers.
verses.am: በአብያና በኢዮርብዓም መካከልም ሰልፍ ነበረ። አብያም የተመረጡትን አራት መቶ ሺህ ኃያላን ሰልፈኞች ይዞ ወደ ሰልፍ ወጣ፤ ኢዮርብዓምም የተመረጡትን ስምንት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ይዞ በእርሱ ላይ ተሰለፈ።

verses.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
verses.fr: Du haut du mont Tsemaraïm, qui fait partie de la montagne d''Ephraïm, Abija se leva et dit: Ecoutez-moi, Jéroboam, et tout Israël!
verses.am: አብያም በተራራማው በኤፍሬም አገር ባለው በጽማራይም ተራራ ላይ ቆሞ እንዲህ አለ። ኢዮርብዓምና እስራኤል ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤

verses.en: Ought ye not to know that the Lord God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.fr: Ne devez-vous pas savoir que l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, a donné pour toujours à David la royauté sur Israël, à lui et à ses fils, par une alliance inviolable?
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ላይ መንግሥትን ለዳዊትና ለልጆቹ በጨው ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም እንደ ሰጠ በውኑ አታውቁምን?

verses.en: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
verses.fr: Mais Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, serviteur de Salomon, fils de David, s''est levé et s''est révolté contre son maître.
verses.am: የዳዊት ልጅ የሰሎሞን ባሪያ የናባጥ ልጅ ኢዮርብዓም ግን ተነሥቶ በጌታው ላይ ዐመፀ።

verses.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.fr: Des gens de rien, des hommes pervers, se sont rassemblés auprès de lui et l''ont emporté sur Roboam, fils de Salomon. Roboam était jeune et craintif, et il manqua de force devant eux.
verses.am: ክፉዎች ሰዎችና ምናምንቴዎችም ወደ እርሱ ተሰበሰቡ፤ ሮብዓም ሕፃንና ለጋ በነበረበት ጊዜ፥ ሊቋቋማቸውም ባልቻለበት ጊዜ፥ በሰሎሞን ልጅ በሮብዓም ላይ በረቱበት።

verses.en: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with your golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, vous pensez triompher du royaume de l''Eternel, qui est entre les mains des fils de David; et vous êtes une multitude nombreuse, et vous avez avec vous les veaux d''or que Jéroboam vous a faits pour dieux.
verses.am: አሁንም በዳዊት ልጆች እጅ የሚሆነውን የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ልትቋቋሙ ታስባላችሁ። እናንተም እጅግ ታላቅ ሕዝብ ናችሁ፥ ኢዮርብዓምም አማልክት አድርጎ የሠራላችሁ የወርቅ እምቦሶች ከእናንተ ጋር ናቸው።

verses.en: Have ye not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
verses.fr: N''avez-vous pas repoussé les sacrificateurs de l''Eternel, les fils d''Aaron et les Lévites, et ne vous êtes-vous pas fait des sacrificateurs, comme les peuples des autres pays? Quiconque venait avec un jeune taureau et sept béliers, afin d''être consacré, devenait sacrificateur de ce qui n''est point Dieu.
verses.am: የአሮንን ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ካህናትና ሌዋውያን አላሳደዳችሁምን? እንደ ሌሎችም አሕዛብ ልማድ ካህናትን አላደረጋችሁምን? አንድ ወይፈንና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ይዞ ይቀድስ ዘንድ የሚመጣ ሁሉ አማልክት ላልሆኑት ለእነዚያ ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the Lord, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
verses.fr: Mais pour nous, l''Eternel est notre Dieu, et nous ne l''avons point abandonné, les sacrificateurs au service de l''Eternel sont fils d''Aaron, et les Lévites remplissent leurs fonctions.
verses.am: ለእኛ ግን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነው፥ አልተውነውም፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አገልጋዮች የአሮን ልጆች ካህናቱ ሌዋውያኑም በሥራቸው ከእኛ ጋር ናቸው።

verses.en: And they burn unto the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the Lord our God; but ye have forsaken him.
verses.fr: Nous offrons chaque matin et chaque soir des holocaustes à l''Eternel, nous brûlons le parfum odoriférant, nous mettons les pains de proposition sur la table pure, et nous allumons chaque soir le chandelier d''or et ses lampes; car nous observons les commandements de l''Eternel, notre Dieu. Et vous, vous l''avez abandonné.
verses.am: በየጥዋቱና በየማታውም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ጣፋጩን ዕጣን ያሳርጋሉ፤ የገጹንም ኅብስት በንጹህ ገበታ ላይ፥ የወርቁን መቅረዝና ቀንዲሎቹንም ማታ ማታ እንዲያበሩ ያዘጋጃሉ፤ እኛም የአምላካችንን የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ እንጠብቃለን፥ እናንተ ግን ትታችሁታል።

verses.en: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the Lord God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
verses.fr: Voici, Dieu et ses sacrificateurs sont avec nous, à notre tête, et nous avons les trompettes retentissantes pour les faire résonner contre vous. Enfants d''Israël! ne faites pas la guerre à l''Eternel, le Dieu de vos pères, car vous n''auriez aucun succès.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ እግዚአብሔር በእኛ ላይ አለቃ ነው፥ መለከቱንም የሚነፉ ካህናቱ ከእኛ ጋር ናቸው፥ በእናንተም ላይ ይጮኻሉ። የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ አይበጃችሁምና ከአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አትዋጉ።

verses.en: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.fr: Jéroboam les prit par derrière au moyen d''une embuscade, et ses troupes étaient en face de Juda, qui avait l''embuscade par derrière.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓም ግን ድብቅ ጦር በስተ ኋላቸው አዞረ፤ እነርሱ በይሁዳ ፊት ሆነው ድብቅ ጦሩ በስተ ኋላቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the Lord, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.fr: Ceux de Juda s''étant retournés eurent à combattre devant et derrière. Ils crièrent à l''Eternel, et les sacrificateurs sonnèrent des trompettes.
verses.am: ይሁዳም ወደ ኋላው በተመለከተ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ ሰልፉ በፊቱና በኋላው ነበረ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጮኹ፥ ካህናቱም መለከቱን ነፉ።

verses.en: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
verses.fr: Les hommes de Juda poussèrent un cri de guerre et, au cri de guerre des hommes de Juda, l''Eternel frappa Jéroboam et tout Israël devant Abija et Juda.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ጮኹ፤ የይሁዳም ሰዎች በጮኹ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ኢዮርብዓምንና እስራኤልን ሁሉ በአብያና በይሁዳ ፊት መታቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël s''enfuirent devant Juda, et Dieu les livra entre ses mains.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከይሁዳ ፊት ሸሹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእጃቸው አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.fr: Abija et son peuple leur firent éprouver une grande défaite, et cinq cent mille hommes d''élite tombèrent morts parmi ceux d''Israël.
verses.am: አብያና ሕዝቡ ታላቅ አመታት መቱአቸው፤ ከእስራኤልም አምስት መቶ ሺህ የተመረጡ ሰዎች ተገድለው ወደቁ።

verses.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël furent humiliés en ce temps, et les enfants de Juda remportèrent la victoire, parce qu''ils s''étaient appuyés sur l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተዋረዱ፥ የይሁዳም ልጆች በአባቶቻቸው አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ታምነው ነበርና አሸነፉ።

verses.en: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephraim with the towns thereof.
verses.fr: Abija poursuivit Jéroboam et lui prit des villes, Béthel et les villes de son ressort, Jeschana et les villes de son ressort, et Ephron et les villes de son ressort.
verses.am: አብያም ኢዮርብዓምን አሳደደው፥ ከእርሱም ከተሞቹን፥ ቤቴልንና መንደሮችዋን፥ ይሻናንና መንደሮችዋን፥ ዔፍሮንንና መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ።

verses.en: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the Lord struck him, and he died.
verses.fr: Jéroboam n''eut plus de force du temps d''Abija; et l''Eternel le frappa, et il mourut.
verses.am: ኢዮርብዓምም ከዚያ በኋላ በአብያ ዘመን አልበረታም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቀሠፈው፥ ሞተም።

verses.en: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.fr: Mais Abija devint puissant; il eut quatorze femmes, et engendra vingt-deux fils et seize filles.
verses.am: አብያም ጸና፥ አሥራ አራትም ሚስቶች አገባ፥ ሀያ ሁለትም ወንዶች ልጆችንና አሥራ ስድስት ሴቶች ልጆችን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions d''Abija, ce qu''il a fait et ce qu''il a dit, cela est écrit dans les mémoires du prophète Iddo.
verses.am: የአብያም የቀረው ነገርና አካሄዱ የተናገራቸውም ቃሎች በነቢዩ በአዶ መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል።

verses.en: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.fr: Abija se coucha avec ses pères, et on l''enterra dans la ville de David. Et Asa, son fils, régna à sa place. De son temps, le pays fut en repos pendant dix ans.
verses.am: አብያም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አሳ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ። በእርሱም ዘመን ምድሪቱ አሥር ዓመት ያህል ዐረፈች።

verses.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God:
verses.fr: Asa fit ce qui est bien et droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, son Dieu.
verses.am: አሳም በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምና ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤

verses.en: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
verses.fr: Il fit disparaître les autels de l''étranger et les hauts lieux, il brisa les statues et abattit les idoles.
verses.am: የእንግዶቹንም አማልክት መሠዊያ የኮረብታውንም መስገጃዎች አፈረሰ፥ ሐውልቶቹንም ሰበረ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፤

verses.en: And commanded Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
verses.fr: Il ordonna à Juda de rechercher l''Eternel, le Dieu de ses pères, et de pratiquer la loi et les commandements.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይሹ ዘንድ፥ ሕጉንና ትእዛዙንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ ይሁዳን አዘዘ።

verses.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.fr: Il fit disparaître de toutes les villes de Juda les hauts lieux et les statues consacrées au soleil. Et le royaume fut en repos devant lui.
verses.am: ከይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችና የፀሐይ ምስሎችን አስወገደ፤ መንግሥቱም በእርሱ ሥር በሰላም ተቀመጠች።

verses.en: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the Lord had given him rest.
verses.fr: Il bâtit des villes fortes en Juda; car le pays fut tranquille et il n''y eut pas de guerre contre lui pendant ces années-là, parce que l''Eternel lui donna du repos.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ምሽጎች ከተሞችን ሠራ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ዕረፍት ስለ ሰጠው ምድሪቱ ጸጥ ብላ ነበር፥ በዚያም ዘመን ሰልፍ አልነበረም።

verses.en: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the Lord our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
verses.fr: Il dit à Juda: Bâtissons ces villes, et entourons-les de murs, de tours, de portes et de barres; le pays est encore devant nous, car nous avons recherché l''Eternel, notre Dieu, nous l''avons recherché, et il nous a donné du repos de tous côtés. Ils bâtirent donc, et réussirent.
verses.am: ይሁዳንም። እነዚህን ከተሞች እንሥራ፥ ቅጥርም ግንብም መዝጊያም መወርወሪያም እናድርግባቸው፤ አምላካችንን እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ፈለግነው ምድሪቱ ገና በፊታችን ናት፤ እኛ ፈልገነዋል፥ እርሱም በዙሪያችን ዕረፍት ሰጥቶናል አለ። እነርሱም ሠሩ አከናወኑም።

verses.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
verses.fr: Asa avait une armée de trois cent mille hommes de Juda, portant le bouclier et la lance, et de deux cent quatre-vingt mille de Benjamin, portant le bouclier et tirant de l''arc, tous vaillants hommes.
verses.am: ለአሳም አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻና ጦር የሚሸከሙ ሦስት መቶ ሺህ የይሁዳ ሠራዊት፥ ጋሻም የሚሸከሙ ቀስትም የሚገትሩ ሁለት መቶ ሰማኒያ ሺህ የብንያም ሰዎች ነበሩት፤ እነዚህም ሁሉ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
verses.fr: Zérach, l''Ethiopien, sortit contre eux avec une armée d''un million d''hommes et trois cents chars, et il s''avança jusqu''à Maréscha.
verses.am: ኢትዮጵያዊውም ዝሪ አንድ ሚሊዮን ሰዎችና ሦስት መቶ ሰረገሎች ይዞ ወጣባቸው፤ ወደ መሪሳም መጣ።

verses.en: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.fr: Asa marcha au-devant de lui, et ils se rangèrent en bataille dans la vallée de Tsephata, près de Maréscha.
verses.am: አሳም ሊጋጠመው ወጣ፥ በመሪሳም አጠገብ ባለው በጽፋታ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ተሰለፉ።

verses.en: And Asa cried unto the Lord his God, and said, Lord, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O Lord our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O Lord, thou art our God; let no man prevail against thee.
verses.fr: Asa invoqua l''Eternel, son Dieu, et dit: Eternel, toi seul peux venir en aide au faible comme au fort: viens à notre aide, Eternel, notre Dieu! car c''est sur toi que nous nous appuyons, et nous sommes venus en ton nom contre cette multitude. Eternel, tu es notre Dieu: que ce ne soit pas l''homme qui l''emporte sur toi!
verses.am: አሳም። አቤቱ፥ በብዙም ሆነ በጥቂቱ ማዳን አይሳንህም፤ አቤቱ አምላካችን ሆይ፥ በአንተ ታምነናልና፥ በስምህም በዚህ ታላቅ ወገን ላይ መጥተናልና እርዳን፤ አቤቱ፥ አምላካችን አንተ ነህ፤ ሰውም አያሸንፍህ ብሎ ወደ አምላኩ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጮኸ።

verses.en: So the Lord smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.fr: L''Eternel frappa les Ethiopiens devant Asa et devant Juda, et les Ethiopiens prirent la fuite.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በአሳና በይሁዳ ፊት ኢትዮጵያውያንን መታ፤ ኢትዮጵያውያንም ሸሹ።

verses.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the Lord, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
verses.fr: Asa et le peuple qui était avec lui les poursuivirent jusqu''à Guérar, et les Ethiopiens tombèrent sans pouvoir sauver leur vie, car ils furent détruits par l''Eternel et par son armée. Asa et son peuple firent un très grand butin;
verses.am: አሳም ከእርሱም ጋር ያለው ሕዝብ እስከ ጌራራ ድረስ አሳደዱአቸው፤ ኢትዮጵያውያንም ፈጽመው እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ወደቁ፥ በእግዚአብሔርና በሠራዊቱ ፊት ተሰባብረዋልና፤ እጅግም ብዙ ምርኮ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the Lord came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
verses.fr: ils frappèrent toutes les villes des environs de Guérar, car la terreur de l''Eternel s''était emparée d''elles, et ils pillèrent toutes les villes, dont les dépouilles furent considérables.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ታላቅ ድንጋጤ ስለ ወደቀባቸው በጌራራ ዙሪያ የነበሩትን ከተሞች ሁሉ መቱ፤ በከተሞቹም ውስጥ እጅግ ብዝበዛ ነበረና ከተሞቹን ሁሉ በዘበዙ።

verses.en: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Ils frappèrent aussi les tentes des troupeaux, et ils emmenèrent une grande quantité de brebis et de chameaux. Puis ils retournèrent à Jérusalem.
verses.am: የከብቶቹንም በረት አፈረሱ፤ እጅግም ብዙ በጎችንና ግመሎችንም ማረኩ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.fr: L''esprit de Dieu fut sur Azaria, fils d''Obed,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በዖዴድ ልጅ በዓዛርያስ ላይ ሆነ፤

verses.en: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The Lord is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.fr: et Azaria alla au-devant d''Asa et lui dit: Ecoutez-moi, Asa, et tout Juda et Benjamin! L''Eternel est avec vous quand vous êtes avec lui; si vous le cherchez, vous le trouverez; mais si vous l''abandonnez, il vous abandonnera.
verses.am: አሳንም ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ እንዲህም አለው። አሳ ይሁዳና ብንያም ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ስትሆኑ እርሱ ከእናንተ ጋር ነው፤ ብትፈልጉትም ይገኝላችኋል፤ ብትተዉት ግን ይተዋችኋል።

verses.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.fr: Pendant longtemps il n''y a eu pour Israël ni vrai Dieu, ni sacrificateur qui enseignât, ni loi.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ብዙ ዘመን ያለ እውነተኛ አምላክ፥ ያለ አስተማሪም ካህን፥ ያለ ሕግም ይኖሩ ነበር።

verses.en: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the Lord God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.fr: Mais au sein de leur détresse ils sont retournés à l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, ils l''ont cherché, et ils l''ont trouvé.
verses.am: በመከራቸውም ወደ እስራኤል አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመልሰው በፈለጉት ጊዜ አገኙት።

verses.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.fr: Dans ces temps-là, point de sécurité pour ceux qui allaient et venaient, car il y avait de grands troubles parmi tous les habitants du pays;
verses.am: በዚያም ዘመን ለሚወጣውና ለሚገባው ሰላም አልነበረም፥ በምድርም በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ላይ ታላቅ ድንጋጤ ነበረ።

verses.en: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
verses.fr: on se heurtait peuple contre peuple, ville contre ville, parce que Dieu les agitait par toutes sortes d''angoisses.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በመከራው ሁሉ ያስጨንቃቸው ነበርና ወገን ከወገን ጋር፥ ከተማም ከከተማ ጋር ይዋጋ ነበር።

verses.en: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.fr: Vous donc, fortifiez-vous, et ne laissez pas vos mains s''affaiblir, car il y aura un salaire pour vos oeuvres.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን ለሥራችሁ ብድራት ይሆንላችኋልና በርቱ፥ እጃችሁም አይላላ።

verses.en: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the Lord, that was before the porch of the Lord.
verses.fr: Après avoir entendu ces paroles et la prophétie d''Obed le prophète, Asa se fortifia et fit disparaître les abominations de tout le pays de Juda et de Benjamin et des villes qu''il avait prises dans la montagne d''Ephraïm, et il restaura l''autel de l''Eternel qui était devant le portique de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሳም ይህን ቃልና የነቢዩን የዖዴድን ትንቢት በሰማ ጊዜ ልቡ ጸና፥ ከይሁዳና ከቢንያምም አገር ሁሉ በተራራማውም በኤፍሬም አገር ከያዛቸው ከተሞች ጸያፉን ነገር አስወገደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ፊት የነበረውን የእግዚአብሔርን መሠዊያ አደሰ።

verses.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
verses.fr: Il rassembla tout Juda et Benjamin, et ceux d''Ephraïm, de Manassé et de Siméon qui habitaient parmi eux, car un grand nombre de gens d''Israël se joignirent à lui lorsqu''ils virent que l''Eternel, son Dieu, était avec lui.
verses.am: አምላኩም እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር እንደ ሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ብዙ ሰዎች ወደ እርሱ ተጠግተው ነበርና እርሱ ይሁዳንና ብንያምን ሁሉ፥ ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴም ከስምዖንም መጥተው ከእነርሱ ጋር የተቀመጡትን ሰበሰበ።

verses.en: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.fr: Ils s''assemblèrent à Jérusalem le troisième mois de la quinzième année du règne d''Asa.
verses.am: አሳም በነገሠ በአሥራ አምስተኛው ዓመት በሦስተኛው ወር በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And they offered unto the Lord the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.fr: Ce jour-là, ils sacrifièrent à l''Eternel, sur le butin qu''ils avaient amené, sept cents boeufs et sept mille brebis.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ካመጡት ምርኮ ሰባት መቶ በሬዎችና ሰባት ሺህ በጎች ለእግዚአብሔር ሠዉ።

verses.en: And they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.fr: Ils prirent l''engagement de chercher l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères, de tout leur coeur et de toute leur âme;
verses.am: በፍጹም ልባቸውና በፍጹም ነፍሳቸው የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ይሹ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አደረጉ፤

verses.en: That whosoever would not seek the Lord God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.fr: et quiconque ne chercherait pas l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël, devait être mis à mort, petit ou grand, homme ou femme.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈልግ፥ ታናሽ ወይም ታላቅ፥ ወንድ ወይም ሴት ቢሆን፥ ይገደል ዘንድ ማሉ።

verses.en: And they sware unto the Lord with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.fr: Ils jurèrent fidélité à l''Eternel à voix haute, avec des cris de joie, et au son des trompettes et des cors;
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም በታላቅ ድምፅና በእልልታ፥ በእምቢልታና በቀንደ መለከት ማሉ።

verses.en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the Lord gave them rest round about.
verses.fr: tout Juda se réjouit de ce serment, car ils avaient juré de tout leur coeur, ils avaient cherché l''Eternel de plein gré, et ils l''avaient trouvé, et l''Eternel leur donna du repos de tous côtés.
verses.am: በፍጹምም ልባቸው ምለዋልና፥በፍጹምም ሕሊናቸው ፈልገውታልና፥ እርሱም ተገኝቶላቸዋልና ይሁዳ ሁሉ በመሐላው ደስ አላቸው፤ እግዚአብሔርም በዙሪያቸው ዕረፍት ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.fr: Le roi Asa enleva même à Maaca, sa mère, la dignité de reine, parce qu''elle avait fait une idole pour Astarté. Asa abattit son idole, qu''il réduisit en poussière, et la brûla au torrent de Cédron.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አሳ እናቱን መዓካን በማምለኪያ ዐፀድ ጣዖት ስላደረገች ከእቴጌነትዋ አዋረዳት፤ አሳም ምስልዋን ቈርጦ ቀጠቀጠው፥ በቄድሮንም ወንዝ አጠገብ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.fr: Mais les hauts lieux ne disparurent point d''Israël, quoique le coeur d''Asa fût en entier à l''Eternel pendant toute sa vie.
verses.am: በኮረብታ ላይ የነበሩትን መስገጃዎች ግን ከእስራኤል አላራቀም፤ ይሁን እንጂ የአሳ ልብ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ፍጹም ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.fr: Il mit dans la maison de Dieu les choses consacrées par son père et par lui-même, de l''argent, de l''or et des vases.
verses.am: አባቱም የቀደሰውን፥ እርሱም የቀደሰውን ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ልዩ ልዩውንም ዕቃ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አገባ።

verses.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.fr: Il n''y eut point de guerre jusqu''à la trente-cinquième année du règne d''Asa.
verses.am: አሳም እስከ ነገሠበት እስከ ሠላሳ አምስተኛው ዓመት ድረስ ሰልፍ አልነበረም።

verses.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.fr: La trente-sixième année du règne d''Asa, Baescha, roi d''Israël, monta contre Juda; et il bâtit Rama, pour empêcher ceux d''Asa, roi de Juda, de sortir et d''entrer.
verses.am: አሳ በነገሠ በሠላሳ ስድስተኛው ዓመት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ባኦስ በይሁዳ ላይ ወጣ፥ ወደ ይሁዳም ንጉሥ ወደ አሳ ማንም መውጣትና መግባት እንዳይችል ራማን ሠራ።

verses.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the Lord and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.fr: Asa sortit de l''argent et de l''or des trésors de la maison de l''Eternel et de la maison du roi, et il envoya des messagers vers Ben-Hadad, roi de Syrie, qui habitait à Damas.
verses.am: አሳም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ከንጉሡ ቤት መዝገብ ብርና ወርቅ ወስዶ።

verses.en: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.fr: Il lui fit dire: Qu''il y ait une alliance entre moi et toi, comme il y en eut une entre mon père et ton père. Voici, je t''envoie de l''argent et de l''or. Va, romps ton alliance avec Baescha, roi d''Israël, afin qu''il s''éloigne de moi.
verses.am: በአባቴና በአባትህ መካከል እንደ ነበረው ቃል ኪዳን በእኔና በአንተ መካከል ይሆናል፤ እነሆ ብርና ወርቅ ሰድጄልሃለሁ፤ እርሱ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲርቅ ሄደህ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከባኦስ ጋር ያለህን ቃል ኪዳን አፍርስ ብሎ በደማስቆ ወደተቀመጠው ወደ ሶሪያ ንጉሥ ወደ ወልደ አዴር ሰደደ።

verses.en: And Benhadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abelmaim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.fr: Ben-Hadad écouta le roi Asa; il envoya les chefs de son armée contre les villes d''Israël, et ils frappèrent Ijjon, Dan, Abel-Maïm, et tous les magasins des villes de Nephthali.
verses.am: ወልደ አዴር ንጉሡን አሳን እሺ አለው፥ የሠራዊቱም አለቆች በእስራኤል ከተሞች ላይ ሰደደ፤ እነርሱም ዒዮንንና ዳንን አቤልማይምንና የንፍታሌምን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ መቱ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.fr: Lorsque Baescha l''apprit, il cessa de bâtir Rama et interrompit ses travaux.
verses.am: ባኦስም በሰማ ጊዜ ራማን መሥራት ተወ፥ ሥራውንም አቋረጠ።

verses.en: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.fr: Le roi Asa occupa tout Juda à emporter les pierres et le bois que Baescha employait à la construction de Rama, et il s''en servit pour bâtir Guéba et Mitspa.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አሳ የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ባኦስ ይሠራበት የነበረውን የራማን ድንጋይና እንጨት አስወገዱ፥ እርሱም ጌባንና ምጽጳን ሠራበት።

verses.en: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the Lord thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
verses.fr: Dans ce temps-là, Hanani, le voyant, alla auprès d''Asa, roi de Juda, et lui dit: Parce que tu t''es appuyé sur le roi de Syrie et que tu ne t''es pas appuyé sur l''Eternel, ton Dieu, l''armée du roi de Syrie s''est échappée de tes mains.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ባለ ራእዩ አናኒ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሳ መጥቶ እንዲህ አለው። በሶሪያ ንጉሥ ታምነሃልና፥ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር አልታመንህምና ስለዚህ የሶሪያ ንጉሥ ጭፍራ ከእጅህ አምልጦአል።

verses.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the Lord, he delivered them into thine hand.
verses.fr: Les Ethiopiens et les Libyens ne formaient-ils pas une grande armée, avec des chars et une multitude de cavaliers? Et cependant l''Eternel les a livrés entre tes mains, parce que tu t''étais appuyé sur lui.
verses.am: ኢትዮጵያውያንና የልብያ ሰዎች እጅግ ብዙ ሰረገሎችና ፈረሰኞች የነበሩአቸው እጅግ ታላቅ ጭፍራ አልነበሩምን? በእግዚአብሔር ስለ ታመንህ በእጅህ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፥

verses.en: For the eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel étend ses regards sur toute la terre, pour soutenir ceux dont le coeur est tout entier à lui. Tu as agi en insensé dans cette affaire, car dès à présent tu auras des guerres.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልቡ በእርሱ ዘንድ ፍጹም የሆነውን ያጸና ዘንድ ዓይኖቹ በምድር ሁሉ ይመለከታሉና። አሁንም ስንፍና አድርገሃል። ስለዚህም ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ሰልፍ ይሆንብሃል።

verses.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.fr: Asa fut irrité contre le voyant, et il le fit mettre en prison, parce qu''il était en colère contre lui. Et dans le même temps Asa opprima aussi quelques-uns du peuple.
verses.am: አሳም በባለ ራእዩ ላይ ተቈጣ፤ ስለዚህም ነገር ተቈጥቶአልና በግዞት አኖረው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አሳ ከሕዝቡ አያሌ ሰዎችን አስጨነቀ።

verses.en: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
verses.fr: Les actions d''Asa, les premières et les dernières, sont écrites dans le livre des rois de Juda et d''Israël.
verses.am: የአሳም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በይሁዳና በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the Lord, but to the physicians.
verses.fr: La trente-neuvième année de son règne, Asa eut les pieds malades au point d''éprouver de grandes souffrances; même pendant sa maladie, il ne chercha pas l''Eternel, mais il consulta les médecins.
verses.am: በነገሠም በሠላሳ ዘጠኝኛው ዓመት አሳ እግሩን ታመመ፤ ደዌውም ጸናበት፤ ነገር ግን በታመመ ጊዜ ባለ መድኃኒቶችን እንጂ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈለገም።

verses.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.fr: Asa se coucha avec ses pères, et il mourut la quarante et unième année de son règne;
verses.am: አሳም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በነገሠም በአርባ አንደኛው ዓመት ሞተ።

verses.en: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.fr: on l''enterra dans le sépulcre qu''il s''était creusé dans la ville de David. On le coucha sur un lit qu''on avait garni d''aromates et de parfums préparés selon l''art du parfumeur, et l''on en brûla en son honneur une quantité très considérable.
verses.am: ለእርሱም ለራሱ በሠራው መቃብር በዳዊት ከተማ ቀበሩት፤ በቀማሚ ብልሃት የተሰናዳ ልዩ ልዩ መልካም ሽቱ በተሞላ አልጋ ላይም አኖሩት፤ እጅግም ታላቅ የሆነ የመቃብር ወግ አደረጉለት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.fr: Josaphat, son fils, régna à sa place. Il se fortifia contre Israël:
verses.am: በእርሱም ፋንታ ልጁ ኢዮሳፍጥ ነገሠ፥ በእስራኤልም ላይ ጠነከረ።

verses.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.fr: il mit des troupes dans toutes les villes fortes de Juda, et des garnisons dans le pays de Juda et dans les villes d''Ephraïm dont Asa, son père, s''était emparé.
verses.am: በተመሸጉትም በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ወታደሮችን አኖረ፥ በይሁዳም አገር አባቱም አሳ በወሰዳቸው በኤፍሬም ከተሞች ዘበኞችን አስቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.fr: L''Eternel fut avec Josaphat, parce qu''il marcha dans les premières voies de David, son père, et qu''il ne rechercha point les Baals;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከኢዮሳፍጥ ጋር ነበረ፥ በፊተኛይቱ በአባቱ በዳዊት መንገድ ሄዶአልና፥ በኣሊምንም አልፈለገምና፤

verses.en: But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
verses.fr: car il eut recours au Dieu de son père, et il suivit ses commandements, sans imiter ce que faisait Israël.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የአባቱን አምላክ ፈለገ፥ በትእዛዙም ሄደ፥ የእስራኤልንም ሥራ አልሠራም።

verses.en: Therefore the Lord stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.fr: L''Eternel affermit la royauté entre les mains de Josaphat, à qui tout Juda apportait des présents, et qui eut en abondance des richesses et de la gloire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥቱን በእጁ አጸና፤ ይሁዳም ሁሉ እጅ መንሻ ለኢዮሳፍጥ አመጣ፤ እጅግም ብዙ ብልጥግናና ክብር ሆነለት።

verses.en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
verses.fr: Son coeur grandit dans les voies de l''Eternel, et il fit encore disparaître de Juda les hauts lieux et les idoles.
verses.am: ልቡም በእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችና የማምለኪያ ዐፀዱንም ከይሁዳ አስወገደ።

verses.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Benhail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
verses.fr: La troisième année de son règne, il chargea ses chefs Ben-Haïl, Abdias, Zacharie, Nethaneel et Michée, d''aller enseigner dans les villes de Juda.
verses.am: በነገሠም በሦስተኛው ዓመት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ያስተምሩ ዘንድ መሳፍንቱን፥ ቤንኃይልን፥ አብድያስን፥ ዘካርያስን፥ ናትናኤልን፥ ሚክያስን፥ ሰደደ።

verses.en: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.fr: Il envoya avec eux les Lévites Schemaeja, Nethania, Zebadia, Asaël, Schemiramoth, Jonathan, Adonija, Tobija et Tob-Adonija, Lévites, et les sacrificateurs Elischama et Joram.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ጋር ሌዋውያንን ሸማያን፥ ነታንያን፥ ዝባድያን፥ አሣሄልን፥ ሰሚራሞትን፥ ዮናትንን፥ አዶንያስን፥ ጦብያን፥ ጦባዶንያን ሰደደ ከእነርሱም ጋር ካህናቱን ኤሊሳማንና ኢዮራምን ሰደደ።

verses.en: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the Lord with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
verses.fr: Ils enseignèrent dans Juda, ayant avec eux le livre de la loi de l''Eternel. Ils parcoururent toutes les villes de Juda, et ils enseignèrent parmi le peuple.
verses.am: እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን የሕጉን መጽሐፍ ይዘው በይሁዳ ያስተምሩ ነበር፤ ወደ ይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ሄደው ሕዝቡን ያስተምሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And the fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.fr: La terreur de l''Eternel s''empara de tous les royaumes des pays qui environnaient Juda, et ils ne firent point la guerre à Josaphat.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ዙሪያ በነበሩ መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ድንጋጤ ሆነ፥ ከኢዮሳፍጥም ጋር አልተዋጉም።

verses.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.fr: Des Philistins apportèrent à Josaphat des présents et un tribut en argent; et les Arabes lui amenèrent aussi du bétail, sept mille sept cents béliers et sept mille sept cents boucs.
verses.am: ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ለኢዮሳፍጥ እጅ መንሻና የብር ግብር ያመጡ ነበር፤ ዓረባውያንም ደግሞ ከመንጎቻቸው ሰባት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አውራ በጎችና ሰባት ሺህ ሰባት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አውራ ፍየሎች ያመጡለት ነበር።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
verses.fr: Josaphat s''élevait au plus haut degré de grandeur. Il bâtit en Juda des châteaux et des villes pour servir de magasins.
verses.am: ኢዮሳፍጥም እየበረታና እጅግም እየከበረ ሄደ፤ በይሁዳም ግንቦችንና የጎተራ ከተሞችን ሠራ።

verses.en: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Il fit exécuter beaucoup de travaux dans les villes de Juda, et il avait à Jérusalem de vaillants hommes pour soldats.
verses.am: በይሁዳም ከተሞች ብዙ ሥራ ሠራ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰልፈኞች ነበሩት።

verses.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.fr: Voici leur dénombrement, selon les maisons de leurs pères. De Juda, chefs de milliers: Adna, le chef, avec trois cent mille vaillants hommes;
verses.am: ቍጥራቸውም እንደ አባቶቻቸው ቤት ይህ ነበረ፤ ከይሁዳ ሻለቆች አለቃው ዓድና፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሦስት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.fr: et à ses côtés, Jochanan, le chef, avec deux cent quatre-vingt mille hommes;
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ አለቃው ይሆሐናን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ ሰማንያ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the Lord; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.fr: et à ses côtés, Amasia, fils de Zicri, qui s''était volontairement consacré à l''Eternel, avec deux cent mille vaillants hommes.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ በፈቃዱ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር የቀደሰ የዝክሪ ልጅ ዓማስያ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ሁለት መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.fr: De Benjamin: Eliada, vaillant homme, avec deux cent mille hommes armés de l''arc et du bouclier,
verses.am: ከብንያምም ጽኑዕ ኃያል የነበረው ኤሊዳሄ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ቀስትና ጋሻ የሚይዙ ሁለት መቶ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤

verses.en: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.fr: et à ses côtés, Zozabad, avec cent quatre-vingt mille hommes armés pour la guerre.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በኋላ ዮዛባት፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ለሰልፍ የተዘጋጁ መቶ ሰማኒያ ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux qui étaient au service du roi, outre ceux que le roi avait placés dans toutes les villes fortes de Juda.
verses.am: ንጉሡ በተመሸጉ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ካኖራቸውም ሌላ እነዚህ ንጉሡን ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.fr: Josaphat eut en abondance des richesses et de la gloire, et il s''allia par mariage avec Achab.
verses.am: ለኢዮሣፍጥም ብዙ ብልጥግናና ክብር ነበረው፤ ለአክዓብም ጋብቻ ሆነ።

verses.en: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
verses.fr: Au bout de quelques années, il descendit auprès d''Achab à Samarie; et Achab tua pour lui et pour le peuple qui était avec lui un grand nombre de brebis et de boeufs, et il le sollicita de monter à Ramoth en Galaad.
verses.am: ከጥቂት ዓመት በኋላም ወደ አክዓብ ወደ ሰማርያ ወረደ። አክዓብም ለእርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር ለነበሩት ሕዝብ ብዙ በጎችንና በሬዎችን አረደ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይሄድ ዘንድ አባበለው።

verses.en: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
verses.fr: Achab, roi d''Israël, dit à Josaphat, roi de Juda: Veux-tu venir avec moi à Ramoth en Galaad? Josaphat lui répondit: Moi comme toi, et mon peuple comme ton peuple, nous irons l''attaquer avec toi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አክዓብ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ትሄዳለህን? አለው። እርሱም እኔ እንደ አንተ ነኝ፥ ሕዝቤም እንደ ሕዝብህ ናቸው፤ በሰልፍም ከአንተ ጋር እንሆናለን ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the Lord to day.
verses.fr: Puis Josaphat dit au roi d''Israël: Consulte maintenant, je te prie, la parole de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ። የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል አስቀድመህ ትጠይቅ ዘንድ እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël assembla les prophètes, au nombre de quatre cents, et leur dit: Irons-nous attaquer Ramoth en Galaad, ou dois-je y renoncer? Et ils répondirent: Monte, et Dieu la livrera entre les mains du roi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ነቢያቱን አራት መቶ ሰዎች ሰብስቦ። ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ ልሂድን? ወይስ ልቅር? አላቸው። እነርሱም። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ውጣ አሉት።

verses.en: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.fr: Mais Josaphat dit: N''y a-t-il plus ici aucun prophète de l''Eternel, par qui nous puissions le consulter?
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን። እንጠይቀው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢይ የሆነ ሌላ ሰው በዚህ አይገኝምን? አለ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the Lord: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël répondit à Josaphat: Il y a encore un homme par qui l''on pourrait consulter l''Eternel; mais je le hais, car il ne me prophétise rien de bon, il ne prophétise jamais que du mal: c''est Michée, fils de Jimla. Et Josaphat dit: Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት አንድ ሰው አለ፤ ነገር ግን ሁል ጊዜ ክፉ እንጂ ከቶ መልካም ትንቢት አይነግርልኝምና እጠላዋለሁ፤ እርሱም የይምላ ልጅ ሚክያስ ነው አለው። ኢዮሳፍጥም። ንጉሥ እንዲህ አይበል አለው።

verses.en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.fr: Alors le roi d''Israël appela un eunuque, et dit: Fais venir tout de suite Michée, fils de Jimla.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አንድ ጃንደረባ ጠርቶ። የይምላን ልጅ ሚክያስን ፈጥነህ አምጣው አለው።

verses.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, étaient assis chacun sur son trône, revêtus de leurs habits royaux; ils étaient assis dans la place à l''entrée de la porte de Samarie. Et tous les prophètes prophétisaient devant eux.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሳፍጥ ልብሰ መንግሥት ለብሰው በሰማሪያ በር መግቢያ አጠገብ በአደባባይ በዙፋኖቻቸው ላይ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ነቢያትም ሁሉ በፊታቸው ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the Lord, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
verses.fr: Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, s''était fait des cornes de fer, et il dit: Ainsi parle l''Eternel: Avec ces cornes, tu frapperas les Syriens jusqu''à les détruire.
verses.am: የክንዓና ልጅ ሰዴቅያስም የብረት ቀንዶች ሠርቶ። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ሶሪያውያንን እስኪጠፉ ድረስ በእነዚህ ትወጋለህ አለ።

verses.en: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.fr: Et tous les prophètes prophétisèrent de même, en disant: Monte à Ramoth en Galaad! tu auras du succès, et l''Eternel la livrera entre les mains du roi.
verses.am: ነቢያትም ሁሉ። እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ሂድና ተከናወን እያሉ እንዲሁ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።

verses.en: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of their's, and speak thou good.
verses.fr: Le messager qui était allé appeler Michée lui parla ainsi: Voici, les prophètes d''un commun accord prophétisent du bien au roi; que ta parole soit donc comme la parole de chacun d''eux! annonce du bien!
verses.am: ሚክያስንም ሊጠራ የሄደ መልእክተኛ። እነሆ፥ ነቢያት በአንድ አፍ ሆነው ለንጉሡ መልካም ይናገራሉ፤ ቃልህም እንደ ቃላቸው እንዲሆን መልካም እንድትናገር እለምንሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, As the Lord liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
verses.fr: Michée répondit: L''Eternel est vivant! j''annoncerai ce que dira mon Dieu.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አምላኬ የሚለውን እርሱን እናገራለሁ አለ።

verses.en: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il fut arrivé auprès du roi, le roi lui dit: Michée, irons-nous attaquer Ramoth en Galaad, ou dois-je y renoncer? Il répondit: Montez! vous aurez du succès, et ils seront livrés entre vos mains.
verses.am: ወደ ንጉሡም በመጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡ። ሚክያስ ሆይ፥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ እንሂድን? ወይስ እንቅር? አለው። እርሱም። ውጣ፥ ተከናወን፤ በእጅህም አልፈው ይሰጣሉ አለ።

verses.en: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the Lord?
verses.fr: Et le roi lui dit: Combien de fois me faudra-t-il te faire jurer de ne me dire que la vérité au nom de l''Eternel?
verses.am: ንጉሡም። በእግዚአብሔር ስም ከእውነት በቀር እንዳትነግረኝ ስንት ጊዜ አምልሃለሁ? አለው።

verses.en: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
verses.fr: Michée répondit: Je vois tout Israël dispersé sur les montagnes, comme des brebis qui n''ont point de berger; et l''Eternel dit: Ces gens n''ont point de maître, que chacun retourne en paix dans sa maison!
verses.am: እርሱም። እስራኤል ሁሉ ጠባቂ እንደሌላቸው በጎች በተራሮች ላይ ተበትነው አየሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም። ለእነዚህ ጌታ የላቸውም፥ እያንዳንዱም በሰላም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ አለ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit à Josaphat: Ne te l''ai-je pas dit? Il ne prophétise sur moi rien de bon, il ne prophétise que du mal.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን። ክፉ እንጂ መልካም ትንቢት አይናገርልኝም አላልሁህምን? አለው።

verses.en: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the Lord; I saw the Lord sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.fr: Et Michée dit: Ecoutez donc la parole de l''Eternel! J''ai vu l''Eternel assis sur son trône, et toute l''armée des cieux se tenant à sa droite et à sa gauche.
verses.am: ሚክያስም አለ። እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር በዙፋኑ ተቀምጦ፥ የሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ በቀኙና በግራው ቆመው አየሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Qui séduira Achab, roi d''Israël, pour qu''il monte à Ramoth en Galaad et qu''il y périsse? Ils répondirent l''un d''une manière, l''autre d''une autre.
