verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ወጥቶ በሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይወድቅ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ አክዓብን የሚያታልል ማን ነው? አለ። አንዱም እንደዚህ፥ ሌላውም እንደዚያ ያለ ነገር ተናገረ።

verses.en: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will entice him. And the Lord said unto him, Wherewith?
verses.fr: Et un esprit vint se présenter devant l''Eternel, et dit: Moi, je le séduirai. L''Eternel lui dit: Comment?
verses.am: መንፈስም መጣ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቆሞ። እኔ አታልለዋለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። በምን? አለው።

verses.en: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the Lord said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
verses.fr: Je sortirai, répondit-il, et je serai un esprit de mensonge dans la bouche de tous ses prophètes. L''Eternel dit: Tu le séduiras, et tu en viendras à bout; sors, et fais ainsi.
verses.am: እርሱም። ወጥቼ በነቢያቱ ሁሉ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስ እሆናለሁ አለ። እግዚአብሔርም። ታታልለዋለህ፤ ይቀናሃል፤ ውጣ፥ እንዲህም አድርግ አለ።

verses.en: Now therefore, behold, the Lord hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the Lord hath spoken evil against thee.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, voici, l''Eternel a mis un esprit de mensonge dans la bouche de tes prophètes qui sont là. Et l''Eternel a prononcé du mal contre toi.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በነቢያትህ አፍ ሐሰተኛ መንፈስን አድርጎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በአንተ ላይ ክፉ ተናግሮብሃል።

verses.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak unto thee?
verses.fr: Alors Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, s''étant approché, frappa Michée sur la joue, et dit: Par quel chemin l''esprit de l''Eternel est-il sorti de moi pour te parler?
verses.am: የክንዓናም ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ ቀረበ፥ ሚክያስንም በጥፊ መታውና። የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ከአንተ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ በምን መንገድ ከእኔ አለፈ? አለ።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.fr: Michée répondit: Tu le verras au jour où tu iras de chambre en chambre pour te cacher.
verses.am: ሚክያስም። እነሆ፥ በዚያ ቀን ልትሸሸግ ወደ እልፍኝህ ስትሄድ ታያለህ አለ።

verses.en: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit: Prenez Michée et emmenez-le vers Amon, chef de la ville, et vers Joas, fils du roi.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ። ሚክያስን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም አለቃ ወደ አሞን፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ መልሳችሁ።

verses.en: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
verses.fr: Vous direz: Ainsi parle le roi: Mettez cet homme en prison, et nourrissez-le du pain et de l''eau d''affliction, jusqu''à ce que je revienne en paix.
verses.am: ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል። በደኅና እስክመለስ ድረስ ይህን ሰው በግዞት አኑሩት፥ የመከራም እንጀራ መግቡት፥ የመከራም ውኃ አጠጡት በሉ አለ።

verses.en: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the Lord spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
verses.fr: Et Michée dit: Si tu reviens en paix, l''Eternel n''a point parlé par moi. Il dit encore: Vous tous, peuples, entendez!
verses.am: ሚክያስም። በደህና ብትመለስ እግዚአብሔር በእኔ የተናገረ አይደለም አለ። ደግሞም። እናንተ ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥ ስሙኝ አለ።

verses.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, montèrent à Ramoth en Galaad.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ወጡ።

verses.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and I will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Israël dit à Josaphat: Je veux me déguiser pour aller au combat; mais toi, revêts-toi de tes habits. Et le roi d''Israël se déguisa, et ils allèrent au combat.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ንጉሥም ኢዮሣፍጥን። ልብሴን ለውጬ ወደ ሰልፍ እገባለሁ፤ አንተ ግን ልብስህን ልበስ አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ልብሱን ለወጠ፥ ወደ ሰልፍም ገቡ።

verses.en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.
verses.fr: Le roi de Syrie avait donné cet ordre aux chefs de ses chars: Vous n''attaquerez ni petit ni grand, mais vous attaquerez seulement le roi d''Israël.
verses.am: የሶርያም ንጉሥ የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች። ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ በቀር ትንሽ ቢሆን ወይም ትልቅ ከማናቸውም ጋር አትጋጠሙ ብሎ አዝዞ ነበር።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
verses.fr: Quand les chefs des chars aperçurent Josaphat, ils dirent: C''est le roi d''Israël. Et ils l''entourèrent pour l''attaquer. Josaphat poussa un cri, et l''Eternel le secourut, et Dieu les écarta de lui.
verses.am: የሰረገሎችም አለቆች ኢዮሣፍጥን ባዩ ጊዜ። የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነው አሉ፥ ሊጋጠሙትም ከበቡት፤ ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን ጮኸ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ረዳው፥ አምላኩም ከእርሱ መለሳቸው።

verses.en: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
verses.fr: Les chefs des chars, voyant que ce n''était pas le roi d''Israël, s''éloignèrent de lui.
verses.am: የሰረገሎቹም አለቆች የእስራኤል ንጉሥ እንዳልሆነ ባዩ ጊዜ እርሱን ከማሳደድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.fr: Alors un homme tira de son arc au hasard, et frappa le roi d''Israël au défaut de la cuirasse. Le roi dit à celui qui dirigeait son char: Tourne, et fais-moi sortir du champ de bataille, car je suis blessé.
verses.am: አንድ ሰውም ቀስቱን በድንገት ገትሮ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ በጥሩሩ መጋጠሚያ በኩል ሳምባውን ወጋው። ሰረጋለኛውንም። ተወግቻለሁና እጅህን ግታ ከሰልፍም ውስጥ አውጣኝ አለው።

verses.en: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
verses.fr: Le combat devint acharné ce jour-là. Le roi d''Israël fut retenu dans son char, en face des Syriens, jusqu''au soir, et il mourut vers le coucher du soleil.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሰልፍ በረታ፤ የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በሶሪያውያን ፊት እስከ ማታ ድረስ በሰረገላው ላይ ራሱን ይደግፍ ነበር፤ ፀሐይም በገባ ጊዜ ሞተ።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Josaphat, roi de Juda, revint en paix dans sa maison à Jérusalem.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በደኅና ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the Lord? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the Lord.
verses.fr: Jéhu, fils de Hanani, le prophète, alla au-devant de lui. Et il dit au roi Josaphat: Doit-on secourir le méchant, et aimes-tu ceux qui haïssent l''Eternel? A cause de cela, l''Eternel est irrité contre toi.
verses.am: ባለ ራእዩ የአናኒ ልጅ ኢዩ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፥ ንጉሡንም ኢዮሣፍጥን። ከሐዲውን ታግዛለህን? ወይስ እግዚአብሔርን የሚጠሉትን ትወድዳለህን? ስለዚህም ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ቍጣ ሆኖብሃል።

verses.en: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.
verses.fr: Mais il s''est trouvé de bonnes choses en toi, car tu as fait disparaître du pays les idoles, et tu as appliqué ton coeur à chercher Dieu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹን ከምድር አስወግደሃልና፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ትፈልግ ዘንድ ልብህን አዘጋጅተሃልና መልካም ነገር ተገኝቶብሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the Lord God of their fathers.
verses.fr: Josaphat resta à Jérusalem. Puis il fit encore une tournée parmi le peuple, depuis Beer-Schéba jusqu''à la montagne d''Ephraïm, et il les ramena à l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጠ፤ ደግሞም ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ተራራማው እስከ ኤፍሬም አገር ድረስ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወጥቶ ወደ አባቶቻቸው አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መለሳቸው።

verses.en: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,
verses.fr: Il établit des juges dans toutes les villes fortes du pays de Juda, dans chaque ville.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ በተመሸጉት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ በእያንዳንዱ ከተማ ውስጥ ፈራጆች አኖረ።

verses.en: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the Lord, who is with you in the judgment.
verses.fr: Et il dit aux juges: Prenez garde à ce que vous ferez, car ce n''est pas pour les hommes que vous prononcerez des jugements; c''est pour l''Eternel, qui sera près de vous quand vous les prononcerez.
verses.am: ፈራጆቹንም። ለእግዚአብሔር እንጂ ለሰው አትፈርዱምና፥ እርሱም በፍርድ ነገር ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና የምታደርጉትን ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Wherefore now let the fear of the Lord be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the Lord our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
verses.fr: Maintenant, que la crainte de l''Eternel soit sur vous; veillez sur vos actes, car il n''y a chez l''Eternel, notre Dieu, ni iniquité, ni égards pour l''apparence des personnes, ni acceptation de présents.
verses.am: አሁንም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በእናንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በደልና ለሰው ፊት ማድላት መማለጃም መውሰድ የለምና ሁሉን ተጠንቅቃችሁ አድርጉ አላቸው።

verses.en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the Lord, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Quand on fut de retour à Jérusalem, Josaphat y établit aussi, pour les jugements de l''Eternel et pour les contestations, des Lévites, des sacrificateurs et des chefs de maisons paternelles d''Israël.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከሌዋውያንና ከካህናት ከእስራኤልም የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች፥ በእግዚአብሔር ስም ፍርድን እንዲፈርዱ ክርክርንም እንዲቈርጡ በኢየሩሳሌም ሾመ። እነርሱም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the Lord, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
verses.fr: Et voici les ordres qu''il leur donna: Vous agirez de la manière suivante dans la crainte de l''Eternel, avec fidélité et avec intégrité de coeur.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው። እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት በቅንነትም በፍጹምም ልብ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in your cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the Lord, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
verses.fr: Dans toute contestation qui vous sera soumise par vos frères, établis dans leurs villes, relativement à un meurtre, à une loi, à un commandement, à des préceptes et à des ordonnances, vous les éclairerez, afin qu''ils ne se rendent pas coupables envers l''Eternel, et que sa colère n''éclate pas sur vous et sur vos frères. C''est ainsi que vous agirez, et vous ne serez point coupables.
verses.am: በከተሞቻቸውም ከተቀመጡት ከወንድሞቻችሁ በደምና በደም መካከል በሕግና በትእዛዝ በሥርዓትና በፍርድም መካከል ያለ ማናቸውም ነገር ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ እግዚአብሔርን እንዳይበድሉ፥ ቍጣም በእናንተና በወንድሞቻችሁ ላይ እንዳይመጣ አስጠንቅቁአቸው፤ እንዲህም ብታደርጉ በደለኞች አትሆኑም።

verses.en: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the Lord; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the Lord shall be with the good.
verses.fr: Et voici, vous avez à votre tête Amaria, le souverain sacrificateur, pour toutes les affaires de l''Eternel, et Zebadia, fils d''Ismaël, chef de la maison de Juda, pour toutes les affaires du roi, et vous avez devant vous des Lévites comme magistrats. Fortifiez-vous et agissez, et que l''Eternel soit avec celui qui fera le bien!
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሚሆነው ነገር ሁሉ የካህናቱ አለቃ አማርያ፥ በንጉሡም ነገር ሁሉ የይሁዳ ቤት አለቃ የይስማኤል ልጅ ዝባድያ በላያችሁ ተሾመዋል፤ ሌዋውያኑም ደግሞ በፊታችሁ አለቆች ይሆናሉ፤ በርትታችሁም አድርጉ፥ እግዚአብሔርም መልካም ከሚያደርግ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
verses.fr: Après cela, les fils de Moab et les fils d''Ammon, et avec eux des Maonites, marchèrent contre Josaphat pour lui faire la guerre.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከዚህ በኋላ የሞዓብና የአሞን ልጆች ከእነርሱም ጋር ምዑናውያን ኢዮሣፍጥን ሊወጉ መጡ።

verses.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazontamar, which is Engedi.
verses.fr: On vint en informer Josaphat, en disant: Une multitude nombreuse s''avance contre toi depuis l''autre côté de la mer, depuis la Syrie, et ils sont à Hatsatson-Thamar, qui est En-Guédi.
verses.am: ወሬኞችም መጥተው። ከባሕሩ ማዶ ከሶሪያ ታላቅ ሠራዊት መጥቶብሃል፤ እነሆም፥ ዓይንጋዲ በተባለች በሐሴሶን ታማር ናቸው ብለው ለኢዮሣፍጥ ነገሩት።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the Lord, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
verses.fr: Dans sa frayeur, Josaphat se disposa à chercher l''Eternel, et il publia un jeûne pour tout Juda.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ፈራ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ሊፈልግ ፊቱን አቀና፤ በይሁዳም ሁሉ ጾም አወጀ።

verses.en: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the Lord: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the Lord.
verses.fr: Juda s''assembla pour invoquer l''Eternel, et l''on vint de toutes les villes de Juda pour chercher l''Eternel.
verses.am: ይሁዳም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ተከማቸ፤ ከይሁዳ ከተሞችም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ መጡ።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, before the new court,
verses.fr: Josaphat se présenta au milieu de l''assemblée de Juda et de Jérusalem, dans la maison de l''Eternel, devant le nouveau parvis.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ጉባኤ መካከል በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በአዲሱ አደባባይ ፊት ቆመ፤

verses.en: And said, O Lord God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
verses.fr: Et il dit: Eternel, Dieu de nos pères, n''es-tu pas Dieu dans les cieux, et n''est-ce pas toi qui domines sur tous les royaumes des nations? N''est-ce pas toi qui as en main la force et la puissance, et à qui nul ne peut résister?
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። አቤቱ የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ አንተ አይደለህምን? የአሕዛብንስ መንግሥታት ሁሉ የምትገዛ አንተ አይደለህምን? ኃይልና ችሎታ በእጅህ ነው፥ ሊቋቋምህም የሚችል የለም።

verses.en: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas toi, ô notre Dieu, qui as chassé les habitants de ce pays devant ton peuple d''Israël, et qui l''as donné pour toujours à la postérité d''Abraham qui t''aimait?
verses.am: አምላካችን ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምድር የነበሩትን አሕዛብ ከሕዝብህ ከእስራኤል ፊት ያሳደድህ፥ ለወዳጅህም ለአብርሃም ዘር ለዘላለም የሰጠሃት አንተ አይደለህምን?

verses.en: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
verses.fr: Ils l''ont habité, et ils t''y ont bâti un sanctuaire pour ton nom, en disant:
verses.am: እነርሱም የተቀመጡባት፥ ለስምህም መቅደስን ሠርተውባት።

verses.en: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
verses.fr: S''il nous survient quelque calamité, l''épée, le jugement, la peste ou la famine, nous nous présenterons devant cette maison et devant toi, car ton nom est dans cette maison, nous crierons à toi du sein de notre détresse, et tu exauceras et tu sauveras!
verses.am: ክፉ ነገር፥ የፍርድ ሰይፍ ወይም ቸነፈር ወይም ራብ፥ ቢመጣብን ስምህ ባለበት በዚህ ቤት ፊትና በፊትህ ቆመን በመከራችን ወደ አንተ እንጮኻለን፥ አንተም ሰምተህ ታድነናለህ አሉ።

verses.en: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
verses.fr: Maintenant voici, les fils d''Ammon et de Moab et ceux de la montagne de Séir, chez lesquels tu n''as pas permis à Israël d''entrer quand il venait du pays d''Egypte, -car il s''est détourné d''eux et ne les a pas détruits, -
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ እስራኤል ከግብጽ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ ያልፉባቸው ዘንድ ያልፈቀድህላቸው፥ ነገር ግን ፈቀቅ ብለው ያላጠፉአቸው፥ የአሞንና የሞዓብ ልጆች የሴይርም ተራራ ሰዎች፥

verses.en: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
verses.fr: les voici qui nous récompensent en venant nous chasser de ton héritage, dont tu nous as mis en possession.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለወሮታችን ክፋት ይመልሱልናል፤ ከሰጠኸንም ርስት ያወጡን ዘንድ መጥተዋል።

verses.en: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
verses.fr: O notre Dieu, n''exerceras-tu pas tes jugements sur eux? Car nous sommes sans force devant cette multitude nombreuse qui s''avance contre nous, et nous ne savons que faire, mais nos yeux sont sur toi.
verses.am: አምላካችን ሆይ፥ አንተ አትፈርድባቸውምን? ይህን የመጣብንን ታላቅ ወገን እንቃወም ዘንድ አንችልም፤ የምናደርገውንም አናውቅም፤ ነገር ግን ዓይኖቻችን ወደ አንተ ናቸው።

verses.en: And all Judah stood before the Lord, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.fr: Tout Juda se tenait debout devant l''Eternel, avec leurs petits enfants, leurs femmes et leurs fils.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ሁሉ ከሕፃናቶቻቸውና ከሚስቶቻቸው ከልጆቻቸውም ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the Lord in the midst of the congregation;
verses.fr: Alors l''esprit de l''Eternel saisit au milieu de l''assemblée Jachaziel, fils de Zacharie, fils de Benaja, fils de Jeïel, fils de Matthania, Lévite, d''entre les fils d''Asaph.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ ከአሳፍ ወገን በነበረው በሌዋዊው በማታንያ ልጅ በይዒኤል ልጅ በበናያስ ልጅ በዘካሪያስ ልጅ በየሕዚኤል ላይ በጉባኤው መካከል መጣ፤

verses.en: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the Lord unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.
verses.fr: Et Jachaziel dit: Soyez attentifs, tout Juda et habitants de Jérusalem, et toi, roi Josaphat! Ainsi vous parle l''Eternel: Ne craignez point et ne vous effrayez point devant cette multitude nombreuse, car ce ne sera pas vous qui combattrez, ce sera Dieu.
verses.am: እንዲህም አለ። ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ፥ አንተም ንጉሡ ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላችኋል። ሰልፉ የእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ የእናንተ አይደለምና ከዚህ ታላቅ ወገን የተነሣ አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡም።

verses.en: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.fr: Demain, descendez contre eux; ils vont monter par la colline de Tsits, et vous les trouverez à l''extrémité de la vallée, en face du désert de Jeruel.
verses.am: ነገ በእነርሱ ላይ ውረዱ፤ እነሆ፥ በጺጽ ዓቀበት ይወጣሉ፤ በሸለቆውም መጨረሻ በይሩኤል ምድረ በዳ ፊት ለፊት ታገኙአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the Lord with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the Lord will be with you.
verses.fr: Vous n''aurez point à combattre en cette affaire: présentez-vous, tenez-vous là, et vous verrez la délivrance que l''Eternel vous accordera. Juda et Jérusalem, ne craignez point et ne vous effrayez point, demain, sortez à leur rencontre, et l''Eternel sera avec vous!
verses.am: እናንተ በዚህ ሰልፍ የምትዋጉ አይደላችሁም፤ ይሁዳና ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ተሰለፉ፥ ዝም ብላችሁ ቁሙ፥ የሚሆነውንም የእግዚአብሔርን መድኃኒት እዩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡም፥ ነገም ውጡባቸው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the Lord, worshipping the Lord.
verses.fr: Josaphat s''inclina le visage contre terre, et tout Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem tombèrent devant l''Eternel pour se prosterner en sa présence.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም በምድር ላይ ተደፋ ይሁዳም ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደቁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the Lord God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
verses.fr: Les Lévites d''entre les fils des Kehathites et d''entre les fils des Koréites se levèrent pour célébrer d''une voix forte et haute l''Eternel, le Dieu d''Israël.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም፥ የቀዓት ልጆችና የቆሬ ልጆች፥ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን በእጅግ ታላቅ ድምፅ ያመሰገኑት ዘንድ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the Lord your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, ils se mirent en marche de grand matin pour le désert de Tekoa. A leur départ, Josaphat se présenta et dit: Ecoutez-moi, Juda et habitants de Jérusalem! Confiez-vous en l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et vous serez affermis; confiez-vous en ses prophètes, et vous réussirez.
verses.am: ማልደውም ተነሡ፥ ወደ ቴቁሔም ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ ሲወጡም ኢዮሣፍጥ ቆመና። ይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ፥ ትጸኑማላችሁ፤ በነቢያቱም እመኑ፥ ነገሩም ይሰላላችኋል አለ።

verses.en: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the Lord, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the Lord; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.fr: Puis, d''accord avec le peuple, il nomma des chantres qui, revêtus d''ornements sacrés, et marchant devant l''armée, célébraient l''Eternel et disaient: Louez l''Eternel, car sa miséricorde dure à toujours!
verses.am: ከሕዝቡም ጋር ተማክሮ በሠራዊቱ ፊት የሚሄዱትን። ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ የሚሉትንም፥ ጌጠኛ ልብስም ለብሰው የሚያመሰግኑትን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚዘምሩትን መዘምራን አቆመ።

verses.en: And when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
verses.fr: Au moment où l''on commençait les chants et les louanges, l''Eternel plaça une embuscade contre les fils d''Ammon et de Moab et ceux de la montagne de Séir, qui étaient venus contre Juda. Et ils furent battus.
verses.am: ዝማሬውንና ምስጋናውንም በጀመሩ ጊዜ ይሁዳን ሊወጉ በመጡት በአሞንና በሞዓብ ልጆች በሴይርም ተራራ ሰዎች ላይ እግዚአብሔር ድብቅ ጦርን አመጣባቸው፤ እነርሱም ተመቱ።

verses.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Ammon et de Moab se jetèrent sur les habitants de la montagne de Séir pour les dévouer par interdit et les exterminer; et quand ils en eurent fini avec les habitants de Séir, ils s''aidèrent les uns les autres à se détruire.
verses.am: የአሞንና የሞዓብ ልጆችም በሴይር ተራራ በሚኖሩት ላይ ፈጽመው ይገድሉአቸው ዘንድ ያጠፉአቸውም ዘንድ ተነሥተውባቸው ነበር፤ በሴይርም የሚኖሩትን ካጠፉ በኋላ እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራውን ለማጥፋት ተረዳዳ።

verses.en: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.fr: Lorsque Juda fut arrivé sur la hauteur d''où l''on aperçoit le désert, ils regardèrent du côté de la multitude, et voici, c''étaient des cadavres étendus à terre, et personne n''avait échappé.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ሰዎች ወደ ምድረ በዳ ግንብ በመጡ ጊዜ ሕዝቡን አዩ፤ እነሆም፥ በምድሩ ሁሉ ሬሳ ሞልቶ ነበር፥ ያመለጠም ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.fr: Josaphat et son peuple allèrent prendre leurs dépouilles; ils trouvèrent parmi les cadavres d''abondantes richesses et des objets précieux, et ils en enlevèrent tant qu''ils ne purent tout emporter. Ils mirent trois jours au pillage du butin, car il était considérable.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥና ሕዝቡም ምርኮ ይወስዱ ዘንድ መጡ ብዙ ከብትና ልዩ ልዩ ዕቃም፥ ልብስም፥ እጅግም ያማረ ዕቃ አገኙ፥ በዘበዙትም፥ ሁሉንም ይሸከሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤ ከምርኮውም ብዛት የተነሣ እስከ ሦስት ቀን ድረስ ይበዘብዙ ነበር።

verses.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the Lord: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.fr: Le quatrième jour, ils s''assemblèrent dans la vallée de Beraca, où ils bénirent l''Eternel; c''est pourquoi ils appelèrent ce lieu vallée de Beraca, nom qui lui est resté jusqu''à ce jour.
verses.am: በአራተኛውም ቀን በበረከት ሸለቆ ውስጥ ተሰበሰቡ፥ በዚያም እግዚአብሔርን ባረኩ፤ ስለዚህም ያ ስፍራ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የበረከት ሸለቆ ተባለ።

verses.en: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the Lord had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.fr: Tous les hommes de Juda et de Jérusalem, ayant à leur tête Josaphat, partirent joyeux pour retourner à Jérusalem, car l''Eternel les avait remplis de joie en les délivrant de leurs ennemis.
verses.am: የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች፥ በፊታቸውም ኢዮሣፍጥ፥ እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶቻቸው ላይ ደስ አሰኝቶአቸዋልና በደስታ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሄዱ ዘንድ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils entrèrent à Jérusalem et dans la maison de l''Eternel, au son des luths, des harpes et des trompettes.
verses.am: በበገናም በመሰንቆም በመለከትም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ገቡ።

verses.en: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the Lord fought against the enemies of Israel.
verses.fr: La terreur de l''Eternel s''empara de tous les royaumes des autres pays, lorsqu''ils apprirent que l''Eternel avait combattu contre les ennemis d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእስራኤልን ጠላቶች እንደ ወጋ በሰሙ ጊዜ በምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ የእግዚአብሔር ፍርሃት ሆነ።

verses.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
verses.fr: Et le royaume de Josaphat fut tranquille, et son Dieu lui donna du repos de tous côtés.
verses.am: የኢዮሣፍጥም መንግሥት ጸጥ አለች፥ አምላኩም በዙሪያው ካሉ አሳረፈው።

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.fr: Josaphat régna sur Juda. Il avait trente-cinq ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna vingt-cinq ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Azuba, fille de Schilchi.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥ በይሁዳ ላይ ነገሠ፤ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜም የሠላሳ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም የሺልሒ ልጅ ዓዙባ ነበረች።

verses.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans la voie de son père Asa, et ne s''en détourna point, faisant ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በአባቱም በአሳ መንገድ ሄደ፥ ከእርሱም ፈቀቅ አላለም፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን አደረገ።

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
verses.fr: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne disparurent point, et le peuple n''avait point encore le coeur fermement attaché au Dieu de ses pères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች አልተወገዱም፤ ሕዝቡም ገና ልባቸውን ወደ አባቶቻቸው አምላክ አላዘጋጁም ነበር።

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
verses.fr: Le reste des actions de Josaphat, les premières et les dernières, cela est écrit dans les mémoires de Jéhu, fils de Hanani, lesquels sont insérés dans le livre des rois d''Israël.
verses.am: የቀረውም የፊተኛውና የኋለኛው የኢዮሣፍጥ ነገር፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ውስጥ በሚገኘው በአናኒ ልጅ በኢዩ ታሪክ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
verses.fr: Après cela, Josaphat, roi de Juda, s''associa avec le roi d''Israël, Achazia, dont la conduite était impie.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ሥራው እጅግ ክፉ ከሆነ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከአካዝያስ ጋር ተባበረ።

verses.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongaber.
verses.fr: Il s''associa avec lui pour construire des navires destinés à aller à Tarsis, et ils firent les navires à Etsjon-Guéber.
verses.am: ወደ ተርሴስም የሚሄዱትን መርከቦች ያሠሩ ዘንድ አንድ ሆኑ፤ መርከቦቹንም በዔጽዮንጋብር አሠሩ።

verses.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the Lord hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.fr: Alors Eliézer, fils de Dodava, de Maréscha, prophétisa contre Josaphat, et dit: Parce que tu t''es associé avec Achazia, l''Eternel détruit ton oeuvre. Et les navires furent brisés, et ne purent aller à Tarsis.
verses.am: የመሪሳም ሰው የዶዳያ ልጅ አልዓዛር። ከአካዝያስ ጋር ተባብረሃልና እግዚአብሔር ሥራህን አፍርሶታል ብሎ በኢዮሣፍጥ ላይ ትንቢት ተናገረ። መርከቦቹም ተሰበሩ፥ ወደ ተርሴስም ይሄዱ ዘንድ አልቻሉም።

verses.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Josaphat se coucha avec ses pères, et il fut enterré avec ses pères dans la ville de David. Et Joram, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ ከአባቶቹ ጋር ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኢዮራም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
verses.fr: Joram avait des frères, fils de Josaphat: Azaria, Jehiel, Zacharie, Azaria, Micaël et Schephathia, tous fils de Josaphat, roi d''Israël.
verses.am: ለእርሱም የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ዓዛርያስ፥ ይሒኤል፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ዔዛርያስ፥ ሚካኤል፥ ሰፋጥያስ የሚባሉ ወንድሞች ነበሩት፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
verses.fr: Leur père leur avait donné des présents considérables en argent, en or, et en objets précieux, avec des villes fortes en Juda; mais il laissa le royaume à Joram, parce qu''il était le premier-né.
verses.am: አባታቸውም ብዙ ስጦታ፥ ብርና ወርቅ፥ የከበረም ዕቃ፥ በይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ሰጣቸው፤ መንግሥቱን ግን በኵር ልጁ ስለ ሆነ ለኢዮራም ሰጠ።

verses.en: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
verses.fr: Lorsque Joram eut pris possession du royaume de son père et qu''il se fut fortifié, il fit mourir par l''épée tous ses frères et quelques-uns aussi des chefs d''Israël.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም በአባቱ መንግሥት ላይ ተነሥቶ በጸና ጊዜ ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ ሌሎችንም የእስራኤልን መሳፍንት በሰይፍ ገደለ።

verses.en: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Joram avait trente-deux ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna huit ans à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ።

verses.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans la voie des rois d''Israël, comme avait fait la maison d''Achab, car il avait pour femme une fille d''Achab, et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአክአብንም ልጅ አግብቶ ነበርና የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።

verses.en: Howbeit the Lord would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.fr: Mais l''Eternel ne voulut point détruire la maison de David, à cause de l''alliance qu''il avait traitée avec David et de la promesse qu''il avait faite de lui donner toujours une lampe, à lui et à ses fils.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከዳዊት ጋር ስላደረገው ቃል ኪዳን፥ ለእርሱና ለልጆቹም በዘመናት ሁሉ መብራት ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስለ ሰጠው ተስፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር የዳዊትን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ አልወደደም።

verses.en: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
verses.fr: De son temps, Edom se révolta contre l''autorité de Juda, et se donna un roi.
verses.am: በእርሱም ዘመን ኤዶምያስ በይሁዳ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ ለራሱም ንጉሥ አነገሠ።

verses.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.fr: Joram partit avec ses chefs et tous ses chars; s''étant levé de nuit, il battit les Edomites qui l''entouraient et les chefs des chars.
verses.am: ኢዮራምም ከአለቆቹና ከሰረገሎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ተሻገረ፤ በሌሊትም ተነሥቶ እርሱንና የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች ከብበው የነበሩትን የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች መታ።

verses.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the Lord God of his fathers.
verses.fr: La rébellion d''Edom contre l''autorité de Juda a duré jusqu''à ce jour. Libna se révolta dans le même temps contre son autorité, parce qu''il avait abandonné l''Eternel, le Dieu de ses pères.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስ ግን በይሁዳ ላይ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዐመፀ፥ በዚያንም ዘመን ልብና ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ዐመፀ፥ የአባቶቹን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትቶ ነበርና።

verses.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.
verses.fr: Joram fit même des hauts lieux dans les montagnes de Juda; il poussa les habitants de Jérusalem à la prostitution, et il séduisit Juda.
verses.am: ዳግምም በይሁዳ ተራሮች ላይ መስገጃዎችን ሠራ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የተቀመጡትን እንዲያመነዝሩ አደረጋቸው፥ ይሁዳንም አሳተው።

verses.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
verses.fr: Il lui vint un écrit du prophète Elie, disant: Ainsi parle l''Eternel, le Dieu de David, ton père: Parce que tu n''as pas marché dans les voies de Josaphat, ton père, et dans les voies d''Asa, roi de Juda,
verses.am: ከነቢዩም ከኤልያስ እንዲህ የሚል ጽሕፈት መጣባት። የአባትህ የዳዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። በአባትህ በኢዮሣፍጥ መንገድ በይሁዳም ንጉሥ በአሳ መንገድ አልሄድህምና፥

verses.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
verses.fr: mais que tu as marché dans la voie des rois d''Israël; parce que tu as entraîné à la prostitution Juda et les habitants de Jérusalem, comme l''a fait la maison d''Achab à l''égard d''Israël; et parce que tu as fait mourir tes frères, meilleurs que toi, la maison même de ton père; -
verses.am: በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ግን ሄደሃልና፥ የአክዓብም ቤት እንዳደረገ ይሁዳንና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን እንዲያመነዝሩ አድርገሃልና፥ ከአንተም የሚሻሉትን የአባትህን ቤት ወንድሞችህን ገድለሃልና፥

verses.en: Behold, with a great plague will the Lord smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
verses.fr: voici, l''Eternel frappera ton peuple d''une grande plaie, tes fils, tes femmes, et tout ce qui t''appartient;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝብህንና ልጆችህን ሚስቶችህንም ያለህንም ሁሉ በታላቅ መቅሠፍት ይቀሥፋል።

verses.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.fr: et toi, il te frappera d''une maladie violente, d''une maladie d''entrailles, qui augmentera de jour en jour jusqu''à ce que tes entrailles sortent par la force du mal.
verses.am: አንተም ከደዌው ጽናት የተነሣ አንጀትህ በየዕለቱ እስኪወጣ ድረስ በክፉ የአንጀት ደዌ ትታመማለህ።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel excita contre Joram l''esprit des Philistins et des Arabes qui sont dans le voisinage des Ethiopiens.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን የፍልስጥኤማውያንና በኢትዮጵያውያን አጠገብ የሚኖሩትን የዓረባውያንን መንፈስ በኢዮራም ላይ አስነሣ።

verses.en: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.fr: Ils montèrent contre Juda, y firent une invasion, pillèrent toutes les richesses qui se trouvaient dans la maison du roi, et emmenèrent ses fils et ses femmes, de sorte qu''il ne lui resta d''autre fils que Joachaz, le plus jeune de ses fils.
verses.am: ወደ ይሁዳም ወጡ፥ አፈረሱአትም፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ ወንዶች ልጆቹንም ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ማረኩ፤ ከታናሹም ልጅ ከአካዝያስ በቀር ልጅ አልቀረለትም።

verses.en: And after all this the Lord smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.fr: Après tout cela, l''Eternel le frappa d''une maladie d''entrailles qui était sans remède;
verses.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር በማይፈወስ ደዌ አንጀቱን ቀሰፈው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.fr: elle augmenta de jour en jour, et sur la fin de la seconde année les entrailles de Joram sortirent par la force de son mal. Il mourut dans de violentes souffrances; et son peuple ne brûla point de parfums en son honneur, comme il l''avait fait pour ses pères.
verses.am: ከቀንም ወደ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ከሁለት ዓመት በኋላ ከደዌው ጽናት የተነሣ አንጀቱ ወጣ፥ በክፉም ደዌ ሞተ። ሕዝቡም ለአባቶቹ ያደርገው እንደ ነበር ለእርሱ የመቃብር ወግ አላደረገም።

verses.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.fr: Il avait trente-deux ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna huit ans à Jérusalem. Il s''en alla sans être regretté, et on l''enterra dans la ville de David, mais non dans les sépulcres des rois.
verses.am: መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ ማንም ሳያዝንለት ሄደ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ እንጂ በነገሥታት መቃብር አልቀበሩትም።

verses.en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
verses.fr: Les habitants de Jérusalem firent régner à sa place Achazia, son plus jeune fils; car la troupe venue au camp avec les Arabes avait tué tous les plus âgés. Ainsi régna Achazia, fils de Joram, roi de Juda.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩትም ታናሹን ልጁን አካዝያስን በእርሱ ፋንታ አነገሡት። የመጣባቸው የዓረብና የአሊማዞን የሽፍቶች ጭፍራ የእርሱን ታላቆች ገድለዋቸው ነበርና። የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
verses.fr: Achazia avait quarante-deux ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna un an à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Athalie, fille d''Omri.
verses.am: አካዝያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ ዕድሜው አርባ ሁለት ዓመት ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ጎቶሊያ የተባለች የዘንበሪ ልጅ ነበረች።

verses.en: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
verses.fr: Il marcha dans les voies de la maison d''Achab, car sa mère lui donnait des conseils impies.
verses.am: እናቱም ክፉ ለማድረግ ትመክረው ነበርና እርሱ ደግሞ በአክዓብ ቤት መንገድ ሄደ።

verses.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the Lord like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux de l''Eternel, comme la maison d''Achab, où il eut après la mort de son père des conseillers pour sa perte.
verses.am: አባቱም ከሞተ በኋላ የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ መካሪዎች ነበሩትና።

verses.en: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
verses.fr: Entraîné par leur conseil, il alla avec Joram, fils d''Achab, roi d''Israël, à la guerre contre Hazaël, roi de Syrie, à Ramoth en Galaad. Et les Syriens blessèrent Joram.
verses.am: በምክራቸውም ሄደ፥ ከእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ከአክዓብ ልጅ ከኢዮራም ጋር የሶርያን ንጉሥ አዛሄልን በሬማት ዘገለአድ ሊዋጋ ሄደ፤ ሶርያውያንም ኢዮራንም አቈሰሉት።

verses.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.fr: Joram s''en retourna pour se faire guérir à Jizreel des blessures que les Syriens lui avaient faites à Rama, lorsqu''il se battait contre Hazaël, roi de Syrie. Azaria, fils de Joram, roi de Juda, descendit pour voir Joram, fils d''Achab, à Jizreel, parce qu''il était malade.
verses.am: ከሶርያም ንጉሥ ከአዛሄል ጋር በተዋጋ ጊዜ ሶርያውያን በሬማት ያቈሰሉትን ቍስል ይታከም ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ተመለሰ፤ ታምሞም ነበርና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮራም ልጅ አካዝያስ የአክዓብን ልጅ ኢዮራምን ያይ ዘንድ ወደ ኢይዝራኤል ወረደ።

verses.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.fr: Par la volonté de Dieu, ce fut pour sa ruine qu''Achazia se rendit auprès de Joram. Lorsqu''il fut arrivé, il sortit avec Joram pour aller au-devant de Jéhu, fils de Nimschi, que l''Eternel avait oint pour exterminer la maison d''Achab.
verses.am: አካዝያስም ወደ ኢዮራም በመምጣቱ ይጠፋ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበረ፤ በመጣም ጊዜ ከኢዮራም ጋር እግዚአብሔር የአክዓብን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ ወደ ቀባው ወደ ናሜሲ ልጅ ወደ ኢዩ ወጣ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
verses.fr: Et comme Jéhu faisait justice de la maison d''Achab, il trouva les chefs de Juda et les fils des frères d''Achazia, qui étaient au service d''Achazia, et il les tua.
verses.am: ኢዩም በአክዓብ ቤት ላይ ፍርድን ሲፈጽም የይሁዳን መሳፍንትና አካዝያስን ያገለግሉ የነበሩትን የአካዝያስን ወንድሞች ልጆች አግኝቶ ገደላቸው።

verses.en: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
verses.fr: Il chercha Achazia, et on le saisit dans Samarie, où il s''était caché. On l''amena auprès de Jéhu, et on le fit mourir. Puis ils l''enterrèrent, car ils disaient: C''est le fils de Josaphat, qui cherchait l''Eternel de tout son coeur. Et il ne resta personne de la maison d''Achazia qui fût en état de régner.
verses.am: አካዝያስንም ፈለገው፥ በሰማርያ ተሸሽጎ ሳለ አገኙት፤ ወደ ኢዩም አምጥተው ገደሉትና። በፍጹም ልብ እግዚአብሔርን የፈለገው የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጅ ነው ብለው ቀበሩት። ከአካዝያስም ቤት ማንም መንግሥትን ይይዝ ዘንድ የሚችል አልነበረም።

verses.en: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
verses.fr: Athalie, mère d''Achazia, voyant que son fils était mort, se leva et fit périr toute la race royale de la maison de Juda.
verses.am: የአካዝያስም እናት ጎቶሊያ ልጅዋ እንደ ሞተ ባየች ጊዜ ተነሥታ የይሁዳን ቤተ መንግሥት ዘር ሁሉ አጠፋች።

verses.en: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
verses.fr: Mais Joschabeath, fille du roi, prit Joas, fils d''Achazia, et l''enleva du milieu des fils du roi, quand on les fit mourir: elle le mit avec sa nourrice dans la chambre des lits. Ainsi Joschabeath, fille du roi Joram, femme du sacrificateur Jehojada, et soeur d''Achazia, le déroba aux regards d''Athalie, qui ne le fit point mourir.
verses.am: የንጉሡ ልጅ ዮሳቤት ግን ከተገደሉት ከንጉሡ ልጆች መካከል የአካዝያስን ልጅ ኢዮአስን ሰርቃ ወሰደች፤ እርሱንና ሞግዚቱን በእልፍኝ ውስጥ አኖረቻቸው፤ ጎቶሊያ እንዳታስገድለው የንጉሡ የኢዮራም ልጅ የአካዛያስ እኅት የካህኑ የዮዳሄ ሚስት ዮሳቤት እንዲሁ ሸሸገችው።

verses.en: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.fr: Il resta six ans caché avec eux dans la maison de Dieu. Et c''était Athalie qui régnait dans le pays.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ዘንድ ተሸሽጎ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ስድስት ዓመት ያህል ተቀመጠ፤ ጎቶልያም በምድር ላይ ነገሠች።

verses.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
verses.fr: La septième année, Jehojada s''anima de courage, et traita alliance avec les chefs de centaines, Azaria, fils de Jerocham, Ismaël, fils de Jochanan, Azaria, fils d''Obed, Maaséja, fils d''Adaja, et Elischaphath, fils de Zicri.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ዓመት ዮዳሄ በረታ፥ የመቶ አለቆቹንም፥ የይሮሐምን ልጅ ዓዛርያስን፥ የይሆሐናንንም ልጅ ይስማኤልን፥ የዖቤድንም ልጅ ዓዛርያስን፥ የዓዳያንም ልጅ መዕሤያን፥ የዝክሪንም ልጅ ኤሊሳፋጥን ወስዶ ከእነርሱ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Ils parcoururent Juda, et ils rassemblèrent les Lévites de toutes les villes de Juda et les chefs de famille d''Israël; et ils vinrent à Jérusalem.
verses.am: ይሁዳንም ዞሩ፥ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ሌዋውያንንና የእስራኤልን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ሰብስበው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።

verses.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the Lord hath said of the sons of David.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée traita alliance avec le roi dans la maison de Dieu. Et Jehojada leur dit: Voici, le fils du roi régnera, comme l''Eternel l''a déclaré à l''égard des fils de David.
verses.am: ጉባኤውም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ከንጉሥ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ። ዮዳሄም አላቸው። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ዳዊት ልጆች እንደተናገረ የንጉሡ ልጅ ይነግሣል።

verses.en: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
verses.fr: Voici ce que vous ferez. Le tiers qui parmi vous entre en service le jour du sabbat, sacrificateurs et Lévites, fera la garde des seuils,
verses.am: የምታደርጉት ይህ ነው፤ በሰንበት ቀን ከምትገቡት ከእናንተ ከካህናትና ከሌዋዊውያን ከሦስት አንድ እጅ በመግቢያ በሮች በረኞች ሁኑ፤

verses.en: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: un autre tiers se tiendra dans la maison du roi, et un tiers à la porte de Jesod. Tout le peuple sera dans les parvis de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከሦስት አንድ እጅም በንጉሥ ቤት ሁኑ፤ አንድ እጅም በመካከለኛው በር ሁኑ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: But let none come into the house of the Lord, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the Lord.
verses.fr: Que personne n''entre dans la maison de l''Eternel, excepté les sacrificateurs et les Lévites de service: ils entreront, car ils sont saints. Et tout le peuple fera la garde de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ግን ከካህናትና ከአገልጋዮቹ ሌዋውያን በቀር ማንም አይግባ፤ እነርሱ ቅዱሳን ናቸውና ይግቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ይጠብቅ።

verses.en: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
verses.fr: Les Lévites entoureront le roi de toutes parts, chacun les armes à la main, et l''on donnera la mort à quiconque entrera dans la maison: vous serez près du roi quand il entrera et quand il sortira.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም የጦር መሣሪያቸውን በእጃቸው ይዘው ንጉሡን በዙሪያው ይክበቡት፤ ወደ ቤቱም የሚገባ ይገደል ንጉሡም ሲገባና ሲወጣ ከእርሱ ጋር ሁኑ።

verses.en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
verses.fr: Les Lévites et tout Juda exécutèrent tous les ordres qu''avait donnés le sacrificateur Jehojada. Ils prirent chacun leurs gens, ceux qui entraient en service et ceux qui sortaient de service le jour du sabbat; car le sacrificateur Jehojada n''avait exempté aucune des divisions.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንና ይሁዳም ሁሉ ካህኑ ዮዳሄ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ፤ ካህኑም ዮዳሄ ሰሞነኞቹን አላሰናበተም ነበርና እያንዳንዱ በሰንበት ቀን ይገቡ የነበሩትን በሰንበትም ቀን ይወጡ የነበሩትን ሰዎች ወሰደ።

verses.en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Jehojada remit aux chefs de centaines les lances et les boucliers, grands et petits, qui provenaient du roi David, et qui se trouvaient dans la maison de Dieu.
verses.am: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን የንጉሡን የዳዊትን ጋሻና ጦር አላባሽ አግሬውንም ጋሻ ለመቶ አለቆች ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
verses.fr: Il fit entourer le roi en plaçant tout le peuple, chacun les armes à la main, depuis le côté droit jusqu''au côté gauche de la maison, près de l''autel et près de la maison.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የጦር መሣሪያውን በእጁ እየያዘ በንጉሡ ዙሪያ ከቤቱ ቀኝ እስከ ቤቱ ግራ ድረስ በመሠዊያውና በቤቱ አጠገብ እንዲቆም አደረገ።

verses.en: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.
verses.fr: On fit avancer le fils du roi, on mit sur lui le diadème et le témoignage, et on l''établit roi. Et Jehojada et ses fils l''oignirent, et ils dirent: Vive le roi!
verses.am: የንጉሡንም ልጅ አውጥተው ዘውዱን ጫኑበት፥ ምስክሩንም ሰጡት፥ አነገሡትም፤ ዮዳሄና ልጆቹም። ንጉሡ ሺህ ዓመት ይንገሥ እያሉ ቀቡት።

verses.en: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the Lord:
verses.fr: Athalie entendit le bruit du peuple accourant et célébrant le roi, et elle vint vers le peuple à la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጎቶሊያም የሚሮጡትንና ንጉሡን የሚያመሰግኑትን የሕዝቡን ድምፅ በሰማች ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መጣች።

verses.en: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
verses.fr: Elle regarda. Et voici, le roi se tenait sur son estrade à l''entrée; les chefs et les trompettes étaient près du roi; tout le peuple du pays était dans la joie, et l''on sonnait des trompettes, et les chantres avec les instruments de musique dirigeaient les chants de louanges. Athalie déchira ses vêtements, et dit: Conspiration! conspiration!
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ንጉሡ በመግቢያው በዓምዱ አጠገብ ሆኖ ከንጉሡ ጋር አለቆችና መለከተኞች ቆመው አየች። የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው መለከቱን ይነፉ ነበር፤ መዘምራንም በዜማ ዕቃ እያዜሙ የምስጋና መዝሙር ይዘምሩ ነበር። ጎቶሊያም ልብስዋን ቀድዳ። ዓመፅ ነው፥ ዓመፅ ነው ብላ ጮኸች።

verses.en: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors le sacrificateur Jehojada, faisant approcher les chefs de centaines qui étaient à la tête de l''armée, leur dit: Faites-la sortir en dehors des rangs, et que l''on tue par l''épée quiconque la suivra. Car le sacrificateur avait dit: Ne la mettez pas à mort dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ዮዳሄ በጭፍራው ላይ የተሾሙትን የመቶ አለቆች። ወደ ሰልፉ መካከል አውጡአት፤ የሚከተላትም በሰይፍ ይገደል ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ካህኑም። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ አትግደሉአት አለ።

verses.en: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.
verses.fr: On lui fit place, et elle se rendit à la maison du roi par l''entrée de la porte des chevaux: c''est là qu''ils lui donnèrent la mort.
verses.am: ገለልም ብለው አሳለፉአት፤ እርስዋም ወደ ፈረሱ በር መግቢያ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ሄደች፥ በዚያም ገደሉአት።

verses.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the Lord's people.
verses.fr: Jehojada traita entre lui, tout le peuple et le roi, une alliance par laquelle ils devaient être le peuple de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም በእርሱና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ በንጉሡም መካከል የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።

verses.en: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple entra dans la maison de Baal, et ils la démolirent; ils brisèrent ses autels et ses images, et ils tuèrent devant les autels Matthan, prêtre de Baal.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ በኣል ቤት ሄደው አፈረሱት፥ መሠዊያዎቹንና ምስሎቹንም አደቀቁ፥ የበኣልንም ካህን ማታንን በመሠዊያው ፊት ገደሉት።

verses.en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the Lord by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the Lord, to offer the burnt offerings of the Lord, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.
verses.fr: Jehojada remit les fonctions de la maison de l''Eternel entre les mains des sacrificateurs, des Lévites, que David avait distribués dans la maison de l''Eternel pour qu''ils offrissent des holocaustes à l''Eternel, comme il est écrit dans la loi de Moïse, au milieu des réjouissances et des chants, d''après les ordonnances de David.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈው፥ እንደ ዳዊትም ትእዛዝ፥ በደስታና በመዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የከፈላቸውን ካህናትና ሌዋውያን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ላይ ሾመ።

verses.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the Lord, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
verses.fr: Il plaça les portiers aux portes de la maison de l''Eternel, afin qu''il n''entrât aucune personne souillée de quelque manière que ce fût.
verses.am: በማናቸውም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ የሆነ ሰው እንዳይገባ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር በረኞችን አኖረ።

verses.en: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the Lord: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
verses.fr: Il prit les chefs de centaines, les hommes considérés, ceux qui avaient autorité parmi le peuple, et tout le peuple du pays, et il fit descendre le roi de la maison de l''Eternel. Ils entrèrent dans la maison du roi par la porte supérieure, et ils firent asseoir le roi sur le trône royal.
verses.am: የመቶ አለቆችንም፥ ከበርቴዎቹንም፥ የሕዝቡንም አለቆች፥ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወሰደ፥ ንጉሡንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አወረደ፤ በላይኛውም በር በኩል ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት መጡ፥ ንጉሡንም በመንግሥቱ ዙፋን ላይ አኖሩት።

verses.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.fr: Tout le peuple du pays se réjouissait, et la ville était tranquille. On avait fait mourir Athalie par l''épée.
verses.am: የአገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ደስ አላቸው፥ ከተማይቱም ጸጥ አለች፤ ጎቶሊያንም በሰይፍ ገደሉአት። ች

verses.en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beersheba.
verses.fr: Joas avait sept ans lorsqu''il devint roi, et il régna quarante ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Tsibja, de Beer-Schéba.
verses.am: ኢዮአስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ሳብያ የተባለች የቤርሳቤህ ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.fr: Joas fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel pendant toute la vie du sacrificateur Jehojada.
verses.am: በካህኑም በዮዳሄ ዘመን ሁሉ ኢዮአስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ።

verses.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.fr: Jehojada prit pour Joas deux femmes, et Joas engendra des fils et des filles.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም ሁለት ሚስቶች አጋባው፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለደ።

verses.en: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Après cela, Joas eut la pensée de réparer la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮአስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይጠግን ዘንድ አሰበ።

verses.en: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
verses.fr: Il assembla les sacrificateurs et les Lévites, et leur dit: Allez par les villes de Juda, et vous recueillerez dans tout Israël de l''argent, chaque année, pour réparer la maison de votre Dieu; et mettez à cette affaire de l''empressement. Mais les Lévites ne se hâtèrent point.
verses.am: ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንንም ሰብስቦ። ወደ ይሁዳ ከተሞች ውጡ፥ የአምላካችሁንም ቤት በየዓመቱ ለማደስ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ገንዘብን ሰብስቡ፤ ነገሩንም ፈጥናችሁ አድርጉ አላቸው። ሌዋውያን ግን ቸል አሉ።

verses.en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the Lord, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
verses.fr: Le roi appela Jehojada, le souverain sacrificateur, et lui dit: Pourquoi n''as-tu pas veillé à ce que les Lévites apportassent de Juda et de Jérusalem l''impôt ordonné par Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, et mis sur l''assemblée d''Israël pour la tente du témoignage?
verses.am: ንጉሡም አለቃውን ዮዳሄን ጠርቶ። የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ ስለ ምስክሩ ድንኳን የእስራኤል ጉባኤ እንዲያዋጣ ያዘዘውን ግብር ከይሁዳና ከኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ሌዋውያንን አላተጋሃቸውም? አለው።

verses.en: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the Lord did they bestow upon Baalim.
verses.fr: Car l''impie Athalie et ses fils ont ravagé la maison de Dieu et fait servir pour les Baals toutes les choses consacrées à la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ጎቶሊያ ከሐዲት ነበረችና ልጆችዋም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አፍርሰዋልና፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ተቀድሶ የነበረውን ሁሉ ለበኣሊም ሰጥተዋልና።

verses.en: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors le roi ordonna qu''on fît un coffre, et qu''on le plaçât à la porte de la maison de l''Eternel, en dehors.
verses.am: ንጉሡም አዘዘ፥ ሣጥንም ሠርተው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር አጠገብ በስተ ውጭ አኖሩት።

verses.en: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the Lord the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Et l''on publia dans Juda et dans Jérusalem qu''on apportât à l''Eternel l''impôt mis par Moïse, serviteur de l''Eternel, sur Israël dans le désert.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ በእስራኤል ላይ ያዘዘውን ግብር ለእግዚአብሔር ያመጡ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም አዋጅ ነገሩ።

verses.en: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
verses.fr: Tous les chefs et tout le peuple s''en réjouirent, et l''on apporta et jeta dans le coffre tout ce qu''on avait à payer.
verses.am: አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው አቀረቡት፥ እስኪሞላም ድረስ በሣጥኑ ውስጥ ጣሉት።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.fr: Quand c''était le moment où les Lévites, voyant qu''il y avait beaucoup d''argent dans le coffre, devaient le livrer aux inspecteurs royaux, le secrétaire du roi et le commissaire du souverain sacrificateur venaient vider le coffre; ils le prenaient et le remettaient à sa place; ils faisaient ainsi journellement, et ils recueillirent de l''argent en abondance.
verses.am: ሣጥኑም በሌዋውያን እጅ ወደ ንጉሡ ሹማምት በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ ብዙ ገንዘብም እንዳለበት ባየ ጊዜ፥ የንጉሡ ጸሐፊና የዋነኛው ካህን ሹም እየመጡ ብሩን ከሣጥን ያወጡ ነበር፥ ሣጥኑንም ደግሞ ወደ ስፍራው ይመልሱት ነበር። እንዲሁም በየቀኑ ያደርጉ ነበር፥ ብዙም ገንዘብ አከማቹ።

verses.en: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Le roi et Jehojada le donnaient à ceux qui étaient chargés de faire exécuter l''ouvrage dans la maison de l''Eternel, et qui prenaient à gage des tailleurs de pierres et des charpentiers pour réparer la maison de l''Eternel, et aussi des ouvriers en fer ou en airain pour réparer la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ንጉሡና ዮዳሄም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሥራ ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰጡአቸው፤ እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የሚጠግኑትን ጠራቢዎችንና አናጢዎችን፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት የሚያድሱትን የብረትና የናስ ሠራተኞችን ይገዙበት ነበር።

verses.en: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
verses.fr: Ceux qui étaient chargés de l''ouvrage travaillèrent, et les réparations s''exécutèrent par leurs soins; ils remirent en état la maison de Dieu et la consolidèrent.
verses.am: ሠራተኞችም ሠሩ፥ የፈረሰውም በእጃቸው ተጠገነ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት እንደ ቀድሞው ሥራ መለሱ፥ አጽንተውም አቆሙት።

verses.en: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the Lord, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils eurent achevé, ils apportèrent devant le roi et devant Jehojada le reste de l''argent; et l''on en fit des ustensiles pour la maison de l''Eternel, des ustensiles pour le service et pour les holocaustes, des coupes, et d''autres ustensiles d''or et d''argent. Et, pendant toute la vie de Jehojada, on offrit continuellement des holocaustes dans la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በጨረሱም ጊዜ የተረፈውን ገንዘብ በንጉሡና በዮዳሄ ፊት አመጡ፤ እነርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ፥ ለአገልግሎትና ለቍርባን ዕቃ፥ ለጭልፋዎችም፥ ለወርቅና ለብርም ዕቃ አደረጉት። በዮዳሄም ዘመን ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሁልጊዜ ያቀርቡ ነበር።

verses.en: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
verses.fr: Jehojada mourut, âgé et rassasié de jours; il avait à sa mort cent trente ans.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም ሸመገለ፥ ዕድሜም ጠግቦ ሞተ፤ በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሠላሳ ዓመት ነበረ።

verses.en: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
verses.fr: On l''enterra dans la ville de David avec les rois, parce qu''il avait fait du bien en Israël, et à l''égard de Dieu et à l''égard de sa maison.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ጋር፥ ከእግዚአብሔርና ከቤቱም ጋር ቸርነትን ሠርቶአልና በዳዊት ከተማ ከነገሥታቱ ጋር ቀበሩት።

verses.en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
verses.fr: Après la mort de Jehojada, les chefs de Juda vinrent se prosterner devant le roi. Alors le roi les écouta.
verses.am: ዮዳሄም ከሞተ በኋላ የይሁዳ አለቆች ገብተው ለንጉሡ እጅ ነሡ፤ ንጉሡም እሺ አላቸው።

verses.en: And they left the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
verses.fr: Et ils abandonnèrent la maison de l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères, et ils servirent les Astartés et les idoles. La colère de l''Eternel fut sur Juda et sur Jérusalem, parce qu''ils s''étaient ainsi rendus coupables.
verses.am: የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንና ጣዖታትን አመለኩ፤ በዚህ በደላቸውም ምክንያት በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ቍጣ ወረደ።

verses.en: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the Lord; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
verses.fr: L''Eternel envoya parmi eux des prophètes pour les ramener à lui, mais ils n''écoutèrent point les avertissements qu''ils en reçurent.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ይመልሱአቸው ዘንድ ነቢያትን ይሰድድላቸው ነበር፤ መሰከሩባቸውም፥ እነርሱ ግን አላደመጡም።

verses.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the Lord, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the Lord, he hath also forsaken you.
verses.fr: Zacharie, fils du sacrificateur Jehojada, fut revêtu de l''esprit de Dieu; il se présenta devant le peuple et lui dit: Ainsi parle Dieu: Pourquoi transgressez-vous les commandements de l''Eternel? Vous ne prospérerez point; car vous avez abandonné l''Eternel, et il vous abandonnera.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በካህኑ በዮዳሄ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ላይ መጣ፤ እርሱም በሕዝቡ ፊት ቆመና። እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? መልካምም አይሆንላችሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርን ስለ ተዋችሁ እርሱ ትቶአችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et ils conspirèrent contre lui, et le lapidèrent par ordre du roi, dans le parvis de la maison de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ተማማሉበትም በንጉሡም ትእዛዝ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ውስጥ በድንጋይ ወገሩት።

verses.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The Lord look upon it, and require it.
verses.fr: Le roi Joas ne se souvint pas de la bienveillance qu''avait eue pour lui Jehojada, père de Zacharie, et il fit périr son fils. Zacharie dit en mourant: Que l''Eternel voie, et qu''il fasse justice!
verses.am: እንዲሁም ንጉሡ ኢዮአስ ዮዳሄ ያደረገለትን ቸርነት አላሰበም፥ ልጁንም ዘካርያስን አስገደለው፤ እርሱም ሲሞት። እግዚአብሔር ይየው፥ ይፈልገውም አለ።

verses.en: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
verses.fr: Quand l''année fut révolue, l''armée des Syriens monta contre Joas, et vint en Juda et à Jérusalem. Ils tuèrent parmi le peuple tous les chefs du peuple, et ils envoyèrent au roi de Damas tout leur butin.
verses.am: ዓመቱም ካለፈ በኋላ የሶርያውያን ሠራዊት መጡበት፤ ወደ ይሁዳና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጥተው ከሕዝቡ መካከል የሕዝቡን አለቆች ሁሉ አጠፉ፥ ምርኮአቸውንም ሁሉ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ደማስቆ ላኩ።

verses.en: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the Lord delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.fr: L''armée des Syriens arriva avec un petit nombre d''hommes; et cependant l''Eternel livra entre leurs mains une armée très considérable, parce qu''ils avaient abandonné l''Eternel, le Dieu de leurs pères. Et les Syriens firent justice de Joas.
verses.am: የሶርያውያንም ሠራዊት ቍጥር ጥቂት ሆኖ ሳለ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅን ሠራዊት አሳልፎ በእጃቸው ሰጣቸው፤ ይህም የሆነው የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ስለ ነበረ ነው። እነርሱም በኢዮአስ ላይ ፍርድ ፈረዱበት።

verses.en: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''ils se furent éloignés de lui, après l''avoir laissé dans de grandes souffrances, ses serviteurs conspirèrent contre lui à cause du sang des fils du sacrificateur Jehojada; ils le tuèrent sur son lit, et il mourut. On l''enterra dans la ville de David, mais on ne l''enterra pas dans les sépulcres des rois.
verses.am: ከእርሱም ዘንድ አልፈው ከሄዱ በኋላ እጅግ ታምሞ ነበር፤ የገዛ ባሪያዎቹም ስለ ካህኑ ስለ ዮዳሄ ልጅ ተበቅለው ተማማሉበት፥ በአልጋውም ላይ ገደሉት፥ ሞተም፤ በዳዊት ከተማ እንጂ በነገሥታት መቃብር አልቀበሩትም።

verses.en: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
verses.fr: Voici ceux qui conspirèrent contre lui: Zabad, fils de Schimeath, femme Ammonite, et Jozabad, fils de Schimrith, femme Moabite.
verses.am: የተማማሉበትም የአሞናዊቱ የሰምዓት ልጅ ዛባድ፥ የሞዓባዊቱም የሰማሪት ልጅ ዮዛባት ነበሩ።

verses.en: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.fr: Pour ce qui concerne ses fils, le grand nombre de prophéties dont il fut l''objet, et les réparations faites à la maison de Dieu, cela est écrit dans les mémoires sur le livre des rois. Amatsia, son fils, régna à sa place.
verses.am: የልጆቹና በእርሱ ላይ የተደረገው ነገር የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ማደሱ፥ እነሆ፥ በነገሥታቱ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል። ልጁም አሜስያስ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

verses.en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.fr: Amatsia devint roi à l''âge de vingt-cinq ans, et il régna vingt-neuf ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s''appelait Joaddan, de Jérusalem.
verses.am: አሜስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሀያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱ ዮዓዳን የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a perfect heart.
verses.fr: Il fit ce qui est droit aux yeux de l''Eternel, mais avec un coeur qui n''était pas entièrement dévoué.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፥ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልብ አይደለም።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
verses.fr: Lorsque la royauté fut affermie entre ses mains, il fit périr ses serviteurs qui avaient tué le roi son père.
verses.am: መንግሥትም በጸናለት ጊዜ አባቱን የገደሉትን ባሪያዎች ገደለ።

verses.en: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.fr: Mais il ne fit pas mourir leurs fils, car il agit selon ce qui est écrit dans la loi, dans le livre de Moïse, où l''Eternel donne ce commandement: On ne fera point mourir les pères pour les enfants, et l''on ne fera point mourir les enfants pour les pères; mais on fera mourir chacun pour son péché.
verses.am: በሙሴም ሕግ መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ ኃጢያቱ ይሙት እንጂ አባቶች በልጆች ፋንታ አይሙቱ፥ ልጆችም በአባቶች ፋንታ አይሙቱ ብሎ እንዳዘዘ የነፍሰ ገዳዮችን ልጆች አልገደለም።

verses.en: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
verses.fr: Amatsia rassembla les hommes de Juda et les plaça d''après les maisons paternelles, les chefs de milliers et les chefs de centaines, pour tout Juda et Benjamin; il en fit le dénombrement depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, et il trouva trois cent mille hommes d''élite, en état de porter les armes, maniant la lance et le bouclier.
verses.am: አሜስያስም ይሁዳን ሰበሰበ፥ በእየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ከሺህ አለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች እጅ በታች አቆማቸው፤ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀመሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉትን ይሁዳንና ብንያምን ሁሉ ቈጠረ፥ ለሰልፍም የሚወጡ፥ ጋሻና ጦርም የሚይዙ ሦስት መቶ ሺህ የተመረጡ ሰዎች አገኘ።

verses.en: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
verses.fr: Il prit encore à sa solde dans Israël cent mille vaillants hommes pour cent talents d''argent.
verses.am: ደግሞም ከእስራኤል ዘንድ መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኃያላን በመቶ መክሊት ብር ቀጠረ።

verses.en: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the Lord is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
verses.fr: Un homme de Dieu vint auprès de lui, et dit: O roi, qu''une armée d''Israël ne marche point avec toi, car l''Eternel n''est pas avec Israël, avec tous ces fils d''Ephraïm.
verses.am: አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ግን ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤልና ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ጋር አይደለምና የእስራኤል ጭፍራ ከአንተ ጋር አይውጣ።

verses.en: But if thou wilt go, do it; be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
verses.fr: Si tu vas avec eux, quand même tu ferais au combat des actes de vaillance, Dieu te fera tomber devant l''ennemi, car Dieu a le pouvoir d''aider et de faire tomber.
verses.am: ብትሄድ ግን፥ በእነርሱም ማሸነፍን ብታስብ፥ የመርዳትና የመጣል ኃይል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነውና እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶችህ ፊት ይጥልሃል አለው።

verses.en: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The Lord is able to give thee much more than this.
verses.fr: Amatsia dit à l''homme de Dieu: Et comment agir à l''égard des cent talents que j''ai donnés à la troupe d''Israël? L''homme de Dieu répondit: L''Eternel peut te donner bien plus que cela.
verses.am: አሜስያስም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው። ለእስራኤል ጭፍራ የሰጠሁት መቶ መክሊት ምን ይሁን? አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው። ከዚህ አብልጦ ይሰጥህ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይችላል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
verses.fr: Alors Amatsia sépara la troupe qui lui était venue d''Ephraïm, afin que ces gens retournassent chez eux. Mais ils furent très irrités contre Juda, et ils s''en allèrent chez eux avec une ardente colère.
verses.am: አሜስያስም ከኤፍሬም የመጡት ጭፍሮች ወደ ስፍራቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ለይቶ አሰናበታቸው፤ ስለዚህም ቍጣቸው በይሁዳ ላይ ጸና፥ ወደ አገራቸውም በጽኑ ቍጣ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
verses.fr: Amatsia prit courage, et conduisit son peuple. Il alla dans la vallée du sel, et il battit dix mille hommes des fils de Séir.
verses.am: አሜስያስም በረታ፥ ሕዝቡንም አውጥቶ ወደ ጨው ሸለቆ ሄደ፥ ከሴይርም ልጆች አሥር ሺህ ገደለ።

verses.en: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
verses.fr: Et les fils de Juda en saisirent dix mille vivants, qu''ils menèrent au sommet d''un rocher, d''où ils les précipitèrent; et tous furent écrasés.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች ደግሞ አሥር ሺህ ሰዎችን በሕይወታቸው ማረኩ፥ ወደ ዓለቱም ራስ ላይ አመጡአቸው፤ ከዓለቱም ራስ ላይ ጣሉአቸው፥ ሁሉም ተፈጠፈጡ።

verses.en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
verses.fr: Cependant, les gens de la troupe qu''Amatsia avait renvoyés pour qu''ils n''allassent pas à la guerre avec lui firent une invasion dans les villes de Juda depuis Samarie jusqu''à Beth-Horon, y tuèrent trois mille personnes, et enlevèrent de nombreuses dépouilles.
verses.am: አሜስያስ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ እንዳይሄዱ ያሰናበታቸው ጭፍሮች ከሰማርያ ጀምረው እስከ ቤትሖሮን ድረስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ከእነርሱም ሦስት ሺህ ገደሉ፥ ብዙ ምርኮም ማረኩ።

verses.en: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''Amatsia fut de retour après la défaite des Edomites, il fit venir les dieux des fils de Séir, et se les établit pour dieux; il se prosterna devant eux, et leur offrit des parfums.
verses.am: አሜስያስም የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች ከገደለ በኋላ የሴይርን ልጆች አማልክት አመጣ፥ የእርሱም አማልክት ይሆኑ ዘንድ አቆማቸው፥ ይሰግድላቸውም ያጥንላቸውም ነበር።

verses.en: Wherefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
verses.fr: Alors la colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Amatsia, et il envoya vers lui un prophète, qui lui dit: Pourquoi as-tu recherché les dieux de ce peuple, quand ils n''ont pu délivrer leur peuple de ta main?
verses.am: ስለዚህም የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በአሜስያስ ላይ ነደደና። ሕዝባቸውን ከአንተ እጅ ያላዳኑትን የአሕዛብን አማልክት ስለ ምን ፈለግሃቸው? የሚል ነቢይ ሰደደበት።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
verses.fr: Comme il parlait, Amatsia lui dit: Est-ce que nous t''avons fait conseiller du roi? Retire-toi! Pourquoi veux-tu qu''on te frappe? Le prophète se retira, en disant: Je sais que Dieu a résolu de te détruire, parce que tu as fait cela et que tu n''as pas écouté mon conseil.
verses.am: እርሱም ሲናገር ንጉሡ። በውኑ አንተ የንጉሡ አማካሪ ልትሆን ሾመነሃልን? ተው፤ ቅጣትን ስለ ምን ትሻለህ? አለው። ነቢዩም። ይህን አድርገሃልና፥ ምክሬንም አልሰማህምና እግዚአብሔር ሊያጠፋህ እንዳሰበ አወቅሁ ብሎ ተወ።

verses.en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
verses.fr: Après s''être consulté, Amatsia, roi de Juda, envoya dire à Joas, fils de Joachaz, fils de Jéhu, roi d''Israël: Viens, voyons-nous en face!
verses.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ አሜስያስ ምክር አደረገና። ና፥ እርስ በርሳችን ፊት ለፊት እንተያይ ብሎ ወደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ ወደ ኢዩ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ወደ ኢዮአስ ላከ።

verses.en: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.fr: Et Joas, roi d''Israël, fit dire à Amatsia, roi de Juda: L''épine du Liban envoya dire au cèdre du Liban: Donne ta fille pour femme à mon fils! Et les bêtes sauvages qui sont au Liban passèrent et foulèrent l''épine.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮስያስ። የሊባኖስ ኵርንችት። ልጅህን ለልጄ ሚስት አድርገህ ስጠው ብሎ ወድ ሊባኖስ ዝግባ ላከ፤ የሊባኖስም አውሬ አልፎ ኵርንችቱን ረገጠ።

verses.en: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
verses.fr: Tu as battu les Edomites, penses-tu, et ton coeur s''élève pour te glorifier. Reste maintenant chez toi. Pourquoi t''engager dans une malheureuse entreprise, qui amènerait ta ruine et celle de Juda?
verses.am: አንተም። እነሆ፥ ኤዶምያስን መትቻለሁ ብለህ ኰርተሃል፤ በቤትህ ተቀመጥ፤ አንተ ከይሁዳ ጋር ትወድቅ ዘንድ ስለ ምን መከራ ትሻላህ? ብሎ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሜስያስ ላከ።

verses.en: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
verses.fr: Mais Amatsia ne l''écouta pas, car Dieu avait résolu de les livrer entre les mains de l''ennemi, parce qu''ils avaient recherché les dieux d''Edom.
verses.am: የኤዶምያስንም አማልክት ስለ ፈለጉ በጠላቶቻቸው እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ ነበረና አሜስያስ አልሰማም።

verses.en: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
verses.fr: Et Joas, roi d''Israël, monta; et ils se virent en face, lui et Amatsia, roi de Juda, à Beth-Schémesch, qui est à Juda.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ ወጣ፤ እርሱና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሜስያስም በይሁዳ ባለች በቤትሳሚስ ላይ እርስ በርሳቸው ተያዩ።

verses.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
verses.fr: Juda fut battu par Israël, et chacun s''enfuit dans sa tente.
verses.am: ይሁዳም በእስራኤል ፊት ተመታ፥ እያንዳንዱም ወደ ድንኳኑ ሸሸ።

verses.en: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.fr: Joas, roi d''Israël, prit à Beth-Schémesch Amatsia, roi de Juda, fils de Joas, fils de Joachaz. Il l''emmena à Jérusalem, et il fit une brèche de quatre cents coudées dans la muraille de Jérusalem, depuis la porte d''Ephraïm jusqu''à la porte de l''angle.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮአስ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የአካዝያስን ልጅ የኢዮአስን ልጅ አሜስያስን በቤትሳሚስ ይዞ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመጣው፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር ከኤፍሬም በር ጀምሮ እስከ ማዕዘኑ በር ድረስ አራት መቶ ክንድ አፈረሰ።
